jobs.title: Junior Chief of Staff (a) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als «Junior Chief of Staff».**

**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine Rolle im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung


**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die Finger schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst


**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit j4id10414393a j4it0940a j4iy26a**

**HRM Systems AG mit Sitz in Winterthur ist ein erfolgreiches Familienunternehmen mit 160 Mitarbeitenden und langer Firmengeschichte. Grossunternehmen und Unternehmensgruppen werden bei der Abwicklung von HR\-Prozessen und im betrieblichen Gesundheitsmanagement durch die im Hause entwickelten Softwarelösungen und Dienstleistungen unterstützt. Als Marktleader in ihrem Bereich steht das Unternehmen auf stabilen und finanziell gesunden Beinen. Dies ermöglicht die gezielte Investition in die wegweisende Weiterentwicklung ihrer Produkte. Auf dich warten flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, grosszügige Home\-Office\-Regelungen, sehr gute Sozialleistungen sowie moderne Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit der spürbar gelebten Wertekultur «Gemeinsam», «Mutig», «Begeistert» und «Respektvoll» bietet man dir ein attraktives Umfeld.**

**Die IT von HRM Systems entwickelt sich stetig weiter. Komplexe Produkte, gewachsene Infrastrukturen und moderne SaaS\-Architekturen bringen spannende technische Herausforderungen mit sich. Um den Bereich DevOps über alle Produkte hinweg gezielt zu stärken, wird ein neues, kleines DevOps\-Team aufgebaut. Dieses Team bildet künftig die Brücke zwischen dem Produktbereich, interner Infrastruktur, Betriebsinfrastruktur und dem Entwicklungsbereich. Damit entsteht eine vielseitige Rolle mit Gestaltungsspielraum und technischer Verantwortung. Im Rahmen eines Exklusivmandats suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n DevOps Engineer.**

**Deine Herausforderung**

* Du unterstützt übergreifend die Produktentwicklungsteams rund um die drei Produkte UKA Solutions, CAREMA und UKA Connect bei DevOps\-Themen und betreust die bestehende Infrastruktur.

* Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb von Produktions\- und Entwicklungsumgebungen auf Infrastruktur\-Ebene sicher.

* Du analysierst und behebst Störungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Entwicklungsteams, IT\-Services und dem externen Infrastruktur\-Provider.

* Du optimierst die Automatisierung rund um Builds, Deployments, Testing, Monitoring und Alerting.

* Du bringst technische Konzepte voran und schaffst die Grundlage für eine stabile, sichere und wartungsarme Infrastruktur.

* Du arbeitest mit Technologien und Werkzeugen wie GitLab, OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, ELK, Grafana und Nagios.

* Du übernimmst übergreifende Themen wie die Verwaltung von Lizenzen und Zugriffsberechtigungen für Entwickler.

* Du entwickelst ein neu entstehendes DevOps Team aktiv mit und bringst deine Ideen für langfristig tragfähige Lösungen ein.

**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps oder DevOps\-nahen Umfeld

* Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung (du kommst entweder aus der Softwareentwicklung und hast dich in Richtung DevOps entwickelt oder du bringst einen Infrastruktur\-Background mit starkem DevOps\-Engineering Verständnis mit)

* Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse von mehreren Technologien, welche sich mit denen bei HRM decken: OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, GitLab

* Du gestaltest gerne mit und bringst deine Ideen ein

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
GLOBAZ SA développe et héberge des solutions IT critiques pour des environnements exigeants en  
Suisse : prévoyance, santé, industrie et administrations. Nos activités impliquent un haut niveau de fiabilité,  
de sécurité, de qualité d’exécution et de responsabilité. L’entreprise est engagée dans une  
transformation importante de son organisation et de son niveau d’exécution.


Dans un contexte de structuration de notre Customer Journey, nous recherchons un(e) :



**Business Analyst**  

GLOBAZ SA est engagée dans une transformation ambitieuse de son modèle opérationnel, de sa culture et de sa relation client. Notre ambition : passer d'une logique de fournisseur de services à une logique de partenaire stratégique créateur de valeur.

Nos clients ne nous évaluent pas sur nos intentions. Ils nous évaluent sur la qualité de l'expérience vécue, notre capacité à comprendre leurs enjeux, notre proactivité et notre réactivité, notre capacité à résoudre leurs « irritations », et notre capacité à contribuer concrètement à leur succès.

Ce rôle clé contribue à améliorer concrètement l'expérience client, à réduire les frictions, à accélérer la résolution des « problèmes » et à renforcer durablement la valeur créée pour nos clients.

**Ton rôle**

Le Business Analyst recueille et analyse les besoins des clients, qu’il s’agisse d’identifier des faiblesses ou opportunités d’amélioration des processus métier, de faire évoluer les structures organisationnelles ou de répondre à des enjeux informatiques. Il les challenge, les formalise en exigences claires et structurées, puis identifie les différentes possibilités d’implémentation en solutions informatiques.

Il intervient notamment dans des projets de digitalisation et d’automatisation des processus métier, ainsi que dans des activités de maintenance et de développement de solutions logicielles.

Au quotidien, le Business Analyst travaille en étroite collaboration avec les Project Managers (PM), Product Owners (PO), équipes IT et parties prenantes métier. Il veille à créer une compréhension commune des besoins et à assurer le lien entre les attentes métier et leur traduction en solutions technologiques.

En résumé, le Business Analyst est un véritable facilitateur de la transformation : il comprend les enjeux, pose les bonnes questions, structure les besoins et contribue à transformer les idées en solutions à valeur ajoutée.

**Tes responsabilités**

***Comprendre et recueillir les besoins :***

* Définir le processus et les méthodes employées pour la récolte des besoins (ateliers, interview, event storming, etc…)
* Formaliser les besoins, les valider et les transcrire en exigences, les spécifier et les modéliser
* Cartographier et décrire les processus ainsi que les flux de valeurs


***Analyser et challenger les besoins** :*

* Analyser le fonctionnement global des processus métier, des structures d'organisation et des enjeux de l'informatique
* Analyser les besoins des parties prenantes internes et externes
* Documenter les besoins métiers au travers de spécifications et de maquettes (rédaction des cahiers des charges)
* Proposer des solutions informatiques et organisationnelles pour répondre aux besoins


***Accompagner la réalisation :***

* Rédiger les user stories et les critères d’acceptation, alimenter le backlog avec le Product Owner
* Participer aux cérémonies agiles et rester disponible pour les équipes de développement tout au long de la réalisation
* Contribuer à la définition des scénarios de test et vérifier la conformité des solutions livrées avec les besoins analysés


**Ton profil**

* Sensibilité technique : tu es à l’aise pour dialoguer avec les développeurs et tu comprends les enjeux d’une solution logicielle ; une formation ou une expérience dans l’informatique (développement, intégration, bases de données, API) est un plus
* Expérience de la méthodologie agile (user stories, backlog, tests d’acceptation)
* Connaissance des assurances sociales suisses (AVS/AI/APG, PC, allocations familiales, LAMal) et expérience avec des logiciels métier complexes : un atout majeur
* Orientation client : tu raisonnes succès et expérience client
* Orientation solutions : face à une difficulté, tu proposes des options plutôt que de remonter des problèmes ; tu es pragmatique et tu aimes faire avancer les choses
* Esprit d’équipe et aisance relationnelle : tu sais fédérer des interlocuteurs métier et techniques, animer des ateliers et coordonner des équipes pluridisciplinaires
* Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA) ou Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP) : un plus

Einleitungstext
Please apply until 31 October 2026.

Projekthintergrund
ETH Space mission is to boost space activities to establish ETH Zurich as the leading university in space research and Earth observation, education and entrepreneurship within Europe and beyond. ETH Space encompasses overall five units: Education, Research, Entrepreneurship, the ETH Swiss GeoLab, and the space mission, LIFE.

ETH Space is led by Prof. Thomas Zurbuchen as its director, and Prof. Richard Kornfeld, as managing director. The team overall consists of about 35 employees. The office is located in Zurich downtown, in one of the central ETH buildings.

The team and finances of ETH Space have grown significantly in recent years, and as ETH Space is transitioning to become an ETH Center, we are looking to add a person for Finance & Controlling and Office Support.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension. The desired starting date is as soon as possible.

For details see Home - ETH Zurich | Space as well as our LinkedIn channel.

Aufgaben-/Stellenbeschreibung
In this multifaceted role, you will take responsibility for Finance & Internal Controlling as well as support the Office Management of ETH Space, playing a key role in ensuring the efficient and smooth operation of the organizational unit. You will ensure the proper execution of financial and administrative processes, support the leadership team with organizational and operational matters, and act as the central point of contact between internal and external stakeholders - for finance and controlling matters. You will support transparent workflows, reliable administration, and professional support for the ETH Space unit.

Your areas of responsibility include, in particular:

Finance & Controlling:

Budget calculations (annual budget and bi-annual rolling forecasts)
Project finances: from budgeting and expenditure to financial reports
Procurement of goods and services involving complex ordering structures, including quote comparisons, export control compliance, procurement regulations, tenders, and contract awards
Accounting & ETH Space internal controlling
Invoice verification and payment
Processing employee expense claims
Credit card statement reconciliation
Performance-based project billing (via SAP)
Handling all ETH Zurich internal finance-related inquiries
Office Management Support:

Administrative support for ETH Space management
Preparation of documents and reports
Tracking tasks and projects
Handling sensitive information confidentially
Support office management in managing daily office operations
Provide recruitment support (job postings, application coordination)
Support new employee onboarding

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH KJP Akutstation 80-100% für die Region Rheinfelden gesucht
jobs.description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Rheinfelden sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt KJP Akutstation.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Rheinfelden

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** KJP Akutstation

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Rheinfelden

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Rheinfelden liegt im Kanton Aargau an der Grenze zu Südbaden und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung dank direkter Bahnverbindungen zu Basel, Zürich und Bern. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein ausgezeichnetes Angebot an Arbeitsplätzen in verschiedenen Branchen sowie eine hohe Lebensqualität mit schöner Naturlandschaft am Rhein. Dank moderner Infrastruktur und kurzer Pendlerstrecken ist Rheinfelden ein attraktiver Arbeitsort für Fachkräfte.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Rheinfelden

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: KJP Akutstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Rheinfelden verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH in der Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie ist in der Region Rheinfelden äußerst angespannt und bietet Ihnen hervorragende Chancen. Akutstationen suchen kontinuierlich nach qualifiziertem Personal im Pensum von 80-100%, da der Fachkräftemangel anhält. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit lokalem Know-how und hilft Ihnen, schnell die passende Stelle zu finden und erfolgreich einzusteigen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Rheinfelden

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Rheinfelden

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Tipp: Laufend neue [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

### Interessiert? Wir freuen uns auf Sie

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH KJP Akutstation in Rheinfelden wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.
- Bewerben Sie sich deshalb jetzt als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für Rheinfelden. Wir vermitteln schnell und persönlich, denn gute Fachkräfte verdienen ebenso gute Partner.

The Opportunity

jobs.title: Product Portfolio Senior Manager Education & Athletes Pathways
jobs.employer: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
jobs.description:
Postulation : https://www.jobup.ch/en/jobs/detail/b2dabcb5-de1a-49d7-870d-91c536ce96a7/?source=company_detail

Are you passionate about creating seamless experiences in education and sport? Are you sensitive to serving the
athletes and bringing them at the center of the sport ecosystem ?
Do you thrive in dynamic, multicultural environments?
Are you driven by developing projects and businesses?
Then join AISTS – the International Academy of Sports Management and Technology – and contribute to shaping
the future of sports leadership.
About AISTS
AISTS, the International Academy of Sport Management and Technology, is a prestigious not-for-profit academic
centre at the heart of the global sport industry. Founded in 2000 in Lausanne, Switzerland, it offers world-class
education and advisory services in sport management. AISTS's unique multidisciplinary approach combines
expertise in technology, management, economics, medicine, career and leadership. With a network of over 750
alumni, 100 distinguished lecturers, and partnerships with leading sport organisations, AISTS shapes the future of
international sport. Located in the Olympic Capital, it serves as a bridge between academia and industry, promoting
excellence in sport management to drive positive global impact through the power of sport.
Your role
The Product Portfolio Senior Manager is responsible for translating the AISTS portfolio strategy into a coherent,
prioritised and commercially viable product portfolio across three product areas: Education, Athletes Pathways, and
Advisory. It initially owns direct responsibility for both Education and Athletes Pathways products streams.
The role ensures that AISTS moves from a primarily MAS-centred organisation toward an integrated platform
combining industry access, short and tailored education, athlete-career transition solutions, and international sport
organisations advisory services (e.g. impact assessments, certification, research mandates, etc.).
Positioning & Context
Reporting to the Executive Director, you will work in partnership with the Professors, experts, speakers and partners
of the AISTS network. Internally, you will work closely with the Head of B2B Partnerships & Development and the
Head of Operations & Delivery. Initially, you will manage the Sport Advisory Product Coordinator.
This role is established as part of a new strategy adopted and rolled out by AISTS. The scope of the role may evolve
according to the deployment of the strategy.
Key responsibilities
Portfolio Management
• Own the consolidated product portfolio roadmap across Education, Athletes Pathways and Advisory.
• Establish common product management standards and coherence across products in terms of target
audiences, value propositions, pricing logic, delivery model, resource needs and expected contribution.
• Prioritise product development using mission alignment, market demand, revenue potential, profitability,
scalability, feasibility and strategic value.
• Translate strategic priorities into clear product briefs, annual product plans, performance indicators and
implementation milestones.
• Maintain product governance discipline, ensuring that each product has an owner, business case, delivery
model, quality criteria, review cycle and is aligned with B2B development (proposal development) and clearly
framed for the Operations and Delivery team to operate
• Provide the Executive Director with a consolidated view of product performance, portfolio risks,
dependencies and investment priorities.
Product ownership
1. Athlete Pathways
• Design and develop the AISTS Athletes Pathways offer, including education, transition, employability,
leadership, entrepreneurship and mentoring formats for active, retiring and retired athletes.
• Build the product value proposition for IFs, NOCs, Olympic stakeholders, athlete commissions, agencies,
sponsors and individual athletes.
• Coordinate athlete-specific curriculum development, mentor pools, career coaching components and
storytelling opportunities with alumni, industry experts and corporate partners.
• Track performance of the athlete pathway product, including athletes supported, revenues, scholarships,
partner satisfaction and post-programme outcomes.
2. Master of Advanced Studies in Sport Management and Technology (MAS) & Continued Education
programmes
• Coordinate curriculum architecture, learning formats, field visits, internships, Client Team Projects, research
papers and industry exposure to maintain and strengthen the leading positioning of the programme.
• Work with delivery coordinators and academic partners to ensure programme design is feasible, coherent
and quality-controlled.
• Lead on the design of the annual Continued Education portfolio across Sport Business, Sport Leadership and
Sport Technology, ensuring their relevance for market needs
• Define course value propositions, target segments, learning outcomes, course leaders, pricing logic and
annual calendar priorities.
• Source lecturers and guest speakers and, where relevant, supervise MAS Client Team Projects
3. Training Houses and tailored education solution
• Develop repeatable B2B education offers for sport organisations starting with IFs and then NOCs, NFs,
LOCs, etc.
• Package tailored education into clear formats, such as staff training, leadership journeys, member federation
modules, Olympic Capital Training Weeks and capability-building workshops ensuring balanced
customisation and reusability
4. Learning innovation and online support
• Use digital or online learning selectively to support continuity, blended formats, pre-work, follow-up modules
or scalable partner needs.
• Contribute to the development of reusable learning assets, templates, cases and content libraries when they
improve product quality and scalability.
• Coordinate with academic and industry stakeholders to keep education products relevant to emerging
trends such as digital, AI, sustainability, governance, fan engagement and commercial innovation.
Product team management
• Manage and coordinate the work with the product coordinator(s).
• Ensure that product owners work closely with Business Development and Marketing for market relevance,
positioning and partnerships and with Operations for delivery feasibility.
What we offer
• Dynamic Work Environment: Join an international team passionate about sports and education.
• Career Development: Gain exposure to a wide range of projects in a prestigious organisation.
• Inclusive Culture: We value diverse perspectives and actively encourage applications from all genders,
backgrounds, and experiences.
• Professional Growth: Access to training programmes to enhance your skills and career development.
• Mentorship Opportunities: Be part of a supportive team committed to helping you thrive in your role.
• Prime Location: Work in Lausanne, the Olympic Capital, with access to sports facilities and view on the
lake

jobs.title: Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Truck Racing and Historic Sporting Coordinator will contribute to the sporting, regulatory and operational delivery of the FIA Truck Racing and Historic Championships. The position is intended for a confirmed sporting coordination profile, capable of managing day-to-day championship matters with a high level of autonomy, while ensuring appropriate escalation and validation on regulatory, sporting and governance matters.

The role requires practical on-site experience, regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials and teams, and the ability to distinguish between matters to be managed independently, matters to be prepared for validation, and matters to be performed under the authority of the relevant sporting decision-makers.

The indicative workload allocation is expected to be:
Truck Racing: 60%
Historic Championships: 40%

MISSIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
TRUCK RACING CHAMPIONSHIP SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate the day-to-day sporting administration of the Truck Racing Championship, ensuring compliance with FIA requirements, sporting regulations and established procedures.
Manage the championship entry process and entry platform where applicable, including competitor support, document follow-up and deadline monitoring.
Review entry documentation and prepare any non-standard or eligibility-related matters for validation by the relevant Championship Manager or competent FIA body.
Coordinate routine communications with teams, ASNs, officials and internal FIA departments on sporting and operational matters.

HISTORIC CHAMPIONSHIPS SPORTING COORDINATION :
Coordinate day-to-day sporting and administrative matters related to Historic Championships, in liaison with the Historic Championships & Commission Manager.
Prepare sporting documents, procedures and information notes for review and validation by the relevant manager or governance body.
Follow up championship-related actions, regulatory updates and stakeholder requests.
Ensure proper coordination between Historic championship activities, commission work and FIA internal processes.

SPORTING DOCUMENTATION :
Prepare, review and maintain sporting documents for events and championships, including procedures, notes to competitors, operational guidelines and Stewards' Handbooks.
Ensure sporting documents remain aligned with current FIA regulations, championship requirements and operational practices.
Prepare draft amendments or updates for validation by the relevant Championship Manager and, where applicable, FIA governance bodies.
Coordinate the circulation of validated documents to the relevant internal and external stakeholders.

ON-SITE EVENT OPERATIONS AND RACE CONTROL SUPPORT

Race Control and Stewards support :
Support the Race Director and Race Control team during events, including preparation and coordination of operational procedures, messaging systems, radio communications, incident follow-up and parc fermé processes.
Prepare Race Control documentation, checklists and briefing materials in advance of events.
Assist the Stewards during events by coordinating administrative and operational processes, including official documentation, communication flows and distribution of decisions.
Prepare incident-related documentation or reports for review by the Race Director or Stewards, without substituting for their sporting decision-making authority.
Operate FIA onboard camera systems and retrieve footage when requested by the Race Director or Stewards for sporting or regulatory purposes.

Commission, committee and stakeholder coordination :
Attend meetings of the Truck Racing Commission, Historic Commission and related working groups as Sporting Coordinator.
Prepare agendas, working documents, meeting dossiers and follow-up notes for review and validation where required.
Maintain records of commission activities, recommendations and decisions.
Follow up action items resulting from commission meetings and coordinate with relevant FIA departments or stakeholders.
Escalate sensitive, strategic or policy-related matters to the relevant Championship Manager or Head of Racing & Historic.

Operational and administrative coordination :
Coordinate the operational needs of FIA staff on-site in relation to Truck Racing and Historic activities.
Support implementation of FIA sporting requirements during events.
Ensure effective preparation, follow-up and filing of sporting and operational documentation.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of sporting and operational processes within the scope of the role.

PROFILE:
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in motorsport sporting operations, championship coordination, race administration or equivalent.
Proven practical on-site experience and regular interaction with Race Control, Stewards, Race Directors, officials, teams and championship stakeholders.
Strong understanding of motorsport sporting regulations, event operations and regulatory processes.
Ability to work autonomously, manage priorities and identify matters requiring validation or escalation.
Strong organisational, drafting and communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear sporting and operational documentation.
Ability to work under pressure in an event environment and to interact professionally with officials, competitors and internal departments.
Fluent in English; French would be an advantage.
Available from December 2026.

jobs.title: SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
jobs.description:
Securecell is a Swiss technology company at the intersection of biotechnology, engineering, and healthcare. For more than three decades, we have been developing innovative solutions that help advance scientific discoveries and improve people's lives. Combining deep expertise in bioprocess control with a strong culture of innovation, we collaborate across disciplines to transform complex challenges into practical technologies that create real-world impact.

Continuing steadily on our sustainable innovation path and growth journey, we are looking for a
SOFTWARE SOLUTION ENGINEER
for our Information Technology Department – Software Architecture team – product R&D role

THE OPPORTUNITY
It is an opportunity to contribute to technologies that support groundbreaking scientific discoveries and help shape the future of biotechnology and healthcare.
As a member of our Software Architecture team, you will play an important role in designing, developing, verifying, and managing the lifecycle of software solutions for innovative medical and biotechnological devices. Working closely with experts from various disciplines, you will contribute to challenging projects, develop innovative solutions, and help deliver products that create value for our customers worldwide.
Whether you are improving existing technologies, driving innovation, or solving complex technical challenges, your contributions will have a direct impact on our success and future growth.
You are part of our Software Architecture Team and accountable for the design, development, verification, and lifecycle management of our Lucullus software platform. In this role, you actively contribute to software development, provide technical leadership, and oversee the software development, integration, and verification of our innovative devices. Lucullus is our process information management platform for bioprocess labs: it connects and controls lab devices and bioreactors, acquires and stores process data, and supports experiment planning and analysis.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
•    Design and evolve the architecture of the Lucullus platform (modules, APIs, data model, device-integration layer) and document key decisions in architecture decision records and design specifications.
•    Implement key components yourself (approx. 50% of time is hands-on design and coding)
•    Own the non-functional requirements: performance, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
•    Prototype and evaluate new technologies before they are adopted in the product.
•    Create, review, and maintain technical documentation, including specifications and design descriptions.
•    Support requirements management, risk management, and compliance activities in accordance with applicable standards and quality requirements.
•    Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, and Product Management.

WHO YOU ARE
You enjoy solving complex technical challenges and thrive in an environment where software architecture and development are critical to delivering innovative technologies. You are proactive, hands-on, and motivated to develop technologies that advance biotechnology and improve lives. You are comfortable providing technical leadership within cross-functional and agile teams. You would rather design and build than coordinate: you enjoy writing code, sketching architecture, and defending technical trade-offs with facts. Leading here means leading by technical example, not by managing people or schedules.


YOUR PROFILE
•    Completed studies (FH / Uni / ETH) in Engineering, preferably Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology.
•    At least 3years of experience in software development.
•    Strong expertise in software development with experience in enterprise-grade applications. Hands-on approach.
•    Ability to collaborate effectively, translating architectural decisions into technical solutions across teams.
•    Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complexity in a large technical stack.
•    Ability to mentor engineers and drive technical decisions through design reviews, code reviews.
•    Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD tools, and automation frameworks.
•    Proficiency in Linux environments, particularly with LTS distributions and Oracle Linux (preferred but open to alternatives).
•    Industry experience in Medtech/Biotech and in (bio)process technology is not a prerequisite; however, there must be a strong interest and awareness that the environment is regulated.
•    Experience working with enterprise databases, particularly Oracle DB and PostgreSQL.
•    Solid understanding of security best practices, compliance, and secure coding methodologies.
•    A valid work permit is required, and only direct applications will be taken into consideration (no agencies)

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU SUCCESSFUL
•    Experience in biotechnology, bioprocessing, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, or life sciences (nice to have)
•    Proven track record of designing and personally implementing software systems end-to-end
•    Passion for innovation and technology
•    Ability to navigate ambiguity and identify practical solutions
•    Strong sense of ownership and accountability
•    Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset
•    Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships across disciplines
•    Experience working in multidisciplinary and international environments

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT SECURECELL
Make an Impact: Your work contributes to innovative technologies that support scientific progress, improve healthcare outcomes, and help address real-world challenges
Work with Exceptional People: Join a global team of talented scientists, engineers, software developers, and business professionals who are passionate about innovation and collaboration
Grow Your Career: We encourage continuous learning and provide opportunities to develop new skills, expand your expertise, and take on new challenges
Innovate Every Day: Be part of cutting-edge projects and help develop solutions that push the boundaries of biotechnology, automation, and healthcare technology
Take Ownership: We believe great ideas can come from anywhere. You'll enjoy a high level of responsibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to make a visible contribution
Enjoy a Collaborative Culture: Our success is built on teamwork, knowledge sharing, mutual respect, and a genuine passion for solving complex challenges together
Be Part of Our Growth Story: Join a growing Swiss technology company where innovation, entrepreneurship, and long-term thinking are at the core of everything we do

WHAT WE OFFER
With flexible working arrangements, a modern workplace, flat hierarchies, and short decision-making paths, we empower individuals to take ownership, contribute ideas, and make a visible impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement, allowing every team member to help shape the future of our company and the industries we serve. To complement this, we offer:
•    Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and contribution
•    Comprehensive benefits package supporting your well-being
•    Generous vacation entitlement, flexible working hours, and hybrid or remote work options
•    Flexible leave arrangements that support work-life balance
•    Learning and development opportunities through training, mentoring, and hands-on experiences
•    Opportunities to collaborate with international customers and partners
•    Convenient location with direct access to public transport, free indoor parking, complimentary coffee and mineral water
•    Private accident insurance and paid time off for new parents
•    Employee share purchase programs (availability varies upon eligibility)
•    Regular team events and company gatherings that strengthen connections and celebrate success

JOB LOCATION
This position is based at Securecell AG headquarters in Urdorf (Zurich), Switzerland. Reporting to: Head of Software.

INTERESTED?
We look forward to learning more about you! Please submit your complete application, including a cover letter, a resume, certificates, and references, through our career portal at www.securecell.ch/jobs, and share, in 2-3 sentences, what attracted you to our company and this role.

jobs.title: Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
jobs.description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified
Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
to join the school from: August 2027

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 02.11.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.
Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for around 500 students aged 7-18 representing 70 nations. Students prepare for IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced, enthusiastic, dynamic, knowledgeable leader and/or teacher of Physical Education and Sport. PE and Sport are compulsory for students throughout the Junior and Senior schools. In Years 10 and 11 students have the option of studying IGCSE PE. Subsequently, in Years 12 and 13, Sports, Exercise and Health Science is offered and is currently taught in conjunction with the Science department.
KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Professional Standards and Expectations
Carry out teaching duties and exercise responsibilities in line with the Guiding Principles of Aiglon;
Treat all members of the community, colleagues and students, with respect and consideration. Treat all students fairly, consistently and without prejudice;
Set a good example to students in terms of appropriate dress, standards of punctuality and attendance;
Read and adhere to the various policies of the school as expressed in the Aiglon Guide and other agreed documentation, and support the ethos of the school by upholding the behaviour code, uniform and kit regulations and other expectations;
Be available to work on campus in good time to complete all necessary preparations and meetings before the start of term;
Take personal responsibility for professional development and participate in staff training in line with the continued professional development programme of Aiglon;
Encourage members of their faculty to take responsibility for their own professional development and ensure all in the faculty participate in staff training in line with the CPD programme of Aiglon;
Reflect on personal and school practices in pursuit of continuous improvement.
Participate in appraisal and self-evaluation activities and ensure the appraisal system is adhered to and completed within the faculty;
Chair a weekly faculty meeting;
Ensure all faculty members are aware of and adhere to departmental deadlines, policies and procedures;
Undertake pastoral and other duties, including weekend and evening duties, as prescribed within school policies;
Ensure that all deadlines are met as published in the school calendar and as directed by the Head of Faculty/Deputy School Directors;
Undertake professional duties that may be reasonably assigned, including cover and exam invigilation and ensure members of their faculty also undertake these duties;
Attend Assembly/Meditation on at least two mornings a week when averaged over any term and be prepared to give a Meditation once each year;
Be proactive and take responsibility for matters relating to health and safety;
Support the school through regular attendance at various events in the School Calendar (these may be religious, spiritual, sporting or cultural).
Departmental Management
Implement a clear vision for curriculum Physical Education and all aspects of Sport at Aiglon, making sure that there is continuity and progression between Junior School and Senior School;
Develop and manage the strategic development plan for the faculty in line with the School’s strategic development plan thus fostering a love of Physical Education and inspiring a lifelong commitment to Sport;
Line management of Head of Junior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Senior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Snowsports and Performance Athletes, MCFC football coach and the Sports Facilities Manager and support  them in the management of all other members of the Physical Education and Sport faculty;
Ensure that the faculty embraces the opportunities available through strategic partnerships including MCFC;
Ensure the faculty handbook is updated annually and includes reference to objectives for the year ahead which tie into the school’s overall objectives;
Provide a strategic link between the Academic Leadership Group and the Physical Education and Sport faculty, attending meetings and reporting on School-wide initiatives;
Ensure that the Department meets the curriculum requirements for the School;
Monitor and develop the quality of teaching, coaching and learning, through regular visits to lessons and otherwise, with a clear focus on excellence;
Implement a clear vision and structure for competitive inter-school sport across the School at Aiglon;
Implement a clear programme for inter-house sport at Aiglon. Liaise with the Director of Boarding and attend House Parent meetings where necessary to publicise and promote sporting initiatives, with clear communication to all stakeholders (students, staff and parents);
Promote and communicate to the Aiglon community initiatives and success stories from the Physical Education and Sport faculty, through weekly assemblies and the calendar alongside regular liaison with stakeholders in Admissions, Communications and Alumni teams;
Ensure that requirements of examination boards are met, and students are entered for public examinations, submitting appropriate coursework and ensuring that students are suitably prepared for examinations;
Preparing an annual report for the Deputy Director setting out an analysis of external examination results and value-added statistics;
Ensure, in consultation with the Deputy School Director the effective deployment of staff and classes within the Department;
Participate in the appointment of new staff, and support new staff entering the Department;
Ensure all members of the faculty take account of students' prior levels of attainment, and baseline data where relevant, and use these to set targets for future improvements;
Oversee all aspects of the organisation of tournaments, fixtures and trips where appropriate;
To be available for School sporting events including The Challenge, Sports Day and other major School events;
Booking of snowsports instructors for all students in the winter term, which will require close liaison with external ski school instructors used by Aiglon, ensuring a high level of instruction takes place and to ensure ability groups are monitored regularly.

Zakres obowiązków: 1. Wykonywanie zadań w zakresie ochrony porządku publicznego wynikającego z ustaw i aktów
prawa miejscowego:
- patrolowanie miasta w patrolach pieszych i samochodowych,
- realizowanie zadań w ramach współdziałania z Policją,
- nakładanie grzywien w formie mandatu karnego,
- prowadzenie postępowań wyjaśniających,
- sporządzanie wniosków o ukaranie do Sądu,
- usuwanie pojazdów i blokowanie kół pojazdów w przypadkach określonych w przepisach
o ruchu drogowym,
- współdziałanie z właściwymi podmiotami w zakresie ratowania życia i zdrowia obywatela,
pomocy w usuwaniu awarii technicznych i skutków klęsk żywiołowych oraz innych
miejscowych zagrożeń,
- zabezpieczanie miejsca przestępstwa, katastrofy lub innego podobnego zdarzenia albo miejsc
zagrożonych takim zdarzeniem przed dostępem osób postronnych lub zniszczeniem śladów
i dowodów, do momentu przybycia właściwych służb, a także ustalenia, w miarę możliwości
świadków zdarzenia,
- ochranianie obiektów komunalnych i urządzeń użyteczności publicznej,
- współdziałanie z organizacjami i innymi służbami w ochronie porządku podczas imprez,
zgromadzeń i imprez publicznych,
- doprowadzanie osób nietrzeźwych do Izby Wytrzeźwień,
- informowanie społeczności lokalnej o stanie i rodzaju zagrożeń, a także uczestniczenie
w działaniach mających na celu zapobieganie popełnianiu przestępstw i wykroczeń
i współdziałanie w tym zakresie z organami państwowymi, samorządowymi i organizacjami
społecznymi,
- konwojowanie dokumentów, przedmiotów wartościowych lub wartości pieniężnych
dla potrzeb Gminy,
- realizacja czynności związanych z niską emisją,
- prowadzenie dokumentacji służbowej w formie papierowej i elektronicznej.
2. Prowadzenie konsultacji z organizacjami pozarządowymi i podmiotami wymienionymi
w art. 3 ust. 3 ustawy z dnia 24 kwietnia 2003 r. o działalności pożytku publicznego
i o wolontariacie, w zakresie projektów.
3. Współpraca z zespołem do spraw nieletnich i patologii Komendy Powiatowej Policji
w Ostrowie Wielkopolskim w zakre

jobs.title: Podinspektor/podinspektorka/inspektor/inspektorka w ref. Gospodarki Komunalnej, Transportu i Utrzymania Dróg
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Podstawowy zakres wykonywanych zadań na stanowisku:  
1) rozliczanie i prowadzenie stosownej sprawozdawczości z realizacji zadań,
2) wnioskowanie w sprawach zaliczania dróg do właściwych kategorii oraz zmiany tych kategorii,
3) przygotowywanie projektów rozstrzygnięć, wniosków i stanowisk Miasta, dotyczących zaliczania dróg i ulic do poszczególnych kategorii oraz współpraca ze Starostwem Powiatowym w tym zakresie,
4) prowadzenie ewidencji dróg gminnych i drogowych obiektów mostowych oraz gromadzenie danych techniczno-eksploatacyjnych i przechowywanie dokumentacji technicznej dróg i obiektów mostowych,
5) koordynacja robót w pasie drogowym,
6) prowadzenie czynności mających na celu wydawanie zezwoleń na zajęcie pasa drogowego dla prowadzenia robót związanych z budową, modernizacją lub remontami podziemnych instalacji inżynieryjnych, na budowę zjazdów z dróg publicznych zarządzanych przez Miasto, umieszczanie obiektów handlowych lub reklam w pasie drogowym oraz naliczanie opłat i kar pieniężnych,
7) wprowadzanie wykonawców w pas drogowy i dokonywanie jego odbiorów po robotach wynikających z wydanych decyzji,
8) przeciwdziałanie niszczeniu dróg przez ich użytkowników,
9) opiniowanie docelowych i tymczasowych projektów organizacji ruchu na czas prowadzenia robót  w pasie drogowym,
10) wydawanie zezwoleń na wykonywanie przewozów regularnych na liniach komunikacyjnych  w komunikacji miejskiej,
11) prowadzenie spraw w zakresie zapewnienia mieszkańcom miasta zbiorowego transportu publicznego,
12) udzielanie licencji na wykonywanie krajowego transportu drogowego w zakresie przewozu osób taksówką na terenie Gminy Tarczyn
13) obsługa i kontrola funkcjonowania miejskich parkingów,
14) przyjmowanie i obsługa wniosków o korzystanie z przystanków z przystanków autobusowych przez przewoźników.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: 1) spełnienie wymogów określonych w art.6 ust.1 i ust.3 ustawy z dnia 21 listopada 2008 roku  
o pracownikac

jobs.title: Stanowisko ds. pozyskiwania funduszy zewnętrznych (k/m)
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Podstawowy zakres wykonywanych zadań na stanowisku:  
1) Prowadzenie spraw związanych z pozyskiwaniem, realizacją, monitorowaniem i rozliczaniem
środków Funduszu Rozwoju Przewozów Autobusowych (FRPA), w tym przygotowywanie
dokumentacji niezbędnej do uzyskania dopłat do przewozów autobusowych o charakterze
użyteczności publicznej.  
2) Przygotowywanie oraz kompletowanie dokumentacji związanej z rozliczaniem dopłat z FRPA,  w tym sporządzanie wymaganych zestawień, informacji, wniosków o wypłatę środków, rozliczeń oraz dokumentów sprawozdawczych.  
3) Monitorowanie realizacji przewozów objętych dofinansowaniem z FRPA pod kątem zgodności z warunkami określonymi w umowach, przepisach prawa oraz wymaganiach właściwych
instytucji.  
4) Współpraca z właściwymi komórkami organizacyjnymi Urzędu, organizatorami i operatorami publicznego transportu zbiorowego oraz innymi podmiotami w zakresie prawidłowej realizacji i rozliczania zadań finansowanych z FRPA.  
5) Monitorowanie zmian przepisów, wytycznych i zasad dotyczących Funduszu Rozwoju Przewozów Autobusowych oraz przekazywanie informacji o ich wpływie na realizowane przez Gminę zadania.
6) wyszukiwanie możliwości pozyskiwania środków finansowych z funduszy pomocowych Unii
Europejskiej, funduszy krajowych oraz innych środków pozabudżetowych możliwych do
pozyskania na realizację projektów w ramach zadań własnych gminy,
7) opracowywanie wniosków aplikacyjnych o dofinansowanie projektów, gromadzenie danych
niezbędnych do właściwego opracowania dokumentacji aplikacyjnej, przygotowywanie
załączników do wniosków,  
8) prowadzenie spraw związanych z prawidłową realizacją projektów, na które pozyskane zostały zewnętrzne środki finansowe w szczególności praca w systemach sprawozdawczych,
przygotowywanie niezbędnych zestawień i dokumentów, prowadzenie raportowania, monitoringu i sprawozdawczości zgodnie z nałożonymi obowiązkami wynikającymi z zawartych umów o dofinansowanie,
9) utrzymywanie stałych kontaktów z instytucjami zajmującymi

  **Who is Eversys and what do we offer?**  



We have become a leader in the world of professional automatic coffee machines by developing innovative solutions inextraction methods and quality control of coffee products.



Our vision is to bridge the gap between the traditional Italian coffee machine with the speed and electronic intelligence of the super\-automatic machine. We export 97% of our production and are present in over 50 countries. Our overseas headquarters are located in England (Crawley, Sussex), Canada (Toronto), USA (NY), (Singapore), China (Shanghai ), Middle East (Dubai).

jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager 80 – 100%
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our team as a Territory Sales Manager and drive the growth of our High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers business across the Brazilian market. Leveraging your strong network and market knowledge, you will help expand our presence with transformer manufacturers, utilities, EPC companies, and industrial customers while representing products manufactured in our Swiss and Swedish factories.

This role offers the opportunity to combine your technical understanding of the power industry with your commercial expertise in one of the world's most dynamic energy markets. Working closely with customers and internal experts, you will contribute to strategic business development initiatives, identify new opportunities, and build long-term customer partnerships that support the energy transition.

The role is based in Altstetten, Zurich, Switzerland, and involves approximately 20–30% travel.

How you’ll make an impact

Develop and grow business opportunities for High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers across the Brazilian market
Build and strengthen relationships with transformer manufacturers, utilities, EPC contractors, and industrial customers
Identify market trends, customer needs, and emerging opportunities to support long-term business growth
Lead commercial discussions and support negotiations with key customers and stakeholders
Collaborate with Offer Engineering and Tendering teams to develop competitive technical and commercial solutions
Prepare and review proposals based on customer requirements and market expectations
Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and contribute to forecasting activities
Ensure smooth handover of secured orders to project management and execution teams

Your background

Minimum 10 years of experience in sales, business development, engineering, or a similar customer-facing role within the energy, electrical, transformer, or industrial sector
Strong knowledge of the Brazilian power and energy market, including utilities, transformer manufacturers, and key industry stakeholders
Proven track record of developing customer relationships and driving business growth in Brazil
Technical background in electrical or mechanical engineering or equivalent industry experience
Experience working in international and multicultural business environments
Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
Business fluent in English and Portuguese, Spanish is an asset
Self-driven, relationship-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with global teams

More about us 

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Accessibility and reasonable accommodation

You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.

This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.

Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment

As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.

Background Screening and Security Checks

As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.

For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.

The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

Tax Operations Associate  
Job Description  
The private markets tax team needs to expand its operational tax capabilities covering both technical and operational aspects. The position as Tax Operations Specialist includes the following activities:  
Provide support in respectof ongoing EU and U.S. tax mattersof private equity and real estate funds, including supporting the Investment Teams with tax due diligence processes and tax structuring, as well as supporting the Investor Teams with related tax provisions;  
Assist in the annual tax compliance process across multiple jurisdictions (including the United States of America, Luxembourg, France, Australia, Ireland, Switzerland), including the coordination and review of tax returns prepared by external advisors, and the arrangement of tax reporting to investors;  
Providesupport in FATCA and CRS ("AEOI") matters, including submission of annual AEOI reporting, form W\-8/W\-9 review;  
Establish and oversee operational tax procedures and controls;  
Assessment of changes in international and domestic taxation rules and their impact on the company;  
Management of ad hoc tax projects and processes.  
Requirements  
Strong academic background with Bachelor's degree \- ideally a Master'sin tax, finance or accounting;anL.L.M. or equivalent would be a strong plus;  
At least 5 years ofhands\-onexperience in international tax matters, gained at aBIG 4 or a reputable tax consulting company;  
Solid exposure to international tax matters, particularly in the context of fund structuring, asset management and the investment fund distributions, including investor tax reporting;  
Good analytical skills and ability to manage multiple and diverse priorities;  
High level of proficiency withMicrosoft office, specifically in Excel;  
A proactive, solution\-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and attention to detail;  
A true team player, self\-motivated with the ability to work independently;  
Fluency inEnglish is required;  
Good communication skills, assertive, confident and trustworthy.  
What you can expect  
We provide modern working conditions, including work\-from\-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;  
A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;  
We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills;  
We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;  
Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family's long\-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;  
You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners' investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.  
Contact Information  
If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.  
For further information please contact us.

c. Prowadzenie spraw związanych z zapewnieniem utrzymania czystości i porządku na terenie Gminy.
d. Prowadzenie spraw związanych z funkcjonowaniem i utrzymaniem zdrojów ulicznych.
e. Prowadzenie spraw dotyczących remontów oraz utrzymania czystości i porządku wiat przystanków komunikacyjnych.
f. Prowadzenie spraw związanych z funkcjonowaniem monitoringu miejskiego.
g. Zapewnienie ogłaszania w Biuletynie Informacji Publicznej taryf na zbiorowe zaopatrzenie
w wodę i zbiorowe odprowadzanie ścieków zatwierdzonych przez organ regulacyjny.
h. Prowadzenie spraw związanych z informowaniem mieszkańców o jakości wody przeznaczonej do spożycia przez ludzi.
i. Prowadzenie spraw związanych z uchwalaniem i zmianą regulaminu dostarczania wody
i odprowadzania ścieków oraz przygotowywanie projektów aktów dotyczących ograniczeń poboru wody na cele inne niż spożycie, zgodnie z obowiązującymi przepisami.
j. Współpraca z MPWiK i PEC w zakresie zadań wykonywanych przez te spółki, związanych
z powierzonym zakresem spraw.
k. Współpraca z gminnymi przedszkolami, szkołami i żłobkiem w zakresie zadań remontowych
służących utrzymaniu obiektów w należytym stanie technicznym.
l. Współpraca z niepublicznymi placówkami oświatowymi mającymi siedziby w budynkach gminnychw zakresie remontów tych obiektów.
m. Nadzór nad funkcjonowaniem siłowni zewnętrznych i placów zabaw, w tym obiektów zrealizowanych z dofinansowaniem zewnętrznym, oraz prowadzenie spraw związanych z zapewnieniem trwałości tych projektów.
n. Wykonywanie innych czynności służbowych zleconych przez przełożonych, związanych
z pracą na stanowisku

* Degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent technical discipline

* Solid understanding of requirements development, traceability, verification and validation processes
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience leading complex engineering projects and working with global suppliers; fluent English is essential, is an advantage
* Highly organized, proactive and collaborative with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment

jobs.title: JOULUMYYJIÄ, Turku Hansa ja Skanssi, Raisio (keskimäärin 5-20 t/vko)
jobs.description:
Rakastatko joulun tunnelmaa, asiakaskohtaamisia ja vauhdikasta myymälätyötä? Haluatko olla mukana luomassa asiakkaillemme onnistunutta joulua ja tehdä jokaisesta kohtaamisesta merkityksellisen?

Haemme määräaikaisia myyjiä joulusesonkiin Turku Hansa ja Skanssi, Raisio -myyntitiimiimme. Työsuhteet alkavat 9.11.2026 ja päättyvät viimeistään 31.12.2026. Etsimämme henkilöt työskentelevät 5–20 tunnin viikkotyösopimuksilla. Työmäärä painottuu erityisesti joulunalusviikoille, jolloin vuoroja on enemmän kuin työsuhteen alussa.

Lisäksi etsimme myyjiä tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttaviin vuoroihin. Tarjolla on joustava ja sinun ehdoillasi tehtävä työ, jossa vuoroja voi tulla tarjolle lyhyelläkin varoajalla.

Sesongin aikaan myymälöissä riittää iloa, energiaa ja tekemisen meininkiä. Etsimme joukkoomme sinua, joka nautit vauhdikkaasta työstä, tartut toimeen oma-aloitteisesti ja haluat luoda asiakkaalle onnistuneen ostokokemuksen jokaisessa kohtaamisessa. Palvelukonseptimme perustuu asiakkaan henkilökohtaiseen huomiointiin sekä Suomen Parhaan Asiakaskohtaamisen mukaiseen myyntityöhön. Meille jokainen asiakas on tärkeä ja jokainen kohtaaminen mahdollisuus onnistua. Suomalaisen Kirjakaupan myyjänä tehtäviisi kuuluu aktiivisten asiakaskohtaamisten lisäksi myymälän ilmeestä huolehtiminen sekä muut päivittäiset myymäläaskareet.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja kiinnostavan myyntityön, jossa saat olla rohkeasti oma itsesi osana innostavaa työyhteisöä. Kuulumme suomalaiseen Otava-konserniin, ja arjessamme näkyvät vahvasti arvomme vastuullisuus, laatu, rohkeus ja läheisyys.

Palkkaus on kaupan TES:n vaativuusluokan B mukaan
- 13,13 €/t–14,96 €/t riippuen kokemusvuosistasi - Iltalisä klo 18 jälkeen: 4,00 €/t - Lauantailisä klo 13 jälkeen: 5,27 €/t - Sunnuntaityöstä maksamme tuplapalkan
Toivomme sinulta
- iloista ja aktiivista asiakaspalveluasennetta sekä halua onnistua myynnissä - aikaisempaa kokemusta myymälä- ja kassatyöskentelystä - sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Englannin kielitaito on eduksi - valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa vuoroissa myymälän aukiolojen mukaisesti - halua tarttua uusiin tehtäviin avoimin mielin ja kohdata asiakkaita parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla joulusesongin säpinässä
Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian hakulinkin kautta, kuitenkin viimeistään 15.10.2026. Kerro, mikä innostaa sinua juuri tässä tehtävässä ja millaista osaamista, kokemusta tai energiaa tuot mukanasi tiimiimme. Hakemusten suuren määrän vuoksi videotervehdys on erinomainen tapa erottua ja tuoda persoonasi esiin.

Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja etenemme rekrytoinnissa sopivien hakijoiden löytyessä. Toimi siis mahdollisimman pian!

jobs.title: Keikkaileva kurottajakuski
jobs.description:
Rakennusalan asiakasyrityksemme hakee joukkoihinsa **Helsinkiin** **kurottajakuskeja** keikkatyöhön eri työkohteille! Työkohteet vaihtuvat asiakkaiden tarpeiden mukaan.

Työtä on tarjolla kokoaikaisesti niin, että olet työsuhteessa meidän kautta ensimmäiset 6kk, minkä jälkeen sinulla on mahdollisuus rekrytoitua suoraan asiakkaalle.
