jobs.title: Projektikoordinaattori Kittilään
jobs.description:
Rovalan Setlementti ry hakee kahta projektikoordinaattoria **Kotona Kittilässä -hankkeeseen**. Hanke toteutetaan ajalla 1.10.2026–30.9.2029 ja projektikoordinaattoreiden toimipaikka sijaitsee Kittilässä.

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan sujuvampia polkuja työelämään ja hyvään arkeen Kittilässä!**

**Haemme Kotona Kittilässä -hankkeeseen hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot omaavaa, aktiivista ja kehittämismyönteistä henkilöä, jolla ei työkinttaat tipahda hevin.**

Kotona Kittilässä -hankkeen tavoitteena on edistää alueelle muuttaneiden työllistymistä, kotoutumista ja Kittilään kiinnittymistä sekä vahvistaa alueen työvoiman saatavuutta ja pitovoimaa. Hankkeessa tuetaan osallistujien osaamista, suomen kielen taitoa ja työelämävalmiuksia sekä autetaan heitä löytämään omia polkujaan koulutukseen, työelämään ja osaksi paikallista yhteisöä.

Hankkeessa toteutetaan yksilö- ja ryhmäohjausta, suomen kielen ja työelämätaitojen koulutusta sekä monipaikkaista kohtaamispaikkatoimintaa. Lisäksi kehitetään Kittilä-Infoa, joka kokoaa yhteen alueelle muuttamista, asumista, työelämää, palveluita, vapaa-aikaa ja suomen kielen opiskelua tukevaa tietoa.

Keskeinen osa hanketta on tiivis yhteistyö alueen yritysten ja muiden työelämätoimijoiden kanssa. Hankkeessa tuetaan yritysten henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä, perehdyttämistä ja monikulttuuristen työyhteisöjen toimivuutta sekä kehitetään työpaikalla oppimisen käytäntöjä. Yhdessä Kittilän kunnan, yritysten, järjestöjen ja muiden yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa rakennetaan toimivia palvelupolkuja ja toimintamalleja, jotka voivat jatkua myös hankkeen päättymisen jälkeen.

Hankkeessa pääset tekemään käytännönläheistä ja monipuolista kehittämistyötä ihmisten, työelämän ja laajan paikallisen verkoston kanssa.

**Projektikoordinaattori 1**

Projektikoordinaattori 1 vastaa erityisesti hankkeen osallistujalähtöisen toiminnan koordinoinnista ja toteutuksesta. Tehtäviin kuuluvat osallistujien yksilöohjaus, osaamis-, koulutus- ja työllistymistarpeiden kartoittaminen sekä työllistymis-, koulutus- ja palvelupolkujen tukeminen. Hän suunnittelee ja toteuttaa ryhmä- ja kohtaamispaikkatoimintaa sekä osallistuu osallistujien osaamista, kotoutumista, osallisuutta ja työelämävalmiuksia vahvistavaan toimintaan.

Projektikoordinaattori osallistuu Kittilä-Infon, koulutusten, työpaikalla oppimisen mallien ja muiden hankkeen toimintamallien suunnitteluun ja pilotointiin. Hän tekee yhteistyötä yritysten, kunnan, järjestöjen ja muiden alueen toimijoiden kanssa sekä tukee osallistujien verkostoitumista ja alueelle kiinnittymistä. Lisäksi hän seuraa osallistujien etenemistä, kerää palaute- ja arviointitietoa sekä osallistuu toimintamallien dokumentointiin, raportointiin ja juurruttamiseen.

**Projektikoordinaattori 2**

Projektikoordinaattori 2 vastaa erityisesti hankkeen yritys- ja verkostoyhteistyön koordinoinnista sekä työllistymistä ja työvoiman saatavuutta tukevien toimintojen toteuttamisesta. Hän tekee osallistujien yksilöohjausta, tukee työnhakua ja työelämään siirtymistä sekä edistää osallistujien ja työnantajien kohtaamista.

Projektikoordinaattori rakentaa ja ylläpitää yhteistyötä yritysten, kunnan, järjestöjen ja muiden alueen toimijoiden kanssa sekä järjestää työnantajavierailuja, rekrytointi- ja verkostoitumistilaisuuksia, työpajoja ja muita yhteistyötapahtumia. Hän kartoittaa yritysten työvoima- ja osaamistarpeita sekä osallistuu Kittilä-Infon, henkilöstökoulutusten, työpaikalla oppimisen mallien ja perehdytyskäytäntöjen kehittämiseen. Lisäksi hän osallistuu kohtaamispaikkatoimintaan, yhteiskehittämiseen sekä hankkeen toimintamallien dokumentointiin, arviointiin, raportointiin ja juurruttamiseen.

Tehtävä edellyttää soveltuvaa vähintään ammattikorkeakoulutasoista tutkintoa (sosionomi tai vastaava tutkinto) tai muuta tehtävään soveltuvaa tutkintoa.

Hakijalle katsomme eduksi

- alueen toimintaympäristön ja työelämän tuntemuksen

- kokemusta hanke- ja kehittämistyöstä sekä verkostotyöstä

- kokemuksen monipuolisesta ohjaustyöstä ja monikulttuurisessa ympäristössä toimimisesta

- kokemuksen ryhmien, tapahtumien, työpajojen tai verkostotilaisuuksien suunnittelusta ja toteuttamisesta

- hyvät digitaidot ja kokemuksen monikanavaisesta viestinnästä

- englannin kielen taidon ja muun kielitaidon.


Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja, organisointitaitoja, vastuullisuutta, hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja, palvelulähtöistä työskentelyotetta, sosiaalisen median osaamista, kykyä työskennellä moniammatillisessa verkostossa sekä joustavuutta ja kehittämismyönteistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen tehtävän, yhteisöllisen ja innostavan työympäristön, viihtyisät toiminnalliset puitteet, hyvät henkilökuntaedut sekä tiimin tuen omalle työlle.

Palkkauksessa ja työehdoissa noudatetaan Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Työ alkaa 1.11.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

Toimi täytetään kuuden (6) kuukauden koeajalla. Työsuhde on määräaikainen hankkeen keston ajan. Työ sisältää matkustamista, ilta- ja jonkin verran myös viikonlopputyötä.

jobs.title: Coordonnateur-trice de clientèle BtoB/Customer succes (H/F)
jobs.description:
Audencia est une prestigieuse école de management basée en France (Paris, Nantes et La Roche-sur-Yon) et à l'International (Chine, Brésil, Australie, Espagne), dont l'objectif est de former des femmes et des hommes capables d'influencer et d'accompagner la société dans toutes ses transitions : économique, écologique, politique, médiatique, culturelle, sociale et technologique. C'est également une entreprise en pleine croissance qui emploie plus de 580 collaborateurs et qui offre un environnement de travail épanouissant et respectueux des équilibres de vie. Vous souhaitez participer à cette aventure, rejoignez-nous !

Nous recrutons un.e Coordinateur-trice Customer Success H/F en CDI pour notre Campus de Saint-Ouen pour un démarrage au 1er octobre 2026.
Au sein de la Direction Offres et Solutions Entreprises, vous êtes le/la garant-e de la qualité de l'expérience délivrée aux entreprises clientes et partenaires après la signature du contrat. Véritable chef d'orchestre des prestations BtoB, vous coordonnez leur mise en œuvre, assurez le suivi opérationnel, veillez au respect des engagements et contribuez activement à la satisfaction et à la fidélisation des clients. En lien étroit avec les équipes commerciales, pédagogiques et les différents services supports, vous garantissez une expérience fluide, personnalisée et de qualité sur l'ensemble des prestations BtoB proposées par la Direction (formation continue, conseil, études, chaires, événements, forums entreprises.). Vous êtes également le/la référent-e événementiel-le de la Direction sur le campus parisien.

Vos missions :
1. Coordination des prestations & produits BtoB
Prise en charge de la relation client après la vente (prestations de service, conseil, études, forums, chaires de recherches etc.)
Organisation des réunions de lancement et coordination des parties prenantes
Organisation, Plannification et suivi de la bonne exécution des prestations ; veille aux délais et à la qualité afin de favoriser l'excellence opérationnelle
Interface principale entre le/la client-e et Audencia pendant toute la durée de la collaboration, réponses aux demandes & accompagnement, gestion des imprévus
Réalisation de bilans de satisfaction et identification de leviers de fidélisation

2. Coordination des programmes de formation continue BtoB
Point de contact privilégié des apprenant-es tout au long de leur parcours & des clients/donneurs d'ordres
Coordination avec les équipes pédagogiques, techniques et services supports
Recueil régulier des feedbacks, détection des signaux faibles (motivation, décrochage) et mise en place de solutions correctives
Planification des programmes et gestion des interventions internes et externes, organisation de Kick-off & des rentrées en lien avec le client/donneur d'ordre
Préparation des éléments de paie pour les contrats intervenants / Contrôle conformité pour mise en paiement
Réservation des salles, organisation des pauses et déjeuners, envoi des convocations et saisie de notes
Suivi de l'assiduité, proposition de sessions de rattrapage
Collecte des documents pour audits et classements, Préparation des Audits qualité (Qualiopi)Analyse des indicateurs de satisfaction et mise en œuvre d'actions correctives
Organisation des fins de formation : organisation de remises de diplômes, édition des bulletins/ certificats, bilan/rex avec les apprenants et/ou le client/donneur d'ordre

3.Référent-e événementiel-le de la Direction Offre et Services aux entreprises
En binôme avec la Chargée de mission Événements basée à Nantes, vous contribuez à l'organisation des temps forts et événements de votre Direction sur le campus de Saint-Ouen (Forum entreprises, Job Datings, Cafés entreprises, etc.).

Conditions de travail : CDI, 35h hebdomadaires à pourvoir à partir du 1er octobre 2026
Rémunération : 33000€-35000€ Brut sur 13 mois selon profil et expérience

jobs.title: CHEF D'EQUIPE  H/F
jobs.description:

Le site Moulinage Vernède est un acteur de référence du moulinage de soie à façon. Depuis plus de 170 ans, l'entreprise met son expertise au service du retordage et de l'assemblage des fils de soie, une étape essentielle qui contribue directement à la qualité, à l'aspect et aux performances des matières et produits finis d'HTH.
Objet de la mission
Pilotage et responsabilité hiérarchique d'une équipe alternante de production autour de 4 enjeux :
Management de proximité
Accompagner son équipe (Être à l'écoute, expliquer, transmettre et recadrer si nécessaire)
Etablir une relation sincère, juste et authentique avec son équipe, ses pairs et sa hiérarchie
Veiller à une bonne répartition de la charge de travail de son équipe
Veiller au développement des compétences de son équipe
Réaliser les entretiens annuels et les entretiens de développement, proposer des mesures d'augmentations individuelles et éventuellement des évolutions

Relayer les communications internes

Animer au quotidien son équipe en organisant des points réguliers individuels et/ou collectifs

Production

Partager et commenter le planning à l'équipe en indiquant les urgences à traiter
S'assurer et veiller au quotidien au respect du planning par son équipe

Réaliser des retours d'expérience avec son équipe à la suite de réclamations client ou anomalies de production dans un but d'amélioration de la qualité et de la productivité
Être force de proposition sur l'amélioration des process

Participer, si besoin, à la production

Proposer des actions d'amélioration HSE et les mettre en œuvre

COMPETENCES TECHNIQUES

Habilitation éventuelle Conduite chariot
Conduite autoclave
Technique : connaissance des procédés de production du site (à minima 2 métiers du moulinage) et des machines associées. Connaissance des matières (soie, viscose). Notions de maintenance
QUALITES PERSONNELLES
Rigueur, sens de l'organisation et capacité à prioriser
Aisance relationnelle et capacité à travailler en équipe
Souci de la qualité et du respect des normes.
Force de proposition
Connaissance et adhésion aux valeurs de la Maison
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement/industrialisation, qualité, RH et maintenance

jobs.title: (Senior) People Operations Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
bonial hilft Dir dabei Zeit, Geld und Papier zu sparen. Wir sind ein digitaler Werbepartner für das Offline-Business. Wir unterstützen Händler:innen in deren Marketing-Aktivitäten und helfen dabei, neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen.

Würdest Du gern dazugehören und Teil des digitalen Wandels im Handel sein?

bonial ist Teil der Axel Springer SE und revolutioniert den Einzelhandel als führender "Drive to Store"-Partner in Deutschland und Frankreich. Über unsere Plattformen "kaufDA" und "MeinProspekt" in Deutschland sowie “Bonial“ in Frankreich verbinden wir täglich Millionen von Nutzer:innen mit ihren Lieblingsgeschäften und -marken – und schaffen dabei echten Mehrwert.

Wir befinden uns in einer spannenden Wachstumsphase, skalieren rasant und verändern die Art und Weise, wie Menschen den Einzelhandel entdecken. Bei bonial arbeiten wir in einem leistungsstarken, dynamischen Umfeld, das von motivierten, ergebnisorientierten Menschen geprägt ist, die mit Leidenschaft etwas bewegen wollen.

Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams sein möchtest, das die Zukunft des Einzelhandels gestaltet, freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Bei bonial sorgt unser People Operations Team dafür, dass sich Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während der gesamten Employee Journey auf reibungslose und mitarbeiterorientierte Prozesse verlassen können. Dabei verbinden wir operatives Anpacken mit dem Anspruch, unsere Zusammenarbeit und unsere Abläufe kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aktuell wechseln wir von Personio zu SAP HCM – ein wichtiger Schritt für unser Team und für die Art, wie wir unsere People-Prozesse gestalten. Hier kommst Du ins Spiel: Als unser:e (Mid–Senior) People Operations Manager:in übernimmst Du die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich, begleitest die Einführung von SAP HCM und hilfst uns, den Übergang für das gesamte Team so reibungslos wie möglich zu gestalten. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unseren People Business Partner:innen, Payroll sowie weiteren internen und externen Stakeholder:innen zusammen.

Die Position ist ab dem Startdatum zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für alle People Operations Themen in Deinem festen Betreuungsbereich und bist eine verlässliche Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte.

  • Du steuerst unsere zentralen administrativen Prozesse entlang der Employee Journey – von Verträgen und Bescheinigungen über das Abwesenheitsmanagement bis hin zu Visa-Prozessen gemeinsam mit unserer externen Agentur.

  • Du verantwortest die Vorbereitung unserer monatlichen Gehaltsabrechnung und arbeitest eng mit unserem externen Payroll-Dienstleister zusammen, damit die Abrechnung korrekt und pünktlich erfolgt.

  • Du spielst eine aktive Rolle bei unserem Wechsel zu SAP HCM und unterstützt aus People-Operations-Perspektive bei Datenqualität, Prozessgestaltung, Tests und Dokumentation.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass neue Prozesse im Arbeitsalltag ankommen: Du teilst Wissen, unterstützt das Team und stellst einen reibungslosen Übergang sicher, ohne das Tagesgeschäft aus dem Blick zu verlieren.

  • Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, erkennst Möglichkeiten zur Vereinfachung und setzt deine Ideen in pragmatische und nachhaltige Lösungen um.

  • Du behältst Änderungen im Arbeitsrecht und Best Practices im People-Operations-Bereich im Blick und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen für bonial ab.

  • Als Teil des Teams unterstützt Du regelmäßig unsere Bürotage und Vor-Ort-Termine, zum Beispiel Onboardings und Unterschriftentermine.



Dein Profil:

  • Du bringst umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in People Operations, HR-Administration oder einer vergleichbaren generalistischen HR-Rolle mit.

  • Du verstehst, was gute Datenqualität, verlässliche Prozesse und ein reibungsloses Tagesgeschäft brauchen – und wie diese Themen zusammenspielen.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Struktur und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch in deine Themen.

  • Du bist hands-on, lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, Veränderungen gemeinsam mit dem Team zu gestalten.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholder:innen und bleibst auch bei komplexen Themen ruhig und konstruktiv.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (min. C1) und gute Englischkenntnisse (min. B2), sodass Du auch in unserem internationalen Umfeld sicher zusammenarbeiten kannst.

  • Du verfügst über fundierte und aktuelle Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht sowie praktische Erfahrung in der vorbereitenden Gehaltsabrechnung.

  • Idealerweise hast du bereits eine HR-Systemeinführung, eine Prozessmigration oder ein vergleichbares Transformationsprojekt begleitet. Erfahrung mit SAP HCM ist ein großes Plus.

Was wir Dir bieten können:

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt.

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Diversität - Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitsplatz für Chancengleichheit zu sein, an dem wir es jeder Person ermöglichen möchten, ihr wahres selbst zu zeigen. Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Wohlbefinden - Für uns ist mentale Gesundheit genauso wichtig wie Fitness. Deshalb bieten wir Dir einen kostenlosen Zugang zu nilo.health, einer App für mentale Gesundheit, an. Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Nachhaltigkeit - Dir liegt das Thema Nachhaltigkeit am Herzen? Uns auch! Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Gemeinsam wollen wir unseren Beitrag leisten und den Planeten so positiv beeinflussen, wie wir nur können.

Flexibilität – Aktuell haben wir eine Regelung, die wöchentlich bis zu 20% mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ermöglicht. Dazu darfst Du 30 Tage pro Jahr aus dem Ausland arbeiten. Zusätzlich bieten wir 28 Urlaubstage. Pro Kalenderjahr kommen ein weiterer Urlaubstag hinzu (bis zu maximal 30 Tage) sowie zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe (z. B. Umzug, Mitarbeit an einem sozialen Projekt etc.).*

Modernes Büro - Wir haben ein eigenes und voll ausgestattetes Fitnessstudio, eine Dachterrasse für Team Events und Mittagspausen in der Sonne, sowie Zen Rooms, in denen Mitarbeitende beten, entspannen oder einfach eine ruhige Minute finden können.

Kostenloses Mittagessen - Wenn Du im Büro bist, bieten wir Dir verschiedene Optionen für ein Mittagessen an, und das Mittagessen geht auf uns! Du kannst in dem nahliegenden Partner-Restaurant essen gehen! Natürlich sind auch heiße sowie kalte Getränke, Obst und andere Snacks im Büro für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen kostenlos.*

Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen.

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“

Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den Axel Springer Essentials. 

Hört sich das gut an für Dich? Wir freuen uns von Dir zu hören!

Besuche uns gerne auch auf unserer bonial_people Instagram Seite oder erfahre mehr über unsere bonial-Kultur unter bonial Medium.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
jobs.description:

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse



Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

Wunsch

jobs.title: Sales Support & Account Operations Specialist (Arabic, French and English)
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a dedicated Cloudflare service and delivery partner operating across the Middle East, North Africa and Europe.

We specialise in Cloudflare licensing, support plans, professional services and managed offerings, working closely with clients, distributors and Cloudflare teams to support effective delivery and long-term customer success.

As we continue to expand our Cloudflare business across the MENAT region, we are looking for a Sales Support & Account Operations Specialist to strengthen our commercial operations and support the execution of our growing sales pipeline.

The Role

This is a hands-on commercial operations role supporting the day-to-day execution of the sales cycle.

Working closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, partners and distributors, you will help ensure that opportunities move efficiently from initial engagement through quoting, coordination, follow-up and renewal.

You will be responsible for keeping commercial activity organised and moving forward — from preparing quotes and maintaining CRM data to tracking renewals, coordinating partners and supporting client interactions.

The role would suit someone who is highly organised, responsive and comfortable working across multiple stakeholders and opportunities in a fast-moving B2B technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Support & Coordination

  • Prepare and manage draft quotations for Cloudflare licensing, professional services, and support or managed service plans.
  • Work closely with Sales Engineers to translate technical scoping into quote-ready commercial documentation.
  • Coordinate with Cloudflare distributors, including Mindware, on pricing, approvals and quote submissions.
  • Support Account Executives with deal preparation, client coordination and sales follow-up.
  • Schedule and coordinate client demos, onboarding sessions and internal handovers.
  • Support the preparation and distribution of Cloudflare marketing materials and commercial documentation.
  • Track indirect opportunities involving partners and distributors.

Sales & Account Operations

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity and account information within Zoho CRM.
  • Track renewals and coordinate timely preparation and follow-up.
  • Maintain structured weekly sales reporting covering pipeline activity, renewals and deals in progress.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for client requirements when Account Executives are unavailable.
  • Gather and organise relevant client information ahead of Account Executive or Sales Engineer involvement.
  • Escalate commercial or operational issues to the appropriate sales, technical or partner teams.
  • Ensure quoting and sales activities follow internal processes and approval workflows.

Key Stakeholders

You will work closely with:

  • Account Executives on opportunities, client interactions and deal execution.
  • Sales Engineers on technical scoping and professional services requirements.
  • Cloudflare partners and distributors on pricing, approvals and commercial coordination.
  • Sales leadership and delivery operations on pipeline visibility, handovers and execution.

The role reports to the Sales Director.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 2–4 years of experience in Sales Support, Sales Operations, Commercial Coordination or a similar role, ideally within a B2B technology, SaaS, cybersecurity or IT environment.
  • Experience preparing and coordinating quotes, renewals and commercial documentation.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining CRM data and sales pipelines.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience coordinating across sales, technical, partner and/or client-facing teams.
  • Fluent Arabic, French and English, both written and spoken.
  • Comfortable working with CRM platforms such as Zoho, Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, particularly Excel, Outlook and Word.
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail.
  • A structured, proactive and ownership-driven approach to work.
  • Ability to work full-time in alignment with Gulf Standard Time.

Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

  • Cloudflare, cybersecurity, cloud or network infrastructure solutions.
  • A technology vendor, reseller, system integrator or distributor environment.
  • Working with Cloudflare partners or distributors such as Mindware.
  • Professional Services quoting and support-plan packaging.
  • Supporting Account Executives and Sales Engineers within a B2B technology sales cycle.
  • Managing renewal calendars, partner coordination and indirect sales opportunities.

Working Hours: Alignment with Gulf Standard Time (UAE) required

Benefits

What BRIXIO Offers

  • A fully remote role with exposure across the MENAT region.
  • The opportunity to work within a growing Cloudflare-focused business.
  • Direct collaboration with commercial, technical and delivery teams.
  • Exposure to regional clients, partners and distributors.
  • Career development opportunities across Sales Operations, Partner Enablement and Regional Coordination.
  • A competitive local compensation package.

jobs.title: Professional Services Engineer - Cloudflare Implementation
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

As a Professional Services Engineer, you will design, build and implement Cloudflare environments for BRIXIO's French-speaking enterprise and public-sector clients and help take them successfully into production.

This is a hands-on implementation role covering onboarding, migration from existing CDN and WAF platforms, WAF and DDoS deployment, Zero Trust rollout, DNS cutovers, SASE and production hardening.

You will work within properly planned and governed client projects. The Delivery Manager owns the project plan and delivery governance, while the Principal Architect provides technical authority and owns the overall design.

Your responsibility is the build, validation and client-facing technical implementation.

The client portfolio includes French banks, industrial groups, public bodies and media organisations. You will regularly work directly with their technical teams in French, explaining what you are implementing, why particular decisions have been made and how production changes will be managed.

This is not a back-office engineering role.

We are hiring at two levels:

  • Senior Engineer: capable of owning a Cloudflare migration end to end and independently leading technical conversations with clients.
  • Mid-Level Engineer: strong network/security fundamentals and implementation experience, with the opportunity to deepen Cloudflare expertise through structured training and certification.

What You Will Do

Cloudflare Implementation & Migration

  • Configure and deploy Cloudflare environments across DNS, CDN and caching, WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, load balancing, Bot Management, Zero Trust and Access, tunnels and SASE components.
  • Deliver migrations from incumbent platforms, particularly Akamai and other CDN/WAF providers.
  • Handle rule translation, traffic cutover planning, staged deployment and rollback design.
  • Plan and execute production DNS cutovers, ensuring a validated rollback is available at every stage.
  • Build and deliver pilots and proofs of concept, from individual applications through to full production rollouts.
  • Test, validate and tune deployed environments, including cache-hit ratio, latency, WAF false positives and other client-relevant performance characteristics.

Client-Facing Technical Delivery

  • Lead technical working sessions with client teams in French, including workshops, configuration reviews, cutover rehearsals and go-live calls.
  • Explain technical decisions, risks and implementation considerations clearly to both engineers and management stakeholders.
  • Produce client-facing technical documentation in French and English, including configuration records, runbooks, cutover plans and project-closure documentation.
  • Identify and raise technical or delivery risks as soon as they become visible rather than allowing them to surface late in the project.

Working Within the Delivery Model

  • Work according to the project plan established by the Delivery Manager.
  • Provide clear and accurate progress updates and flag potential delays or blockers early.
  • Escalate architecture and design questions to the Principal Architect rather than making unapproved architectural changes during delivery.
  • Maintain accurate project timesheets and record effort against the appropriate projects.
  • Identify and communicate potential out-of-scope client requests to the Delivery Manager.
  • Deliver a structured handover into managed services at project closure, including complete documentation, runbooks and known risks, allowing the support team to operate the environment effectively from day one.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Work with implementation engineers in Dubai and Poland, managed services teams in Morocco and the Philippines, and pre-sales and architecture teams in France.
  • Use Zoho Projects and BrixioOne as the source of truth for project tasks, documentation and reporting.
  • Contribute to BRIXIO's internal knowledge base and reusable implementation patterns and playbooks.
  • Support managed services teams with escalations requiring deeper implementation expertise.
  • Share technical knowledge across the wider delivery organisation.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Foundation

You should have a strong practical understanding of:

  • DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS and certificates
  • Proxies and reverse proxies
  • Caching and CDN mechanics
  • Web application architecture
  • Origin infrastructure
  • Cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure or GCP

You should be able to clearly explain what happens between a browser and an origin infrastructure and confidently troubleshoot problems across that path.

You will also need a solid grounding in web application security, including:

  • WAF concepts
  • OWASP Top 10
  • Bot mitigation
  • DDoS attack patterns
  • Rate limiting

You should be comfortable using technical troubleshooting tools including:

  • curl
  • dig
  • traceroute
  • Browser developer tools
  • Packet capture tools where required

You should also have scripting and automation capability using technologies such as Python, Bash or Terraform, together with experience working with REST APIs.

Experience with Cloudflare Workers is a strong advantage.

Cloudflare Experience

For the Senior position, hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience is required.

For the Mid-Level position, Cloudflare experience is a strong advantage but is not mandatory where you bring strong experience with comparable CDN, WAF or Zero Trust technologies.

Candidates coming from platforms such as Akamai or other relevant CDN/security technologies can be considered where the underlying technical foundation is strong.

BRIXIO provides access to Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification to support continued development.

Delivery Experience

Senior Engineer

  • 5+ years of experience implementing network, security or cloud infrastructure for external clients.
  • Demonstrated experience owning technical delivery within client-facing projects.
  • Hands-on Cloudflare implementation experience.
  • Ability to independently lead technical client discussions and implementation activities.

Mid-Level Engineer

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in network, security or cloud environments.
  • Alternatively, strong technical support or NOC experience combined with genuine implementation exposure.
  • Strong technical fundamentals and the ability to develop deeper Cloudflare expertise.

For Both Levels

  • Experience working within a professional services, consultancy, MSP or systems integrator environment with committed project timelines.
  • Experience with production cutovers or migrations under formal change control is a significant advantage.
  • Confidence working directly with external clients.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

French is the primary working language for this portfolio. You will conduct technical workshops, participate in cutover and go-live calls, and prepare client-facing technical documentation in French.

English is required for collaboration with BRIXIO's international teams and work involving Gulf and Asian accounts.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Working Pattern

The role operates primarily during Central European working hours.

Some client migrations and production go-lives will require planned out-of-hours presence. These windows will be agreed in advance and compensated.

The position is remote from Morocco, with collaboration through the Equans IT Hub in Casablanca and occasional travel to client sites in France and elsewhere in Europe.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Rigorous and methodical when working with production environments.
  • Disciplined about documenting configurations and changes as work progresses.
  • Comfortable working directly with clients, including when communicating technical risks or problems.
  • Honest about the limits of their knowledge and willing to involve the Principal Architect when appropriate.
  • Able to distinguish between genuine technical blockers and issues that simply require additional implementation time.
  • Comfortable working remotely within an international team spanning Morocco, France, the Gulf, Poland and the Philippines.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Cloudflare environments go live according to plan and perform in production as expected from testing.
  • Migrations are completed without unplanned downtime and with validated rollback procedures in place.
  • Clients develop confidence in your technical judgement and delivery.
  • Technical documentation is complete enough for managed services teams to operate environments without unnecessary dependency on the implementation engineer.
  • Project effort is recorded accurately, allowing delivery performance and invoicing to be managed correctly.
  • Knowledge gained during implementations becomes reusable across future BRIXIO projects.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working directly with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, with the stability, scale and internal mobility of a major international organisation.
  • Develop genuine Cloudflare expertise through Cloudflare University, partner-only training and funded certification.
  • Work alongside a team that includes members of Cloudflare's Partner Technical Advisory Council.
  • Deliver substantial European enterprise and public-sector implementations through properly governed projects rather than ad hoc technical changes.
  • Develop towards Senior Professional Services Engineering, Solution Architecture or broader opportunities within the Equans delivery organisation.

jobs.title: MSP Engineer, Network and Security - Rotating shifts
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Core Services and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with offices in Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

BRIXIO is building a genuine managed services capability — not simply a ticket queue.

As an MSP Engineer, you will operate client Cloudflare environments during your shift, combining reactive incident management with structured, proactive engineering.

You will detect and investigate issues before clients report them, resolve incidents within committed service levels, execute production changes under controlled processes, and carry out proactive activities designed to improve security, performance and service stability over time.

Managed services and support are delivered by the same team. This means your role spans both incident response and scheduled proactive work, with proactive engineering time protected within the rota rather than fitted around ticket volume.

You will be the technical responder on shift, but you will not carry an account alone. Client relationship management and reporting are owned by the Delivery Manager, while technical arbitration sits with the MSP & Support Lead.

There is no expectation to be reachable outside your scheduled shift.

Working Pattern

BRIXIO operates a follow-the-sun model across its teams in Morocco and the Philippines, designed around client demand and defined service coverage windows.

Early Shift

09:00–17:00 Morocco time

Provides full coverage during the core client peak window and is named on relevant client contracts.

Late Shift

15:00–23:00 Morocco time

Extends coverage across the peak window and includes an overlap and structured handover with the Early Shift.

Weekend Rotation

Weekend coverage is shared across the team on a reduced rotation. Sunday forms part of the service window for Gulf clients.

Shifts are managed through a published rota issued in advance, so you will know your schedule ahead of time.

Each shift change includes a 30-minute overlap and written handover, ensuring that engineers do not inherit undocumented situations.

Under the current operating model, Gulf night coverage is provided by colleagues in the Philippines within their normal working day. Shift patterns may evolve as the team and client base grow, with any changes discussed with the team in advance.

Weekend rotation is compensated in accordance with Moroccan law and Equans policy.

What You Will Do

Service Operations

  • Staff the client intake channel during your shift, qualify and triage incoming requests, and own first response within committed service levels.
  • Diagnose and resolve incidents across the Cloudflare stack, including WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and caching, DNS, TLS, load balancing, Zero Trust and Workers.
  • Qualify monitoring alerts, act on them using documented runbooks and create tickets where required.
  • Escalate appropriately and early to senior engineers, the MSP & Support Lead and Cloudflare Support in accordance with the escalation matrix.
  • Maintain accurate ticket records in Jira, including detection source, priority and timestamps, supporting accurate service-level reporting.

Change Execution

  • Execute production configuration changes under formal change control, including four-eyes validation and a documented rollback plan before deployment.
  • Provide named technical coverage during declared client go-live windows, including pre-go-live validation and active monitoring following cutover.
  • Maintain Cloudflare configuration as code using Terraform and version control.
  • Investigate and resolve configuration drift identified through automated nightly comparisons.
  • Ensure production changes are properly documented and traceable.

Proactive Engineering

  • Deliver scheduled proactive activities including configuration and security-posture audits, false-positive analysis, cache and rate-limit calibration, DNS and certificate hygiene, and unused-rule cleanup.
  • Analyse traffic and security telemetry using Cloudflare Analytics, GraphQL API and log data to identify potential problems before they affect clients.
  • Recommend and implement security and performance improvements and demonstrate their impact.
  • Contribute to root-cause analysis following major incidents.
  • Identify recurring causes and raise them through the problem-management process so they can be eliminated rather than repeatedly resolved.

Collaboration & Knowledge

  • Work closely with client NOC and security teams, including participation in operational channels and major incident bridges where BRIXIO is integrated with the client's teams.
  • Write and maintain runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures and configuration documentation in Confluence.
  • Support BRIXIO's professional services and implementation teams during escalations and handovers into managed service.
  • Actively share technical knowledge across the team to reduce dependency on individual engineers.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

Technical Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in network, security or cloud operations.
  • Experience within managed services, NOC or SOC environments is a strong advantage.
  • Solid working knowledge of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, caching and CDN mechanics.
  • Practical Cloudflare experience across WAF, DDoS mitigation, rate limiting, bot management, CDN and DNS.
  • Where Cloudflare experience is partial, BRIXIO will fund Cloudflare certification, which you will be expected to complete within the first six months.
  • Confidence using diagnostic tools including curl, dig, traceroute, browser developer tools and HAR analysis.
  • Experience with Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Experience with Git/version control.
  • Scripting capability using Python or Bash.
  • Understanding of web application architecture and application-security fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with Jira Service Management and ITIL-aligned incident, change and problem-management processes.
  • Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP is an advantage.

Languages

Full professional fluency in both French and English is a hard requirement.

You will handle incidents both in writing and verbally with French- and English-speaking enterprise clients, including during high-pressure situations. You will also prepare client-facing incident and change records in both languages.

Both French and English will be assessed during the interview process.

Arabic is a significant advantage when supporting BRIXIO's Gulf accounts.

How You Work

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Calm and methodical when working under incident pressure.
  • Disciplined about escalation rather than improvising when the situation requires additional expertise.
  • Serious about documentation and maintaining accurate technical records.
  • Able to explain technical situations clearly to non-technical stakeholders in either French or English.
  • Comfortable acknowledging what they do not know and finding the right answer.
  • Reliable within a rotating shift environment and disciplined about providing clean handovers to colleagues.
  • Comfortable working remotely within a distributed international team spanning Morocco, the Philippines, France and the Gulf.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means:

  • Increasing numbers of issues are detected and resolved proactively before clients report them.

  • Shift handovers are clean, tickets are accurate and runbooks remain current.
  • Clients develop confidence in the engineers operating their environments.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join a managed service designed around defined processes, published rotas, protected proactive engineering time and no expectation of being reachable outside your shift.
  • Develop towards Senior MSP Engineering, Professional Services Implementation, Solution Architecture or Service Delivery Management.
  • Work in an environment where automation is part of the engineering role, with engineers encouraged to contribute to and improve BRIXIO's internal tooling.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Managed Services and Support
jobs.description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe, the Gulf and Asia, with operations spanning Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist Cloudflare expertise with the scale and reach of a major international organisation.

The Role

As BRIXIO continues to grow, we are looking for a Customer Success & Renewals Manager to take ownership of the commercial health and long-term development of our managed service and support portfolio.

This is not a technical support or project management position.

Your focus begins where implementation projects transition into long-term client relationships. You will own renewals, retention, account health and the conversion of completed projects into ongoing support and managed services.

You will develop a clear understanding of every account in your portfolio: the value being delivered, the health of the relationship, upcoming renewals, potential risks and opportunities for further development.

This is a newly created role with genuine ownership. You will have the opportunity to build the processes, governance and structure behind BRIXIO's customer success and renewal function.

What You Will Own

Renewals & Retention

  • Own the consolidated renewal calendar across Cloudflare subscriptions and BRIXIO service contracts.
  • Lead renewal planning and client conversations early enough to enable proactive decision-making.
  • Use subscription renewals as an opportunity to review usage, entitlement, service requirements and potential managed-service needs.
  • Maintain accurate renewal forecasts across the portfolio.
  • Build and maintain an account-health view using service performance, ticket trends, incidents, consumption and stakeholder engagement.
  • Identify accounts at risk and coordinate recovery plans with the relevant operational teams.
  • Review lost renewals and ensure relevant insights are captured and acted upon.

Project-to-Service Conversion

  • Own the conversion of completed Cloudflare implementation projects into ongoing support and managed-service relationships.
  • Work with Delivery Managers at project closure and hypercare exit to identify and progress conversion opportunities.
  • Maintain a structured pipeline of conversion opportunities, with clear status and next actions.
  • Develop commercial proposals in collaboration with the Sales Director and operations teams.
  • Actively manage prepaid and on-demand professional services contracts to support utilisation, client value and future renewal.

Client Governance & Account Health

  • Prepare and lead Quarterly Business Reviews for major accounts, covering value delivered, service performance, roadmap, risks and next steps.
  • Establish an appropriate governance rhythm for mid-sized and smaller accounts.
  • Maintain a portfolio dashboard providing clear visibility of account health, renewal status, risks and conversion performance.
  • Maintain appropriate account segmentation and adjust it as client relationships grow or evolve.

Account Growth

  • Identify expansion opportunities based on genuine client needs and signals such as traffic growth, new applications, evolving security requirements, additional business units or service consumption.
  • Qualify opportunities and work with the sales team to progress them, while directly managing smaller opportunities where appropriate.
  • Keep clients informed of relevant Cloudflare capabilities in a consultative and credible way.

Commercial Operations & Collaboration

  • Work across BRIXIO's international organisation, collaborating with operations and support, sales, architecture, pre-sales and finance teams.
  • Maintain accurate account, renewal and pipeline information within Zoho CRM and BrixioOne.
  • Establish scalable processes and ways of working for a newly created function.
  • Bring structure and visibility to the portfolio as BRIXIO continues to grow.

Your First 90 Days

Your initial priorities will be clearly defined:

  • Portfolio baseline: establish the position of every managed service and support contract, including value, renewal date, account health, stakeholders and risk.
  • Renewal calendar: create a consolidated 12-month view of Cloudflare subscription and BRIXIO service renewals.
  • Conversion pipeline: review recently completed and closing implementation projects and build a qualified project-to-service conversion pipeline.
  • Service consumption: take ownership of prepaid and on-demand service contracts and improve utilisation.
  • Governance: establish the Quarterly Business Review cycle and reporting structure for major accounts.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Service Delivery Management or a comparable client-facing commercial role within technology services.
  • Demonstrable experience owning renewals and retention, ideally with measurable commercial outcomes.
  • Experience within an MSP, managed security provider, systems integrator, consultancy or SaaS environment involving recurring revenue.
  • Confidence working with contracts, pricing, service entitlements and SLAs.
  • Experience with vendor subscriptions or licence renewals within a reseller or indirect model would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience creating or developing a customer-success, renewal or account-management function would also be highly valued.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable having credible conversations with security and infrastructure stakeholders.

Ideally, you will have:

  • A working understanding of DNS, CDN, WAF, DDoS mitigation and Zero Trust, or the ability to develop this knowledge quickly.
  • The ability to interpret service reports and analytics and translate them into meaningful client conversations.
  • Confidence working alongside technical delivery, operations and architecture teams.

Cloudflare product training, access to Cloudflare University and funded certification will be provided.

Languages

Full professional fluency in French and English is essential, both written and spoken.

You will work with French-speaking European accounts as well as enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, including leading governance conversations and preparing client-facing material in both languages.

Arabic is a significant advantage for the Gulf portfolio.

What Will Help You Succeed

You are likely to thrive in this role if you are:

  • Highly organised and systematic, with the ability to maintain visibility across a significant portfolio of accounts.
  • Commercially confident and comfortable discussing renewals, pricing and scope with clients.
  • Credible with both client-side technical stakeholders and internal operations teams.
  • Able to identify account risk proactively rather than waiting for a client to escalate.
  • Self-directed and comfortable building structure where no established playbook currently exists.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role will be measured through tangible commercial and customer outcomes, including:

  • Strong net revenue retention across the managed service and support portfolio.
  • Increased conversion of completed implementation projects into ongoing services.
  • Renewals managed proactively, with clear forecasting and no avoidable lapses.
  • Better utilisation of prepaid and on-demand service entitlements.
  • Effective governance and business-review cycles across key accounts.
  • Clear, accurate and up-to-date visibility of portfolio health, risk and opportunity.

Why BRIXIO?

  • Join one of a select number of Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partners, working closely with Cloudflare engineering and support teams.
  • Be part of Equans and the Bouygues group, combining specialist expertise with the stability and opportunities of a major international organisation.
  • Work with substantial enterprise and public-sector clients across Europe and the Gulf.
  • Build and shape a function from the ground up rather than simply inheriting an established process.
  • Develop towards broader account leadership, scaled customer success or opportunities within the wider Equans commercial organisation.

jobs.title: Fleet Koordinator med flair for IT – er du vores nye problemknuser?
jobs.description:
Hans Jensen & Koldkur Transport er moderne transportvirksomheder indenfor tank- og silotransport, er aktive indenfor både- Fødevare- foder- tekniske samt ADR-produkter. Vi har bæredygtighed som en kerneværdi, og vi stræber efter at gøre tingene ordentligt, samt sætter en ære i at yde den bedste service i branchen.

Vi er ISO9001, ISO22000, ISO14001, GMP+, samt SQAS certificeret.

 Vores piloter bruger Transics, Volvo Connect og deres mobiltelefon mange gange hver eneste dag.
Når noget driller, skal de have én person på kontoret, de kan ringe til. En der tager telefonen, tager ejerskab og løser problemet. Det er dig. Vi har oprettet en ny stilling som fleet koordinator med flair for IT.


Du bliver bindeleddet mellem piloter, disponenter og administration, og du griber de opgaver, der i dag falder ned mellem stolene. Du er ikke IT-ansvarlig, og vi forventer ikke, at du kan programmere, men du er typen, der ikke giver op før tingene virker.

Du refererer til vores Business Improvement Manager. Tilsammen råder vi over ca. 150 lastbiler og ca. 200 trailere og en hel flåde af piloter, der regner med, at udstyret fungerer.

 

Dit ansvar og dine opgaver:

·         Ejerskab for de systemer piloterne bruger hver dag: Transics, Volvo Connect og mobiltelefoner, opsætning, drift, vedligehold og fejlretning.

·         Fast kontaktperson for piloterne når IT driller. Du tager opkaldet, finder løsningen og følger op, til det virker.

·         Oplæring af nye piloter i den daglige brug af Transics, Volvo Connect og telefon.

·         IT-kyndig til kolleger på kontoret i Onsild og Fårbæk, kontakt til eksterne IT-leverandører samt IT-indkøb af telefoner og udstyr.

·         Kontrol af følgesedler, logbøger og scanninger på udførte transporter, så ordrerne er klar til fakturering.

·         Registrering af afvigelser og uregelmæssigheder og forslag til, hvordan vi undgår dem næste gang.

jobs.title: Researcher in artificial intelligence for future healthcare solutions
jobs.description:
The position

An exciting position as Researcher is available in the Department of Computer Science within the TRUSTING project (https://trusting-project.eu/). The project is funded by the EU until 31st December 2028. The position is for one year initially. The research focuses on voice and language-based AI for psychosis relapse detection and will be conducted within a thriving research group that has recently received grants of excellence.

The goal is to contribute broadly to research on applications of AI in medicine, specifically to the development and validation of novel computational language models, algorithms, and tools for spoken language-based detection of schizophrenia relapse in 6 different languages.

The workplace is at UiT in Tromsø. Ideally, you can start as soon as possible but must be able to start in the position in Tromsø within a reasonable time after receiving the offer. 


The project

TRUSTING is a research project where an international interdisciplinary team are developing a machine learning based monitoring system that leverages spoken language processing (SLP) and natural language processing (NLP) of speech recorded at home to calculate relapse risk. The developed monitoring system will be used in a forthcoming randomized clinical trial where the goal is to validate the clinical outcomes of those affected by schizophrenia. Within this project, we are seeking a researcher with a strong computer science background to take an active role in developing novel machine learning based systems and tools on the path towards clinical use and implementation of AI for the treatment and care of patients. The candidate will contribute broadly to the project to enable the development of new algorithms for clinical AI based on patient data from heterogeneous sources notably language/speech-based sources. The activity will focus on the development of a prototype implementation of early warning- and other AI-based decision support systems to study the effectiveness and safety of a novel clinical decision tool that is based on SLP/NLP and utilizes large language models. The monitoring system has three main parts, namely a secure backend for recording sounds from mobile phones, a platform for data cleaning and machine learning model development, and a front-end app used by the patients. Therefore, an interest in working with state-of-the-art MLOps technology is an advantage. The project will focus on interaction with clinicians, with a goal of closing the gap between foundational research in machine learning and the clinical use of machine learning methods for the benefit of patients from a healthcare point of view. Hence, the work will be conducted in a highly interdisciplinary research environment and the candidates will collaborate with an international team consisting of clinicians, researchers in science and technology, health, industry partners, as well as personnel responsible for ICT, data security, privacy concerns and more. 

The UiT team will collaborate with the other research teams within the TRUSTING consortium. 


Contact

Further information about the position and UiT is available by contacting: 

  • Professor Brita Elvevåg: phone +47 91993063; email: brita.elvevag@uit.no 
  • Professor Lars Ailo Bongo: phone +47 92015508; email: lars.ailo.bongo@uit.no 
  • Associate Prof. Sandra Just, phone +49 1771966546; email: sandra.a.just@uit.no

General and administrative questions: 

  • Head of administration Martin Fjellvang Osima, phone +47 77 64 62 44; email: martin.osima@uit.no 

Qualification requirements

We are looking for applicants with a strong background, interest and expertise in computer science research with a focus on machine learning methods for the health domain, with strong coding skills and familiarity with state-of-the-art machine learning frameworks. We would like an interested, active and highly motivated candidate who likes to explore new technologies, and who is an independent thinker but also a team player who will enjoy collaborating with other researchers and clinicians. 

The position requires 

  • a PhD degree in computer science or a related field (e.g., computational behavioral science) 
  • a publication record that document solid expertise in computer science
  • strong technical skills 
  • since the position is part of an interdisciplinary project, close interaction with other project participants will be required.
  • good communication skills in English are necessary and documented fluency in English is required.
  • personal suitability: Our working culture is important to us. We will emphasize the applicants motivation for the position and personal suitability. We are looking for candidates who display the following:
    • Collegial team player, ability to cooperate and communicate well with other members of staff and contribute to a good working
      environment.
    • Strong networking skills, ability to collaborate and conduct scientific leadership
    • Interest in strategy and strategic development of the department.
    • Good communication skills and ability to engage with academic, stakeholder and public audiences.

 

An advantage:  

  • previous experience in natural language processing, sound-based machine learning, development and deployment of health technology software is considered a benefit. 
  • experience with explainable and interpretable AI methods applied within medical contexts, notably in clinical decision systems, would be an advantage. 
  • previous experience in systems development, data management, networking, and applied machine learning is also considered an advantage. 
  • it is also beneficial if the applicant has an interest and previous experience with inter-disciplinary or industry collaboration. 
  • candidates with research experience and relevant publications in conferences and journals will be considered with higher priority

For a permanent position as researcher it requires proficiency in a Scandinavian language equivalent to level B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). New employees who do not fulfill the language criteria by appointment are required, within three years, to demonstrate sufficient proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Arrangements will be made to facilitate the completion of Norwegian courses.

During this assessment process, emphasis will be placed on your potential for research as evidenced by a thesis and any other academic works. In addition, we may consider work experience or other activities of significance. The assessment will emphasize motivation and personal suitability for the position.

 At UiT we put emphasis on the quality, relevance and significance of the research work and not on where the work is published, in accordance with the principles of The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

UiT wishes to increase the proportion of females in academic positions. In cases where two or more applicants are found to be approximately equally qualified, female applicants will be given priority. 


Application

We will evaluate you based only on the documentation that you submit with the application. 

The application and submitted documents must be sent electronically via www.jobbnorge.no and must contain:

  • Letter of application – this should include a short description of your background and its relevance to the advertised position, as well as a summary of your motivation for applying for this position. Please make it clear why you consider yourself qualified for this position and describe how you will strengthen the research activity in the research team (e.g., a vision statement).
  • CV with complete overview of education, supervised professional training, professional experience, and list of scientific publications.
  • Description of your academic production, stating which works you consider most important and of relevance to this position. A brief description of the other listed works should also be included to demonstrate breadth of production. These descriptions shall be an attachment to the application. 
  • Description of your academic and software production and links to any open-source code.
  • Up to five academic works. The doctoral thesis is regarded as one work. 
  • Diplomas and transcripts (all academic degrees) 
  • Contact information to 2-3 references 
  • Documentation of English proficiency 

All documentation to be considered must be in a Scandinavian language or English. We only accept applications and documentation sent via Jobbnorge within the application deadline. The applicant will be assessed by an expert committee. 


We offer
  • Participation in an excellent and thriving research group that has recently received a prestigious ERC Synergy grant (https://erc.europa.eu/news-events/news/synergy-grants-2023-examples-projects) 
  • A productive, collaborative, and stimulating environment with researchers working on cutting-edge medical applications of artificial intelligence and speech technologies
  • Flexible working hours and a state collective pay agreement 
  • Pension scheme through the state pension fund 
  • The possibility to balance professional development with a location to experience the liberating arctic nature: ski under the northern lights, hike and bike along the fjords 
  • Good welfare arrangements for employees
  • Norwegian health policy aims to ensure that everyone, irrespective of their personal finances and where they live, has access to good health and care services of equal standard. As an employee you will become member of the National Insurance Scheme which also include health care services. 
  • If you have to relocate to Tromsø then the Faculty of Science and Technology may reimburse your moving costs. Further details
    regarding this matter will be made available if you receive an offer from us.

 

More practical information for working and living in Norway can be found here: https://uit.no/staffmobility


Generel information

The appointment is made in accordance with State regulations and guidelines at UiT. At our website, you will find more information for
applicants.

The engagement is to be made in accordance with the acts relating to Control of the Export of Strategic Goods, Services and Technology. Candidates who by assessment of the application and attachment are seen to conflict with the criteria in the latter law will be prohibited from recruitment.
 

After the appointment you must assume that there may be changes in the area of work.
 

More information about moving to Norway and working at UiT: http://uit.no/mobility

jobs.title: Aktiv personlig assistent
jobs.description:
Personlig assistent sökes till en aktiv och glad 7-årig pojke med autism

Vi söker en trygg, engagerad och lekfull personlig assistent till en härlig 7-årig pojke med autism. Han är en nyfiken och energifylld kille som tycker om att vara i rörelse, leka, upptäcka nya saker och ha roligt tillsammans med personer han känner sig trygg med.

Som personlig assistent blir du ett viktigt stöd i hans vardag. Du hjälper honom att skapa struktur och förutsägbarhet, samtidigt som du uppmuntrar till lek, utveckling och delaktighet utifrån hans egna förutsättningar. Arbetet innebär att finnas med både i hemmet och vid olika aktiviteter, där du bidrar till en trygg och positiv miljö.

Vi söker dig som:

Är trygg, lugn och ansvarstagande.

Har ett positivt förhållningssätt och ett stort tålamod.

Tycker om att leka, vara aktiv och vistas utomhus.

Kan skapa struktur och följa rutiner samtidigt som du är flexibel när situationen kräver det.

Är lyhörd och har förmåga att läsa av barnets behov och kommunikation.

Har ett genuint intresse av att arbeta med barn och vill bidra till en meningsfull och utvecklande vardag.

Det är meriterande om du:

Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn med autism eller andra neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar.

Har arbetat som personlig assistent, inom skola, förskola eller annan barnverksamhet.

Har kunskap om alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation (AKK) eller lågaffektivt bemötande.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Det viktigaste för oss är att du är en varm, trygg och engagerad person som kan bygga en god relation med vår son och möta honom med respekt, tålamod och glädje.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig

Du söker jobbet genom att skapa ett konto och fyller i din profil. Där kan du ladda upp CV och personligt brev. När profilen är klar klickar du på ’’lediga tjänster’’ och söker denna tjänst. Vi rekryterar löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan! Vi erbjuder all nödvändig introduktion och utbildning för samtliga nyanställda, för att du ska känna dig trygg i din arbetsroll som personlig assistent. Du kommer även att få gå de utbildningar som A-Assistans rekommenderar. Dina ansökningshandlingar gås igenom av personal på A-Assistans samt av kundens anhöriga.

Om A-Assistans:

A-Assistans Leimir AB är ett privat företag som anordnar personlig assistans till assistansberättigade i hela landet. Vi har ca 600 personliga assistenter anställda. Kontor har vi i Stockholm,Hudiksvall, Karlstad, Västerås, Östersund och Umeå. Målet med vår verksamhet är att våra kunder ska kunna leva ett så självständigt liv som möjligt. Vi har kollektivavtal: Kommunal och Fremia för personliga assistenter. Semester -, OB- ersättning och andra lönetillägg tillkommer enligt avtal. Vi erbjuder även friskvårdspeng på 2 000 kr för heltidstjänst och år, fika på arbetet och andra förmåner.

jobs.title: Timvikarier till Avlösarservice på schema
jobs.description:
Arbetsuppgifter

Vill du arbeta extra och samtidigt göra något meningsfullt? Som timvikarie inom avlösarservice stöttar du barn och ungdomar med funktionsnedsättning och ger deras föräldrar möjlighet till avlastning.

Om uppdraget

Som avlösare ansvarar du tillfälligt för omsorgen i barnets eller ungdomens hem. Arbetet utgår från individens behov och kan innebära hjälp med personlig omvårdnad, matlagning, enklare städning, promenader eller olika aktiviteter. Det kan också handla om att spela favoritspel, pyssla eller bara vara ett socialt sällskap. Flera av de barn vi möter behöver tydlig struktur och kommunikation, vilket innebär att du kan använda metoder som lågaffektivt bemötande (LAB) och alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation (AKK).

Till skillnad från många andra timvikariat innebär avlösarservice att du får ett schema hos ett specifikt barn. Det betyder att du blir en viktig del av barnets vardag som ordinarie personal, med fasta och återkommande arbetspass varje vecka. Schemat planeras i samråd med familjen och anpassas både efter deras behov och dina möjligheter.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull, trygg i att arbeta självständigt och har lätt för att skapa förtroende. Du har intresse av att arbeta med barn eller ungdomar med funktionsnedsättning, oavsett om du har tidigare erfarenhet från yrkeslivet eller genom närstående. Kontinuitet och tillit är viktigt i det här uppdraget. Vi söker därför dig som har möjlighet att arbeta kontinuerligt och skapa en trygg och långsiktig relation med de familjer du stödjer. Det medicinska ansvaret ligger alltid hos vårdnadshavaren, enligt beslut om egenvård.

Arbetstid

Arbetstiderna varierar beroende på familjernas behov och kan vara förlagda till vardagar, kvällar, helger och nattetid.

Kvalifikationer

För att få arbeta som vikarie inom funktionsstöd behöver du ha fyllt 18 år, i enlighet med föreskrifterna om minderårigas arbetsmiljö (AFS 2023:2).

Du som inte uppfyller godkänt betyg i Svenska 1 eller Svenska som andraspråk 1 kan komma att erbjudas språktest via EducateIt.

Vi ser det som meriterande att du har fullgjord eller pågående utbildning inom området, till exempel som stödassistent, undersköterska alternativt en pågående eller avslutad akademisk utbildning inom hälso- och sjukvård, beteendevetenskap eller pedagogisk utbildning. Det är även meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom funktionsstödsområdet eller inom vård och omsorg. Har du tidigare erfarenhet/ kunskaper av lågaffektivt bemötande (LAB) eller alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation (AKK) är det också meriterande, men inte ett krav.

Som vikarie inom funktionsstöd sätter du individen i fokus, har ett pedagogiskt förhållningssätt och ett genuint intresse för människor med olika typer av funktionsvariationer. Det är viktigt att du är lyhörd för individens behov för att kunna anpassa ditt bemötande i olika situationer. För oss är det önskvärt att du är ansvarsfull samt har ett flexibelt förhållningssätt. Det är även mycket viktigt att du är stabil och trygg som person.

Känner du att ovanstående beskrivning stämmer in på dig? Då är du varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Övrigt

Urval och intervjuer påbörjas under ansökningstiden.

Istället för att skicka in personligt brev till oss kommer du få svara på ett antal frågor där du får beskriva din kunskap inom området.

I Förvaltningen för Funktionsstöd arbetar vi med konceptet 3T- ”Tim till tillsvidare”. Målsättningen är att det ska leda till en tillsvidareanställning i förvaltningen för utbildade vikarier, ca 70 % av vår tillsvidareanställda kommer från timvikariat. Bemanningsenheten kan rådgöra kring utbildning och det går att kombinera utbildning med arbete via bemanningsenheten. Vi lotsar även utbildad personal mot verksamheter som har behov.

Göteborgs Stad arbetar aktivt för att främja lika rättigheter och möjligheter samt att motverka diskriminering.

Som medarbetare i förvaltningen för funktionsstöd erbjuder vi dig:

- Introduktion vid nyanställning

- Kompetensutveckling

- Friskvårdsbidrag & cykelbidrag

Före erbjudande om anställning ber vi dig uppvisa utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Du ska själv begära ett utdrag från polisens belastningsregister. Du beställer ett digitalt registerutdrag som skickas till din digitala brevlåda. Detta gör du via länken: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/kontrollera-dina-uppgifter-i-belastningsregistret/

Göteborgs Stad tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning. Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik. https://goteborg.se/wps/portal/start/jobba-i-goteborgs-stad/sa-ar-det-att-jobba-hos-oss/formaner-och-lon

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR. Har du skyddade personuppgifter ska du INTE söka via systemet utan kontakta ansvarig rekryterande chef för hantering av din ansökan.

Tillsättning sker under förutsättning att tjänsten inte behöver tas i anspråk i förvaltningen eller stadens omställningsarbete.

Till dig som företräder bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag: Inför denna rekrytering har vi valt rekryteringskanaler och önskar inte erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- eller rekryteringshjälp.

Om oss

Vi är alla olika. Vi är också lika och har samma rätt till ett tryggt hem, en meningsfull sysselsättning och att känna oss värdefulla. Med rätt förutsättningar kan vi växa, utvecklas och delta i samhället på våra egna villkor.

Inom förvaltningen för funktionsstöd ger vi stöd, service och omsorg till barn och vuxna med funktionsnedsättning och skapar möjlighet för dem att leva ett gott och självständigt liv, som alla andra.

Med 6 200 engagerade medarbetare är vi Sveriges största funktionsstödsförvaltning. Vi arbetar bland annat inom boenden med särskild service, daglig verksamhet, boendestöd, personligt stöd och barn- och korttidsboenden.

Vill du vara med och bidra till ett mer inkluderande samhälle? Välkommen till oss!

Du är Göteborg

jobs.description: Perce-Neige est une Fondation reconnue d'utilité publique, engagée au côté des personnes vivant avec un handicap et de leurs familles. Présente sur l'ensemble du territoire avec une soixantaine d'établissements et services (EANM, EAM, MAS, IME, SAVS, EPHAD), elle porte une exigence forte : proposer des accompagnements de qualité visant à permettre aux personnes de développer toutes leurs compétences, en respectant leur singularité, soutenir les familles touchées par le handicap et favoriser la recherche scientifique. LA MAISONLa Maison Perce-Neige de Faugeras est située sur un vaste domaine arboré à Condat-sur-Ganaveix, en Corrèze, dans un environnement naturel remarquable. Implantée depuis 1970, elle comprend deux structures distinctes : un foyer de vie (EANM) accueillant 40 adultes en situation de handicap mental, dont une unité dédiée aux personnes présentant des troubles du spectre de l'autisme, et un foyer d'accueil médicalisé (EAM) de 16 places destinées à des adultes handicapés vieillissants. L'accompagnement repose sur une démarche individualisée qui tient compte des besoins biologiques, affectifs, sociaux et psychologiques de chaque personne. Chaque résident est reconnu comme un sujet à part entière, avec son histoire, ses capacités et ses aspirations.
