jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role
Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) sit at the intersection of engineering and customer impact. This is not a traditional product engineering role - it's built for engineers who want their work to directly shape outcomes for Synthesia's most strategic customers and partners, often within days, not sprints.

You'll be embedded in high-value customer engagements, working alongside Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success to design, build, and ship bespoke technical solutions that unlock use cases no off-the-shelf feature could address. You'll own the full arc - from a whiteboard conversation with a customer's CTO through to a working, deployed integration - and you'll do it fast.

This role is for engineers who are super scrappy, fast-learning, and ambitious - people who might not pass every bar of a traditional product engineering process but who consistently find creative ways to get things built and shipped in the real world.

What You'll Do

  • Work directly with Synthesia's most strategic customers and partners to design and build bespoke technical solutions that unlock high-value use cases on their behalf.

  • Own the full build cycle for custom engagements: from scoping and architecture through to delivery, with a bias toward speed and impact over broad reusability.

  • Bridge technical and business stakeholders - equally fluent in conversations with engineers and architects as with senior decision-makers on the customer or partner side.

  • Translate ambiguous customer requirements into working prototypes and production-grade solutions in tight timelines.

  • Partner with internal product and engineering teams to feed real-world customer needs back into the product roadmap.

  • Identify patterns across customer engagements and help define where bespoke builds should become platform features.

  • Represent Synthesia's technical capabilities confidently and credibly in customer meetings, workshops, and discovery sessions.

What We're Looking For

The mindset matters more than the CV

You don't need to have worked at a particular company or passed a particular interview loop. What we care about is how you operate:

  • Bias for action. You build before asking permission. You ship something scrappy to test a hypothesis before writing a spec.

  • Rapid learner. You pick up new tools, APIs, and customer contexts quickly - and you enjoy the discomfort of operating at the edge of what you know.

  • Customer instinct. You naturally ask "what problem are they actually trying to solve?" before writing a line of code.

  • Commercially aware. You understand that speed of delivery is a form of value. You make tradeoffs that a product engineer might not - and you own the consequences.

  • Communicator. You can run a technical deep-dive with an enterprise architect in the morning and explain your approach to a CPO in the afternoon.

Experience signals we look for

  • Experience building and shipping working software - the form it took matters less than the fact you've owned something end-to-end.

  • Comfort working across the stack or with APIs and integrations to deliver solutions quickly.

  • Some exposure to customer or commercial contexts - whether that's a startup, an agency, a consulting role, or a side project with real users.

  • Familiarity with how enterprise customers think about technical integrations and vendor solutions.

  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate your output (we expect this to be part of how you work, not a bonus).

What we're explicitly not optimising for

  • Mastery of a specific language, framework, or infrastructure stack.

  • Performance on algorithmic coding challenges or system design interviews at the level we'd apply for product engineering roles.

  • Deep specialisation in ML, platform engineering, or any single technical domain.

How This Role Differs From Our Product Engineering Roles

  • You've led three or more end-to-end custom engagements for strategic customers, from scoping call to working deployment.

  • You've built a reputation internally as the person who can get things done with and for customers - fast.

  • You've fed meaningful insights from the field back to product teams, influencing at least one roadmap decision.

  • You've become comfortable operating across the full Synthesia platform and API surface, and know where the edges are.

  • You've helped define the playbook for how FDE engagements are scoped, run, and handed off.

Why join us?

We’re living the golden age of AI. The next decade will yield the next iconic companies, and we dare to say we have what it takes to become one. Here’s why,

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 50% of the Fortune 500)

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2.

Proprietary AI technology

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind.

AI Safety, Ethics and Security

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security.

jobs.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

About the role

Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.

You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.

Why now

Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.

The problem you're solving

Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.

We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:

  • Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

  • Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

  • Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

  • Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

  • Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

  • Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

  • Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

  • Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.

Who you are

You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.

You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.

You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.

You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

You may be a good fit if you bring

  • Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it.

  • A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent.

  • Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it.

  • Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them.

  • Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation.

  • Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

This is a permanent role and we prefer a hybrid working model; we are flexible with remote working as long as you can meet with the team in our London studio in-person now and then.

At Framestore’s Oscar-winning Technology team, innovation is at the heart of what we do, whether this be developing new techniques, new ideas or creative new ways to tell our clients’ stories. Underpinning all of this is a long tradition of research, technology and development - from engineering our bespoke software solutions to gaining early access to bleeding-edge technology and forging vibrant partnerships with leading academic and scientific institutions.

Framestore combines talent and technology to bring life to everything we create. Driven by creativity and inspired by the future, we set out every day to reframe the possible.

The Role

This is a senior engineering role focused on taking a modern, cloud-forward approach to platform development. You will work on a greenfield, AI-driven SaaS platform, building modern tools that bridge state-of-the-art technology with Framestore's world-class film making and media production workflows. You will help deploy, scale, and secure cloud-native serverless infrastructure to support our generative AI SaaS platform and latest products. Beyond hands-on cloud orchestration, you will focus heavily on developer enablement—empowering the entire team to ship valuable features to production with high velocity and reliability. Working within an agile environment alongside artists, pipeline teams, and systems teams, you will design scalable cloud solutions, embed robust enterprise security practices, and enhance deployment pipelines as the platform grows.

What you’ll do

  • Provision, manage, and scale secure, high-availability cloud infrastructure using Terraform and modern orchestration tools following enterprise security standards.

  • Drive developer enablement by building, optimizing, and maintaining powerful CI/CD deployment pipelines to streamline developer workflows and increase overall delivery velocity.

  • Architect and efficiently scale cloud-native serverless services and execution pipelines to support generative AI SaaS platform workflows and external clients.

  • Embed robust enterprise cloud security practices, ensuring comprehensive data protection, secure network topologies, and compliance as the platform scales.

  • Implement and enhance comprehensive platform telemetry, observability, logging, and monitoring systems to guarantee high system reliability and performance.


What we’re looking for:

  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern web frameworks (FastAPI, Asyncio).

  • Proven senior experience developing, operating, and scaling cloud-native SaaS applications and serverless architectures.

  • Hands-on expertise with containerisation (Docker) and serverless architectures (Cloud Run, Vertex AI).

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI).

Position Summary

e.l.f. Beauty is looking for a Director, EMEA Insights to join our dynamic, fast-paced, high-growth company. The ideal candidate will have a consumer and community-first mindset with a strong background in executing consumer research and synthesizing market data to analyze and articulate consumer trends and business impacts. This person is highly self-motivated, inherently curious, and strategic yet detail-oriented, with a passion for analyzing data, surfacing insights, and storytelling with data to drive business decisions.

The position will report directly to the Vice President, Global Insights. 

The Director, EMEA Insights is responsible for overseeing the EMEA-focused market and consumer insights functions, including market analysis, competitive intelligence, product insights, consumer research, audience segmentation, trends, and foresight, to drive actionable, data-driven growth through compelling storytelling. This individual will be adept at connecting dots across multiple data sources and strategically distilling and disseminating those actionable insights to all levels in the organization. This individual will be a thought leader and work collaboratively with cross-functional partners, acting as the voice of the EMEA consumer in making strategic connections between broad-based trends and marketplace opportunities. The ideal candidate is data-driven, results-oriented, has excellent communication skills, and is comfortable operating across all levels of the business, from strategic to tactical.

This position is based in e.l.f.’s London office with a hybrid 3-day in office schedule.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategically distill insights from diverse data sources and present them to senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a compelling narrative with concise and actionable findings and implications.
  • Leverage multiple data sources to connect dots and develop a comprehensive understanding of the business environment including brand performance, competitive brands and products, social dynamics, consumer behavior, demographic/audience factors, and macroeconomics, keeping a pulse on consistently evolving trends and foresight within and beyond beauty. Disseminate insights and strategic recommendations throughout the organization at all levels.
  • Leverage syndicated data tracking resources (e.g. NielsenIQ, Circana, Euromonitor, WGSN, Shopper Insights, Mintel, Spate, GfK) for frequent analysis of trends and identifying whitespace opportunities.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with external data and research partners (NielsenIQ, Circana, Mintel, YouGov, etc.), while consistently evaluating potential new data and research partners.
  • Drive the exploration and implementation of innovative research, trend tracking and social listening methodologies, including AI, to create next generation insights approaches and methodologies.
  • Partner with US-based Global Insights team to connect dots and unify insights that drive the business.

Requirements:

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in consumer research, market analysis, and data insights and analytics, inclusive of experience leading a multi-disciplinary consumer and market insights team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Market Research, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Marketing, or a related quantitative field. A master's degree or MBA is a plus.
  • Strong ability to analyze and synthesize disparate information from multiple data sources into a holistic story with strategic implications and recommendations. Capable of turning complex information into simple and understandable messaging.
  • Adept at designing and executing multi-country end-to-end quantitative and qualitative consumer research (i.e., survey development, discussion moderation), with the ability to generate relevant and actionable insights connected to consumer needs and business strategies.

  • Inherently curious, proactive, and enjoys digging beyond the surface to uncover insights. Exceptional at finding trends and the story in the data, articulating the “so what,” and translating insights into strategic, actionable recommendations.
  • Passionate about customer-centricity and data-driven strategy, with the ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders.
  • Outstanding analytical, critical thinking, and organizational skills with extreme attention to detail. Ability to focus on both strategy and execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and data story-telling skills, including the ability to clearly present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholders. Has executive presence with a high degree of comfort working with and presenting to senior leaders.

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.).

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As Senior Product Manager for Search & AI Discovery, you will shape how customers find, explore and connect with our digital commerce experience — across traditional search and the next generation of AI-powered discovery. You will own the product strategy and roadmap for search discoverability, ensuring our digital platforms are built to be visible, scalable and high-performing across markets. This includes core technical SEO capabilities such as metadata, canonicals, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, hreflang, URL structures, pagination, faceted navigation and Core Web Vitals.

Beyond today’s search landscape, you will help define how we show up in AI-powered search, generative discovery and shopping-agent experiences. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About Level Zero

Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we're pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health.

Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are.

We're seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we're assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.

We're looking for a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the mechanical architecture of Level Zero's wearable medical devices, from early concept through to design transfer and volume manufacture. Working directly with the founding team and a multidisciplinary engineering group, you'll set the mechanical direction for highly miniaturised, body-worn products, making the key decisions on architecture, materials, manufacturing processes and risk. This is a hands-on senior role for someone who wants to own the mechanical design of a medical wearable end to end, while mentoring others and shaping how we develop products as we grow.


What you'll do
  • Own and lead the mechanical architecture of Level Zero's wearable medical devices.
  • Drive miniaturisation and integration, working with electronics, sensing and industrial design to package complex functionality into small, comfortable, body-worn form factors.
  • Set mechanical design standards, CAD practices, drawing conventions and design review processes for the engineering team.
  • Lead the design of injection moulded, overmoulded and precision components from concept through to production release.
  • Define mechanical requirements, design specifications and architecture documentation, and ensure traceability within the design history file.
  • Lead tolerance analysis and statistical tolerancing for critical assemblies to ensure robust performance and manufacturability at scale.
  • Own mechanical risk management, leading DFMEA activities and contributing to PFMEA and overall product risk files.
  • Define and oversee verification and validation strategies, including reliability, environmental, ingress, drop, wear and life-cycle testing.
  • Lead root cause investigations into complex mechanical failures and drive effective, data-led design improvements.
  • Champion human-centred design, leading human factors studies, usability evaluations and user research, and ensuring wearability, comfort and ease of use are designed in from the start.
  • Select and manage external suppliers, moulders, tooling vendors and contract manufacturers, and lead tooling trials, pilot builds and design transfer.
  • Balance performance, usability, reliability, manufacturability, regulatory requirements and cost across the product lifecycle.

    • The ideal candidate must have
  • Master's degree with 4+ years of industry experience in mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering or a related discipline.
  • A track record of taking medical devices or consumer wearables from concept through to volume manufacture.
  • Experience leading the mechanical design of highly miniaturised or densely integrated products.
  • Expert CAD and drafting skills, including complex assemblies and surfacing, with a strong command of engineering drawings, GD&T and manufacturing tolerances.
  • Extensive experience designing injection moulded plastic components for volume manufacture, including overmoulding, multi-shot or insert moulding.
  • Experience leading tolerance stack analysis and applying statistical tolerancing to critical assemblies.
  • Experience designing sealed, leak-tight or ingress-protected assemblies and developing associated test methods.
  • Strong knowledge of assembly methods including snap fits, heat staking, ultrasonic and laser welding, adhesives and overmoulding.
  • Experience leading DFMEA, contributing to PFMEA and applying structured risk management in line with ISO 14971.
  • Experience working within an ISO 13485 or equivalent quality system, including design controls, change control, product release and PLM systems.
  • Experience defining and executing V&V plans and mechanical test methods.
  • Experience managing external suppliers, tooling vendors and contract manufacturers, including tooling trials and production transfer.
  • Proven ability to lead structured root cause analysis on complex mechanical failures.
  • Experience designing products with user needs at the centre of development.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence across multidisciplinary engineering teams and with senior stakeholders.

    • Nice to have:

  • Experience designing skin-adhered or continuously worn medical devices (e.g. CGMs, patch pumps, cardiac monitors)
  • Experience designing pumps, valves, diaphragms, microfluidics or other fluid-handling mechanisms
  • Experience with IEC 60601, ISO 10993 biocompatibility or IEC 62366 usability engineering
  • Experience designing precision mechanical mechanisms, such as applicators or insertion mechanisms
  • Experience with sterilisation-compatible design and material selection
  • Familiarity with Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical data analysis
  • Experience with FEA for structural, thermal or fatigue assessment
  • Experience with rapid prototyping, machining and 3D printing
  • Prior work in a start-up or small company environment
  • Experience building or scaling an engineering team

    • Who You Are

    We value culture as much as we value technical expertise, creating an environment that's equal parts collaboration, curiosity, and fun.

    We're a fast-paced, mission-driven young team on a quest to make a lasting impact, fueled by uncompromising integrity, unwavering support for one another, and the thrill of exploring uncharted territories. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future.

    If our vision excites you, here are the qualities we look for:

  • You live and breathe integrity, tackling challenges with honesty and transparency.
  • You're a self-starter who loves diving into the unknown, collaborating on complex problems, and taking full ownership of results.
  • You excel at open, clear communication and see every piece of feedback as a springboard for growth—especially in a science and data-focused environment.
  • You're motivated by creating real impact, particularly when it comes to advancing human health.
  • You strike a balance between independence and collaboration, knowing when to seek support or invite others to join in.
  • You're confident in defending your ideas, while also valuing respectful, constructive debate as a path to better solutions.
  • You thrive in the dynamic atmosphere of a startup, constantly evolving your skill set and fearlessly applying what you learn

    • What we offer
  • A full-time role with a competitive salary and equity options, reflecting our value in your expertise and potential.
  • An environment where you'll collaborate directly with the founding team at a leading biosensor startup, gaining access to industry experts and thought leaders.
  • The chance to grow with us, including ample opportunities for leadership, career advancement, and exploration.
  • Travel to New York and other potential sites for R&D purposes.
  • The excitement of working on cutting-edge technology, shaping strategic decisions, and driving innovation at an early-stage venture alongside a superstar team.
    • Be Part of Our Journey
    If you're ready to be at the forefront of biosensing innovation and thrive in fast-paced, learning-rich environments, we'd love to hear from you.

    If your skills and experience do not align perfectly with this role, yet you believe you have something unique to offer, we're keen to listen. Reach out to us with a short statement on how you can contribute and let's discuss where you might fit into our team.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov
jobs.description:
Poskytovanie technickej podpory používateľom pri riešení bežných problémov s hardvérom, softvérom a podnikovými aplikáciami. Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.
Výhody:13, 14 mzda po odpracovaní 6 mesiacov, mesačné prémie, príspevok na dochádzanie do práce, kredit na občerstvenie, príspevok na stravu nad rámec zákona.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.description:
Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Vaše pracovné úlohy na uvedenej pracovnej pozícii budú: Aktívne vyhľadávanie klientov a následná starostlivosť o nich. Poistné poradenstvo a vypracovávanie návrhov na poistenie podľa potrieb klienta. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Sprostredkovanie predaja vybraných bankových produktov.
Výhody:Stabilná a zaujímavá práca v najsilnejšej poisťovacej skupine na Slovensku Vienna Insurance Group. 6-mesačný program podpory nových regionálnych obchodných zástupcov s garanciou minimálneho príjmu a provízie bez obmedzenia. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. Ak Vás ponuka zaujala, pošlite nám Váš štruktúrovaný životopis. Kontaktovať budeme len vybraných uchádzačov, ktorí spĺňajú požiadavky danej pozície. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Financial Accountant (m/w, 80–100%)
jobs.description:
IN KÜRZE

Du begeisterst dich für Zahlen, legst Wert auf Präzision und möchtest aktiv das Wachstum von FELFEL mitgestalten? Als Financial Accountant (80–100%, ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung) in Zürich Wiedikon übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in unserem agilen Finance Team. Hier formst du nicht nur Zahlen, sondern gestaltest gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft unseres Unternehmens.


DEINE VERANTWORTUNGEN

  • Führe das Tagesgeschäft inklusive Haupt- und Nebenbücher (Debitoren, Kreditoren, Bank- und Zahlungsabstimmungen) für unsere Schweizer Gesellschaft und unterstütze das Tagesgeschäft unserer US-Gesellschaft.
  • Erstelle Verrechnungen an Kunden und wirke bei Monats-, Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen nach Schweizer Recht mit.
  • Pflege und optimiere unser ERP-System (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC), um dessen kontinuierliche Skalierbarkeit sicherzustellen.
  • Agiere als Ansprechperson für interne sowie externe Stakeholder bei Fragen zur Rechnungsstellung und Kreditorenbuchhaltung.
  • Wirke an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finanzprozesse mit.
  • Steuere die Kommunikation als Schnittstelle zu externen Partnern wie ERP-Support, Behörden und Lieferanten.
  • Unterstütze bei der Erstellung von MWST-Abrechnungen, Sales and Use Tax Meldungen für unsere US-Gesellschaft sowie bei der jährlichen Steuererklärung.


WAS DU MITBRINGST

  • 2–4 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen in einem ähnlichen Umfeld.
  • Abschluss als Eidg. Finanzfachmann/frau im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen (oder aktuell in entsprechender Ausbildung).
  • Sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse sowie Erfahrung mit ERP-Systemen (Abacus / Microsoft Dynamics BC von Vorteil).
  • Leidenschaft für Zahlen, Strukturen und Prozesse in einem agilen Umfeld.
  • Selbstständige, exakte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
  • Ausgeprägter Teamgeist und Fähigkeit, mit internen sowie externen Partnern professionell zu kommunizieren.
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Nichtraucher:in – wir möchten nicht, dass du nach Zigaretten riechst, weder bei der Arbeit noch bei Kundenterminen. Schliesslich dreht sich bei FELFEL alles um gutes Essen.
  • Gültige Arbeitsbewilligung für die Schweiz oder Schweizer Pass.


WAS WIR BIETEN

  • Jede Menge leckeres Essen, nur wenige Schritte von deinem Schreibtisch entfernt - wir erfüllen all deine kulinarischen Wünsche...
  • Bester Barista-Kaffee und Tee für das ganze Team dank unserer innovativen Gavetti Kaffeemaschine
  • 5 Wochen Urlaub pro Jahr
  • Pro Jahr gewähren wir zwei ganze Wochen "Work from anywhere" und sorgen damit für Abwechslung im Arbeitsalltag
  • Wir finanzieren dein Halbtax-Abo, und unterstützen so unsere Mitarbeitenden bei der Nutzung des ÖV
  • Frisch gebackene Eltern erhalten von uns 16 bzw. 3 Wochen voll bezahlte Elternzeit. Wir unterstützen zudem die Rückkehr in den Beruf, indem wir einen grosszügigen finanziellen Beitrag an die Kinderbetreuung bis zum Erreichen des Kindergartenalters leisten
  • Tolle Team-Events, wie z.B. unsere bekannten FELFEL Summer-Outings
Klingt das nach dem perfekten Job für dich? Wir können es kaum erwarten, mehr über dich zu erfahren! BEWIRB DICH JETZT mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen auf Deutsch oder Englisch.

Chez Deliveroo, vous aurez l'opportunité de contribuer à des projets concrets ayant un impact direct sur des millions de clients.

  • D'un environnement collaboratif où l'autonomie, l'innovation et l'apprentissage sont encouragés.

Le processus comprend généralement :

  • Un échange avec notre équipe Talent Acquisition.

jobs.title: Signal Processing Engineer (Radar)
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a confirmed Radar Signal Processing Engineer on Harmattan AI's Radar team in Paris, you will own the signal processing algorithms behind our next-generation airborne radar payload. You will take full ownership of your workstream, from algorithmic research through embedded implementation and flight validation, working with high autonomy and minimal oversight. You will work closely with the EW and RF analytics teams to translate product-level requirements into deployed, mission-ready capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement near-real-time algorithms for radar image formation, including inverse SAR (ISAR) processing of moving targets.

  • Develop and refine detection and tracking algorithms (e.g., EKF/UKF-based approaches) for moving target indication on airborne radar data.

  • Build jamming estimation capabilities, combining out-of-band spectral sniffing with in-band spatial covariance analysis, and the adaptive logic that drives radar behavior in response.

  • Contribute radar-derived observables and algorithms that support navigation when GNSS is unavailable.

  • Prototype and port algorithms onto the selected embedded computing platform, balancing algorithmic performance against real-time and resource constraints.

  • Validate algorithms end-to-end through hardware-in-the-loop bench testing, anechoic chamber campaigns, and real flight conditions, iterating quickly on results.

  • Work closely with the EW and RF analytics modules to align signal processing development with system-level requirements.

Candidate Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of confirmed, hands-on experience in radar signal processing, gained in the defense or automotive radar industry preferably.

  • Solid experience in Signal Processing on radar systems, either FMCW or pulsed, is required; exposure to moving target tracking, ECCM, radar-based navigation, or live/real-time processing is a strong plus.

  • Strong theoretical foundations and genuine hands-on comfort with the underlying mathematics, not reliance on off-the-shelf tools or LLM-generated solutions.

  • A quick thinker, comfortable taking full ownership of a technical scope end-to-end with minimal oversight.

  • Comfortable working in a fast, iterative cycle: writing code, running hardware-in-the-loop tests, and pushing validated changes independently.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Pijpfitter
jobs.description:
Als pijpfitter werk je mee aan de vervaardiging en de inbouw van pijpleidingsystemen aan boord van de jachten die op de werf in aanbouw zijn. Voor onze andere vacatures kijk ook even op www.werkenvoorhmb.nl

Wij bieden jou een uitdagende en verantwoordelijke functie in een leuke organisatie.

jobs.title: Coördinator Dagbesteding Geelbroekerweg Hooghalen
jobs.description:
Als coördinator dagbesteding begeleid en ondersteun je bewoners met een intensieve begeleidingsvraag in hun dagelijks leven. Je coördineert de dagbesteding, vertaalt de doelen uit het persoonlijk plan naar passende activiteiten en stemt deze af met de persoonlijk begeleider, onder verantwoordelijkheid van de gedragsdeskundige. Binnen de Cirkel combineer je het werken op de dagbesteding met het werken op de woonlocatie. Zo zorg je samen met je collega's voor continuïteit, verbinding tussen wonen en dagbesteding en een eenduidige begeleidingsstijl.

Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, behandelaren, verwanten en andere betrokkenen. Je stimuleert bewoners in hun ontwikkeling, zelfredzaamheid en maatschappelijke participatie, rapporteert over de voortgang en denkt actief mee over de ontwikkeling van nieuwe activiteiten. Je werkt onregelmatige diensten en draagt iedere dag bij aan een veilige, gestructureerde en betekenisvolle leef- en werkomgeving.

Samen met je collega's maak je iedere dag het verschil voor bewoners die behoefte hebben aan duidelijkheid, structuur en een omgeving waarin zij zich kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wil jij bijdragen aan een betekenisvolle dag voor mensen met een intensieve ondersteuningsvraag? Een van onze collega's zet een mooie volgende stap binnen Vanboeijen. Daarom zijn wij op zoek naar een nieuwe coördinator dagbesteding die samen met ons het verschil wil maken voor onze bewoners.

Op de locatie Geelbroekerweg in Hooghalen bied je samen met je collega's een veilige, prikkelarme omgeving aan jongvolwassenen en volwassenen met complexe zorgvragen en moeilijk verstaanbaar gedrag. Wonen en dagbesteding zijn hier onlosmakelijk met elkaar verbonden. In een warme en huiselijke omgeving lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan een waardevolle, voorspelbare en betekenisvolle dag voor de bewoners.

Wat ga je doen?
In deze rol ben je het aanspreekpunt voor klanten en help je hen bij vragen over verzekeringen. Je zorgt voor een correcte en vlotte afhandeling van claims en denkt actief mee over passende oplossingen. Je combineert klantgerichtheid met commercieel inzicht en weet kansen te signaleren, zonder het belang van de klant uit het oog te verliezen.

Wat vragen wij?
Ervaring in de verzekeringsbranche;
bereidheid om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen en up-to-date te blijven binnen het vakgebied;
klantgericht talent met sterke communicatieve vaardigheden;
empathisch vermogen, gecombineerd met commercieel inzicht;
collegiale instelling en een prettige persoonlijkheid;
een echte teamplayer met een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding;
je bent niet bang om initiatief te nemen en zaken op te pakken;
beschikbaar voor minimaal 24 uur per week.

Wie ben jij?
Je bent iemand die energie haalt uit het helpen van anderen en graag meedenkt met klanten. Je schakelt makkelijk, communiceert helder en werkt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband effectief samen.

Wat bieden wij?
Een afwisselende functie binnen een klein, betrokken team, een prettige werksfeer en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei.

Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap? Dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

jobs.title: Schoonmaker Maandag & Vrijdag

jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?

Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.

Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.

Wie zoeken we?

Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.
Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.
Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.
Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.
Je hebt affiniteit met security.
Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.
Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.
Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.
En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.

Wat verwachten we niet?

Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.
Dat je pakken draagt.
Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.
Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.
En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.
We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.

Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?

Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.

Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.

Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.

jobs.description:
EGM architecten
Responsive facade designs for sustainable architecture
A closer look at the design of sustainable exterior facades for a healthy and energy-efficient indoor climate
The Netherlands are facing a major challenge. The National Climate Agreement states that the built environment must be completely energy-neutral by 2050 (TNO, 2021). As a result, the demand for sustainable design solutions is constantly increasing. Smart design and the use of the latest technologies, enable architects to contribute to the built environment in a meaningful way. In this research, we take a closer look at the design of sustainable exterior facades for a healthy and energy-efficient indoor climate. By adding Generative Design to the design process, we can achieve the most optimal facades that respond to the local climate and weather conditions. Utilizing passive solar energy by design
During the design process, local climate and weather data is added to the developed algorithm as a parameter. With this method, it is possible to test different design solutions in their natural, site specific environment and test their performance with real climate and weather conditions. Based on the climate data of a given geo location Generative Design is added to this process to optimize the facade's performance and get the most energy efficient solution for the facade design.
The goal is to generate a facade that utilises passive solar energy by design. For example, in summer excessive sunlight is blocked by using an overhang. During the winter period, the facade lets in enough sunlight to naturally light up and warm up the building. Facades tailored to the local climate and weather conditions can utilize solar radiation sufficiently throughout the year. In return, climate systems and/or air conditioning systems do not have to deploy as much, and therefore save energy. PhD position Using microfluidics to observe and manipulate coacervate droplets
PhD PhD position Using microfluidics to observe and manipulate coacervate droplets
We are looking for a 4-year PhD candidate to join our nationally funded, multi-partner research consortium, Towards De-Novo Life. The main aim of this interdisciplinary project is to achieve minimal life based on chemical rather than biological components such as DNA, proteins or other macromolecules. Our PhD candidate will contribute by developing new microfluidic tools to work with micrometer-sized coacervate droplets, the compartments in which chemical replication, growth and evolution will take place.
PhD position Using microfluidics to observe and manipulate coacervate droplets
https://werkenbij.rug.nl/vacature/phd-position-using-microfluidics-to-observe-and-manipulate-coacervate-droplets-2327/
What are you going to do?
The de-novo synthesis of life requires integrating the essential features of life, which include replication (the ability to copy oneself), metabolism (promoting the formation of one's own components from material in the environment) and compartmentalization (keeping the internal components together and separate from the environment) into a system that is maintained out of equilibrium. Key to the creation of a minimal form of life is Darwinian evolution of the resulting synthetic cell-like systems. Serving as the compartments in our work are coacervate microdroplets, consisting of a very dense aqueous phase containing a high concentration of macromolecules. Because coacervates can exist in dilute aqueous phases without loss of droplet structure, they can act as cell-like spheres without the need of a membrane to contain their content.

jobs.description:
Contexte :

ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé.

L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission :

  • la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé,

  • la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).

Au sein de la Direction de la formation, le pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages », assure le cadre administratif de gestion des élèves dans leurs parcours de formation. Il agit en fonction support des directeurs de programme.

 

Le/la titulaire du poste est affecté(e) au sein de la Direction de la Formation, sur le site de Brest, et est rattaché(e) hiérarchiquement à la Directrice du pôle « admissions, scolarité, stages ».

Dans ce cadre, l’ENSTA recrute, pour son campus de Brest, un/une gestionnaire administratif qui assurera le suivi des dossiers élèves, en particulier des élèves militaires sous statut d’IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement)

 

Missions / Activités principales :

 

Le titulaire du poste est chargé(e) du suivi administratif des élèves civils :

  • Elaboration et la diffusion des certificats de scolarité et autres documents de scolarité (certificat d'inscription ...)

  • Suivi d’attestation CVEC

  • Suivi des bourses étudiantes, en lien avec le CROUS, en qualité de correspondant(e) bourses.

  • Gestion des cartes étudiantes,

  • Gestion des demandes de financements par la formation continue,

  • Gestion des déplacements et répartition des étudiants pour les actions de promotion de l’offre de formation,

  • Participation aux activités du pôle

 

Sous l'autorité fonctionnelle du Directeur des études IETA et de l'Adjointe Officiers des corps de l'armement, le/la titulaire du poste assure la gestion administrative des élèves sous statut IETA (Ingénieur des études et techniques de l’armement) :

 

  • Assurer la gestion administrative et le suivi individuel des élèves militaires : dossiers, solde, cartes militaires, suivi médical, permissions, affectations, arrêts de travail, accidents, décorations, etc ;

  • Assurer la liaison avec le service médical de la base navale de Brest ;

  • Assurer la gestion et le suivi des habilitations des étudiants civils et des personnels du campus de Brest ;

  • Veiller au respect des procédures, à la confidentialité et à la tenue à jour des dossiers.

 

Activités annexes :

  • Elaborer des tableaux de bords pour les enquêtes, statistiques et bilans

  • Actualisation des dossiers élèves dans le SI de scolarité.

  • Participer à la démarche Qualité de l’établissement ;

  • Contribuer à la démarche RSE dans le cadre de ses missions et de ses activités au sein de l’Ecole.

 

Niveau de diplôme et formations :

Bac à Bac+2 en gestion administrative, gestion des ressources humaines ou dans un domaine équivalent, avec une expérience professionnelle similaire. Une expérience dans des environnements liés à l'enseignement supérieur et/au ministère des armées serait un plus.

 

 Emploi :

Poste ouvert aux candidats :

  • Fonctionnaire de catégorie C - RIFSEEP 1

  • Agent contractuel de catégorie C (emploi pérenne ; CDD de 1 à 3 ans renouvelable) CDI possible après 2 ans de CDD

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation « SECRET »

 

Durée d’affectation souhaitée : 3 à 5 ans

Date de prise de fonctions prévue : 1er novembre 2026

Rémunération :

  • Fonctionnaires : selon les conditions statutaires (grille indiciaire, IFSE, CIA)

  • Contractuels : en fonction de l'expérience professionnelle sur des postes de niveau équivalent

Lieu de travail :

ENSTA Campus de Brest,

« Le site est accessible en voiture (parking pour le personnel) ou en transports en commun. L’Ecole étant engagée dans une démarche RSE (DD-RS et employeur pro-vélo), elle encourage aux mobilités douces par la mise en place de dispositif d’aide financière (FMD) et des infrastructures adaptées aux cyclistes ».

Poste à temps complet (25 jours de congés annuels, 23 RTT annuels)

Avantages :

  • Transports (participation forfaitaire de l’employeur à hauteur de 75 %)

  • Forfait mobilité durable (jusqu’à 300€/an)

  • Possibilité de télétravail (après période d’essai et après accord du manager et dépôt d’une demande)

  • Subvention employeur au restaurant administratif et/ou à la cafétéria de l’établissement

  • Comité d’action sociale, avec notamment des événements et animations proposés au personnel, salle de sport sur adhésion,

  • Mutuelle (participation à hauteur de 50% de l’établissement)

Aménagement du poste de travail et recrutement inclusif :

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux candidats en situation de handicap.

ENSTA s’engage à un recrutement favorisant l’égalité, la diversité et l’inclusion. Toutes les candidatures sans aucune distinction (âge, handicap, sexe, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle…) ont leur place dans notre processus de recrutement.

 

 Présentation de l’Ecole :

 

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

 

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

 

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.


Profil attendu :

 

Connaissances :

  • Règles et méthodes de gestion administrative

  • Expression écrite et orale en français et anglais

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de l’enseignement supérieur

  • Organisation et fonctionnement de la DGA

 

 

Savoir-faire :

  • Savoir appliquer les dispositions réglementaires

  • Être à l’aise avec les systèmes d’information

  • Être à l’aise avec les logiciels de bureautique

  • Savoir analyser et synthétiser des informations

  • Utiliser les techniques de rédaction administrative

  • Savoir appliquer les règles, protocoles et procédures

  • Savoir planifier son temps et s’organiser de manière méthodique

 

Savoir-être :

  • Discrétion professionnelle

  • Sens des relations humaines

  • Curiosité

  • Autonomie

  • Travail en équipe

  • Rigueur et organisation

jobs.description:
Montréal, Québec (Canada) | Recrutement international

Cette opportunité est destinée aux personnes résidant à l'extérieur du Canada et souhaitant s'établir à Montréal.

 

À propos de nous

Basée à Montréal, avec des bureaux à Québec et Nantes, nous accompagnons depuis plus de 20 ans de grandes organisations canadiennes et françaises dans la conception et l'évolution de leurs plateformes de données.

Rejoindre agileDSS, c'est intégrer une équipe à taille humaine où l'expertise technique, le partage de connaissances et l'esprit collaboratif occupent une place centrale.

Vous interviendrez sur des mandats variés de :

·       Conception de plateformes Data Lake et Lakehouse ;

·       Analytique avancée et projets liés à l'intelligence artificielle ;

·       Gouvernance et qualité des données.

 

Nos consultants collaborent avec des organisations ayant déjà plusieurs années de maturité Cloud, disposant de plateformes de données à grande échelle et investissant dans des initiatives stratégiques portées par leurs directions Data.
