·       Concevoir et développer des pipelines de données dans l'écosystème AWS ;

·       Mettre en œuvre des processus d'ingestion, de transformation et de stockage des données ;

·       Participer à la conception d'architectures Data Lake et Data Lakehouse ;

·       Exploiter et optimiser les services AWS liés à la donnée ;

·       Assurer la qualité, la sécurité et la traçabilité des données ;

·       Collaborer avec les architectes, développeurs et équipes métiers ;

·       Participer aux activités d'automatisation et de déploiement ;

·       Optimiser la performance et les coûts des solutions développées ;

·       Contribuer aux meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie de données.

 


Profil recherché

Expérience

·       Minimum 4 ans d'expérience en ingénierie de données ;

·       Expérience significative sur AWS ;

·       Expérience en environnement Big Data ou Cloud Data Platform.

 

Compétences techniques

·       AWS Glue ;

·       S3 ;

·       Lambda ;

·       Athena ;

·       Redshift et/ou Snowflake ;

·       Python ;

·       SQL ;

·       Airflow ou autre outil d'orchestration ;

·       Git et CI/CD.

Atouts

·       Databricks sur AWS ;

·       dbt ;

·       Terraform ;

·       Kafka ;

·       Certifications AWS.

 

Langues

·       Français courant ;

·       Niveau d'anglais permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des clients, partenaires et collègues dans un environnement bilingue.

 

Savoir-être

Nous recherchons une personne :

·       Passionnée par les technologies Data et Cloud ;

·       À l'aise dans un environnement de consultation ;

·       Reconnue pour sa collaboration et son autonomie ;

·       Motivée par un projet de mobilité internationale vers le Québec.

jobs.description: Ti piace lavorare con precisione, seguendo l'installazione elettromeccanica di macchinari? Cerchi un'opportunità in cui mettere in pratica le tue competenze tecniche? Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito meccanico, meccatronico ed elettromeccanico. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda cliente del settore di robotica e automazione, selezioniamo un: TECNICO SERVICE ELETTRICO Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? La risorsa sarà inserita all'interno di un contesto dinamico e coinvolgente e si occuperà di: Installazione e manutenzione degli impianti presso i clienti; Cablaggio e assemblaggio di componenti elettrici; Lavoro in squadra e, quando necessario, in autonomia; Interventi in cantiere con trasferte giornaliere o di più giorni su tutto il territorio italiano (sabato e domenica esclusi). Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Diploma tecnico o qualifica professionale in ambito elettrico; Comprovata competenza nel cablaggio e nella manutenzione elettrica; Manualità e precisione; Disponibilità a trasferte su territorio nazionale; Gradita esperienza pregressa in ruoli similari. Ti riconosci in queste caratteristiche? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Orario di lavoro: Da lunedì a venerdì, con trasferte giornaliere o di 2-3 giorni sul territorio nazionale. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con assunzione diretta da parte dell'azienda, a tempo indeterminato. jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz procedur operacyjnych.

znajomość technologii firmy Fortinet (w szczególności FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail);

doświadczenie w pracy z systemami monitoringu (preferowany Zabbix);

jobs.title: Inspektor / Inspektorka ds. techniczno-remontowych
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Twój zakres obowiązków:
1. Opracowywanie planów remontowych dla zasobów Spółdzielni.
2. Kontrola terminowości obowiązkowych przeglądów technicznych budynków (rocznych i pięcioletnich) wynikających z Prawa Budowlanego (instalacje gazowe, przewody kominowe, instalacje elektryczne, dźwigi osobowe) oraz prowadzenie Książek Obiektów Budowlanych (KOB).
3. Sporządzanie wycen, kosztorysów, przedmiarów robót i specyfikacji warunków zamówienia (SWZ) oraz przygotowywanie zapytań ofertowych, analiza i porównywanie ofert od wykonawców.
4. Bieżący nadzór nad jakością i terminowością prac firm zewnętrznych, uczestnictwo w odbiorach technicznych oraz rozliczanie wykonanych robót.
5. Zlecanie, nadzorowanie i odbieranie bieżących zadań realizowanych przez wewnętrzny zespół konserwatorów.
6. Kontrola i weryfikacja zgodności stanu nieruchomości z wymogami Spółdzielni (w tym przeprowadzanie wizji lokalnych w terenie).
7. Rozpatrywanie wniosków mieszkańców, wydawanie warunków technicznych oraz zgód na remonty.
8. Analiza zużycia ciepła w budynkach oraz inicjowanie korekt mocy zamówionej.
9. Okresowy zdalny odczyt wodomierzy (2 razy w roku).
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: średnie ogólnokształcące - konieczne
- inne zawody: Inspektor nadzoru budowlanego - konieczne
- pozostałe: Nasze wymagania
Wykształcenie średnie lub wyższe (preferowane profile: budowlane, instalacyjne lub techniczne).
Uprawnienia budowlane będą dodatkowym atutem (nie są warunkiem koniecznym).
Brak przeciwwskazań zdrowotnych do pracy na wysokości (powyżej 3 metrów).

jobs.title: Dintero – Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Dintero -- Senior Backend Engineer

Location: Oslo

Contact/Application: Application@yourheadway.no

Your Headway is recruiting for Dintero.

Senior backend engineer? Build payment infrastructure handling 150M+ API calls every month . At Dintero, you are not working on the edges of a product. You build core systems where failure has real consequences .

We develop and operate the entire platform ourselves and control the full payment flow. This gives us deep technical ownership, real responsibility, and engineers who influence architecture, not just implementation.

Dintero operates in a space that is complex in two dimensions:

  • Technical complexity -- distributed systems, high throughput, strict uptime requirements

  • Regulatory complexity -- payment schemes, compliance, auditability, and financial correctness


We are also at the forefront of innovation in the payment space:

  • First to implement Passkeys with Mastercard

  • Early adopters of real-time clearing APIs

  • First new acquirer in Norway in over 20 years

This is a role for engineers who want to work on serious backend systems that must work, every time .

Production at Scale

  • 150M+ API calls per month

  • 10 senior engineers -- small team, high ownership

  • Infrastructure designed for high availability and robust transaction flows

What You Will Work On

  • Design and own backend services end-to-end

  • Build APIs used directly by merchants and partners

  • Make architectural decisions with long-term impact

  • Work with scalability, observability, and operational quality

  • Ship to production frequently and take ownership of what you build

In short: less coordination, more engineering.

Tech Stack

Deliberate choices. Minimal hype.

  • AWS (Fargate, Lambda, DynamoDB, Aurora)

  • Microservices

  • Node.js and TypeScript

  • Infrastructure as Code

  • API-first

We value sound engineering decisions over chasing trends.

Your Profile

You have experience working with complex systems in production.

  • 5+ years of backend development experience

  • Experience with distributed systems and architectural trade-offs

  • Comfortable owning systems end-to-end

  • Experience where reliability, correctness, or compliance matter

  • Cloud experience (Preferably AWS)

Scandinavian language (Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish) is a plus, but not required.

This Role Is a Strong Fit If You Have Worked With

  • Payment systems or financial infrastructure

  • High-throughput APIs or event-driven systems

  • Systems with strict uptime, latency, or consistency requirements

  • Regulated domains (fintech, banking, etc.)

This Role Is Likely Not Right If You

  • Prefer frontend-focused work

  • Want heavy processes and multiple decision layers

  • Prefer narrowly defined tasks over ownership

We are intentionally a small team. Everyone contributes to core decisions.

Why Dintero

  • Real ownership of critical systems

  • Strong engineering culture -- good ideas win

  • Short decision paths

  • Work that has direct real-world impact

  • A financially solid fintech company with strong growth

Compensation

  • Competitive salary (aligned with Tekna levels)

  • Stock options

Engineers building the platform should share in the value creation.

Recruitment Process

Dintero is partnering with Your Headway AS for this recruitment.

jobs.title: Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:

Applied Scientist, SCOT FO Science and Tech
Job ID: 10522151 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

How does Amazon decide which fulfillment center ships your order, which truck carries it, and how to keep promise, across hundreds of millions of packages daily? SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (FO) owns the science behind these decisions. We are seeking Applied Scientists to join the FO Science & Tech team in Luxembourg (alternatively: Barcelona, or London). You will design and build optimization models that power Amazon's fulfillment decisions at scale from real-time order assignment and multi-objective cost-speed tradeoffs to capacity-aware control systems that steer millions of shipments per hour toward operational plans.

Basic qualifications

• PhD in Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience)
• Strong programming skills (Python preferred; experience with optimization solvers a plus)
• Research experience in one or more:
• Large-scale mathematical programming (LP, MIP, decomposition methods)
• Combinatorial optimization (assignment, scheduling, network flows)
• Multi-objective optimization and control

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building optimization systems that run in production at scale
• Being comfortable with ambiguity and fast iteration cycles
• Publications in relevant venues

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement optimization models (MIP, heuristics, decomposition) that solve large-scale fulfillment problems, from order assignment to network flow control. Build research prototypes end-to-end: from problem formulation through scalable implementation to production validation. Analyse complex tradeoffs (cost, speed, capacity) and translate findings into actionable recommendations for leadership and operations teams. Collaborate with engineers to bring science solutions into production systems serving millions of customer orders daily.

A day in the life

You formulate an optimization problem on a whiteboard with teammates, then prototype it in Python with real data by the afternoon. You run experiments against production-scale datasets, iterate on the model, and present results to stakeholders who will use them to make network decisions next week. Some days you dive deep into solver performance; other days you're explaining a Pareto frontier to an operations leader. You collaborate with large engineering and product teams to bring your solutions into systems serving millions of customers. Alongside fast-turnaround prototypes, you own long-term research bets, the kind that reshape how Amazon's fulfillment network operates at scale. Your work goes live.

About the team

SCOT Fulfillment Optimization Science & Tech (FO SnT) is the applied research team behind Amazon's fulfillment decision-making systems. We decide how orders get assigned to warehouses, how capacity is allocated across the network, and how cost and speed tradeoffs are managed in real time, at global scale. Our models influence billions of euros in annual operational spend. They protect sites from overload during peak, reduce transportation costs and CO2 emissions, and ensure customers receive their packages when promised. Leadership relies on our science to make investment decisions worth hundreds of millions. We are practitioners of large-scale optimization: MIP formulations, decomposition methods, approximation algorithms, and parallelisation. We use machine learning where it sharpens our decisions, including forecasting, learned heuristics, and multi-armed bandits. We pick the right tool for the problem, not the fashionable one. You will work alongside Senior and Principal scientists, and collaborate with Amazon Scholars and academic partners who bring frontier research into our applied problems. We code our prototypes to be production-ready and collaborate with large engineering teams to ship systems, not papers. Above all, we have fun solving hard real-world problems at real-world speed, failing, learning, and shipping along the way.

Basic Qualifications

• PhD
• Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
• Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
• Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience using Unix/Linux
• Experience in professional software development

We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

jobs.description:
Head of International Markets

Permanent contract

At HSBC, we're a trusted international organisation with a global customer base of around 39 million customers worldwide through a network that covers 62 countries and territories. In Europe, our ambition is to become the leading international wholesale bank and we need talent like you to help us meet our ambition. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top or in an exciting new direction - we offer opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

The HSBC Group in Luxembourg is a significant employer and operates several businesses including asset management, securities services, private banking and corporate banking.

By joining us, you'll help evolve and grow our private banking business.

What you will do:

Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer Luxembourg, you will define and execute the Bank's international business development and market corridor strategy in Asia, the Middle East, the UK and the US. Working closely with the Business Head and Relationship Managers, you will drive disciplined delivery of Net New Money (NNM) and revenue, while safeguarding segment and book purity and ensuring a consistently strong client experience. You will promote HSBC Private Bank Luxembourg as the Booking Centre of choice for HSBC PB's international clients, seeking diversification in Continental Europe. As a senior member within the Luxembourg Front Office management team, you will also be accountable for governance and risk management processes and provide supervisory oversight of business activities.

In this role, you will (but not limited to):

• Own retention and growth of a Luxembourg-based private banking portfolio sourced from key international markets (Asia, Middle East, UK and US).
• Drive deepening across investments, lending and deposits (where applicable), reducing attrition and ensuring appropriate booking governance and book purity for corridor-sourced relationships.
• Run disciplined sales management, including opportunity qualification, pricing/returns focus, and activity standards.
• Establish corridor-to-PBLU portfolio routines (pipeline, attrition watchlist, top-client plans, rebooking/booking exception management).
• Define, refresh and execute the International Markets strategy in close partnership with the Business Heads, including priority client segments, target industries, and value propositions.
• Build and execute PBLU awareness and adoption plan through structured engagement programmes (education series, immersion and exchange visits, regular follow-ups) to deepen understanding of PBLU's platform, offering and capabilities across other HSBC Private Bank booking centres and relevant HSBC lines of business.
• Deliver market financial targets (revenue, margin, profitability, cost-to-serve where applicable), monitor performance drivers (mix, pricing, attrition, productivity), and ensure transparent forecasting by high-quality management information.

You should apply if you have:

• Extensive experience in Private Banking Relationship Management and senior client-facing roles.
• Positive track record in business development and risk management.
• Strong, up-to-date understanding of the market landscape, peer product offering and industry innovation.
• Experience working with clients and teams across Asia, MENA, the UK and the US.
• Demonstrated ability to shape market strategy and multi-year business plans, including footprint/capability design and target setting.
• Strong commercial execution skills, including pipeline management, conversion discipline, pricing/returns focus.
• Strong stakeholder management skills across products, operations, risk, compliance and multiple geographies.
• Fluent English (written and spoken).

Even if you feel you do not meet 100% of our qualifications, we encourage you to apply, if you believe this role is right for you.

What you'll get in return:

The pay range for this role is EUR 155,700 - 233,600.

HSBC operates multiple variable pay plans, to reflect the diverse nature of the businesses, roles and markets in which we operate. Variable pay is designed to reward colleagues for their individual performance and contribution, as well as the performance of their relevant Business / Infrastructure, and the overall Group.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive package of benefits usually covering health support, life assurance, pension, and family friendly leaves, as well as many other benefits to support your wellbeing.

HSBC has been certified “Top Employer 2026” in Europe. This recognition from the Top Employers Institute rewards our HR practices and recognises HSBC as an HR Leader in France, Germany, Italy, Ireland, Luxembourg, The Netherlands, Poland and Spain.

If you're looking for a career where you will be respected as an individual and valued for the contributions you make, please visit our career page, and discover how diversity drives our success.

Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we're dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. If you have a need that requires accommodations or changes during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Please note that every selected candidate will have to provide us with a valid criminal record check in due time.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website. For any GDPR request, please send it to: lux.data.privacy@hsbc.com

For further information on building your career at HSBC, please visit: www.hsbc.com/careers

Junior Accountant

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Junior Accountant!
  
Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Being part of the team, you will:

• Be trained from your more experienced colleagues and assist with the accounting for a portfolio of local business clients consisting primarily of startups, large corporations, SMEs, family-owned businesses and self-employed individuals;
• Be responsible for the day-to-day bookkeeping and handle monthly, quarterly and annual declarations;
• Develop your technical, interpersonal and business skills which will be key to your success within our firm;
• Act as a trusted partner and advisor to your clients and your team.

This position is for you if:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting or Finance;
• You are a recent graduate or have ideally one year of accounting experience;
• You possess a solid understanding of local tax regulations and VAT;
• You are highly organized, detail-oriented and able to juggle multiple tasks simultaneously to meet deadlines;
• You are recognized for your analytical skills, technical expertise and sense of responsibility;
• You have excellent communication skills and are able to establish and develop good relationships with your colleagues and clients;
• You possess good knowledge of accounting software and MS Office;
• You are fluent in French or German with a good command of English; Luxembourgish is a plus.

What´s in it for you:

•  Competitive remuneration package including

- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),

• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

jobs.title: TECHNICIEN DE LABORATOIRE (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Votre mission :

Le technicien de laboratoire exerce sa fonction sous la responsabilité du médecin/biologiste chef de service et du cadre soignant chef d'unité.
Sur prescription médicale écrite préalable et dans un but de diagnostic, de traitement médical, de prévenir une maladie, il réalise ou contribue à la réalisation d'examens de laboratoire et ceci dans les domaines de biochimie clinique, d'hématologie, de bactériologie, de sérologie, d'immunopathologie, d'immunohématologie, d'immunogénétique, d'allergologie, de cytométrie, de cytogénétique, de biologie moléculaire et de biologie de procréation médicalement assistée.

Il produit des résultats pour permettre un diagnostic, un traitement médical, prévenir une maladie,….

Il procède aux prélèvements sanguins, participe aux programmes de recherche, assure la maintenance des automates et contribue à la formation des stagiaires et nouveaux collaborateurs.

Ses attributions sont décrites dans le règlement GD du 15 juillet 1969 (laborantin) et du 18 mars 1981 (ATM) ainsi que le règlement GD du 07 octobre 2010 sur le code de déontologie.

Vos tâches principales :

• Réaliser des actes techniques dans le respect des bonnes pratiques.
• Communiquer et rendre compte de ses actes.
• Valoriser la qualité des actes et contribuer à l'amélioration de la pratique professionnelle.
• Assurer la maintenance et la logistique liées aux actes de laboratoire.
• Former, accompagner et intégrer les nouveaux collaborateurs et les stagiaires.

        Votre profil :

• Autorisation d'exercer la profession d'ATM de laboratoire ou laborantin au Luxembourg.
• Connaissances linguistiques : Français, Luxembourgeois et Anglais technique.
• Connaissance et capacité d'utilisation de l'outil informatique.
• Compétences techniques : Compétences généralistes en biologie clinique

• Aptitudes professionnelles :

o respect de l'éthique et de la confidentialité
o faire preuve d'impartialité

• Aptitudes personnelles :

o sens relationnel développé, politesse, disponibilité, franchise
o travail en équipe, sens des responsabilités
o sens de l'ordre, rigueur et méthode, capacités d'organisation
o capacité d'adaptation aux nouveaux procédés d'analyse et volonté d'évolution
o sens des priorités, capacité à gérer les urgences et les situations de stress
o capacité d'analyse, esprit de synthèse, curiosité intellectuelle
o sens pédagogique.


Horaires : 6h-14h30, 7h-15h, 13h-21h. Gardes et disponibilité en fonction des besoins de service.

jobs.title: Responsable Administratif et financier RAF (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches


Responsable Administratif et Financier
Rattachement hiérarchique
Direction Générale


Contexte de l'entreprise:

Dans le cadre de la réorganisation opérationnelle et du futur départ de notre actuelle Directrice Administrative d'ici fin 2026, nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Administratif et Financier.

Dans notre environnement d'entreprise multiculturel (allemand, français, luxembourgeois) d'installation et maintenance HVAC, ce poste combine des fonctions de pilotage opérationnel, de contrôle de gestion rigoureux et de supervision transversale.


Missions et Responsabilités Clés:

Le/la RAF aura la responsabilité de superviser les quatre grands piliers de notre administration :

1. Management Général et Opérationnel

Assurer le pilotage de l'organisation administrative globale et le support au quotidien (informatique, événements, parc automobile, matériel).
Manager l'équipe de l'administration : piloter la répartition des tâches, assurer la montée en compétences et gérer les absences et suppléances.
Optimiser et digitaliser les processus internes, résoudre les problématiques inter-services et faire remonter (escalader) les points bloquants à la direction.
Fournir un support opérationnel à la direction générale par la préparation d'analyses, d'évaluations et de bases de décision.

2. Contrôle de Gestion, Finance & Audit

Piloter le contrôle de gestion des projets : analyser les écarts (coûts/recettes/marges), réviser les prévisions, valider les durées de projets et contrôler les coûts post-clôture.
Assurer l'interface entre la finance et le métier : aligner les données de la comptabilité avec la gestion de projet, et suivre les flux de trésorerie (garanties bancaires, retenues de garantie).
Coordonner de manière centrale l'audit financier avec notre auditeur externe (pré-audit de novembre et audit final en mars-avril), préparer les dossiers et justifier les données.

3. Supervision Comptable et RH (en binôme)

Encadrer la facturation régulière et en temps utile des clients.
Organiser les relances et suivre le bon recouvrement des factures clients.
Assurer les cycles de paiement (et la collecte systématique des escomptes fournisseurs).
Procéder au contrôle et à la validation finale des factures d'achat du département administratif.
Superviser l'administration RH : contrôler avec ses équipes les temps de travail avant l'envoi en paie, apporter un support à la rédaction de courriers/contrats RH, et faire l'interface avec le comité d'entreprise.
Fixer les grilles salariales annuelles, notamment pour la facturation des heures de projets.

4. Administration des Systèmes, Gérance Juridique, Services Généraux et Projets Transversaux

Gérer l'administration du système ERP (LABEL) : gérer les accès et les droits, effectuer les clôtures mensuelles et annuelles.
Assurer le suivi des engagements contractuels et la gestion globale des assurances (incluant le traitement des sinistres sur les chantiers et les bâtiments).
Assurer la supervision hiérarchique et le contrôle de la gestion du parc automobile (fleet management).
Piloter la qualité (norme ISO 9001) et mener des projets transversaux d'amélioration continue tels que la poursuite de la digitalisation de l'entreprise.


Profil et Qualités Requises:


Compétences Linguistiques:

En raison de la forte multiculturalité de notre entreprise et des interactions quotidiennes avec les différentes équipes, le profil recherché doit impérativement parler et comprendre l'allemand et le français.
La compréhension du luxembourgeois constitue un atout supplémentaire.


Expertise Technique (Hard Skills):

Solide formation et expérience avérée en gestion financière, contrôle de gestion (idéalement appliqué à la gestion de projets) et comptabilité.
Maîtrise des mécanismes de préparation et de justification lors d'audits financiers (ex. : relation avec des auditeurs).
Expérience dans l'administration des Ressources Humaines et le droit contractuel/gestion des assurances.
Forte aisance informatique avec les systèmes de type ERP (l'administration de logiciels type LABEL est un plus).


Savoir-être et Aptitudes (Soft Skills):

Excellente capacité managériale pour encadrer, coordonner et faire évoluer une équipe variée.
Esprit critique et excellente capacité d'analyse pour évaluer et challenger des données financières et économiques.
Sens aigu de l'organisation garantissant une stricte séparation des rôles entre l'exécution, le contrôle et la validation.
Excellentes compétences de communication inter-départements (capacité à lier les visions comptables, administratives et métier).

Contrôler les quantités d'asphalte produites, livrées et mises en œuvre.
Comparer les quantités prévues aux quantités réellement consommées.
Suivre les heures de main-d'œuvre et les heures machines.
Participer aux réunions de chantier lorsque nécessaire.
Vérifier la cohérence entre l'avancement physique et l'avancement financier.

Préparer les préfactures et assurer leur transmission aux clients.
Identifier les éventuels écarts entre les prévisions, les coûts réels et les prestations réalisées.
Assurer un suivi régulier des indicateurs liés à l'activité.


Structuration et amélioration des processus:

Participer à la mise en place et à la structuration des processus de suivi des coûts, des achats et des approvisionnements.
Contribuer à la mise en place d'outils de suivi et de contrôle adaptés aux besoins de l'activité.
Participer à l'amélioration des processus administratifs et opérationnels liés aux chantiers.
Identifier les éventuels besoins d'amélioration et proposer des solutions permettant d'optimiser le suivi des coûts et des ressources.

Bac+2 à Bac+5 en contrôle de gestion, gestion, génie civil, travaux publics, économie de la construction ou domaine similaire.

Une expérience en contrôle de gestion, travaux publics, chantier routier ou suivi de coûts est souhaitée.
Une bonne compréhension des processus de métré, chiffrage, calcul de coûts et facturation est un atout.

Organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers simultanément.

Autonomie et sens des responsabilités.
Bon relationnel et capacité à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs.
À l'aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes de gestion.
Capacité à travailler aussi bien sur le terrain qu'au bureau.

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:


Ingénieur en génie civil – Infrastructures, voirie, métrés et soumissions (m/f/d)


Vos missions:

Rejoignez une équipe multidisciplinaire composée d'ingénieurs, de techniciens, de dessinateurs-projeteurs et participez à la
préparation technique et économique de projets de génie civil, notamment dans les domaines de la voirie, des réseaux et des infrastructures.
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez amené(e) à :

• Analyser les plans et dossiers techniques
Étudier les plans, pièces techniques et données des projets afin d'identifier les prestations, quantités et éléments nécessaires à l'élaboration des dossiers de soumission.

• Établir les métrés et calculs de quantités
Réaliser et vérifier les métrés et calculs de quantités pour les travaux de terrassement, de voirie, de réseaux, de canalisations et d'aménagements extérieurs.

• Établir les estimations de coûts et les devis
Réaliser des estimations de coûts aux différentes phases des projets, établir des devis et contribuer au suivi et à l'optimisation économique des solutions proposées.

• Élaborer les bordereaux et cahiers des charges
Préparer et rédiger les bordereaux de soumission, cahiers des charges et descriptions techniques des travaux et prestations, en veillant à la précision et à la cohérence des documents.

• Préparer les dossiers de soumission
Constituer les documents techniques nécessaires aux appels d'offres et assurer leur cohérence avec les plans, métrés, bordereaux et autres pièces du projet.

• Participer à l'analyse des offres
Contribuer à l'analyse technique et, le cas échéant, économique des offres reçues, vérifier les prix et prestations proposés et participer à la comparaison des offres.

• Garantir la cohérence des documents techniques
Contrôler la concordance entre les plans, quantités, métrés, bordereaux, descriptions techniques et autres documents contractuels et identifier les éventuelles incohérences.

• Collaborer avec les équipes de projet
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs, dessinateurs-projeteurs et autres intervenants afin de garantir la qualité et la cohérence des dossiers

• Assurer le suivi des documents
Mettre à jour les métrés, bordereaux et autres documents techniques en fonction de l'évolution des études et des projets.

• Contribuer au développement de la division
Participer activement à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail, à la standardisation des documents, au partage des connaissances et au développement des compétences internes.


Votre profil:

• Formation : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur en génie civil ou d'une formation équivalente.

• Expérience professionnelle : Vous disposez d'une expérience dans le domaine des infrastructures, de la voirie et des réseaux ainsi que dans l'établissement de métrés, de bordereaux et de dossiers de soumission.

• Compétences en métrés et soumissions : Vous maîtrisez l'analyse de plans techniques, le calcul de quantités et l'élaboration de documents de soumission. Vous êtes particulièrement attentif(ve) à la cohérence entre les plans, les métrés, les bordereaux et les descriptions techniques.

• Compétences techniques: Vous disposez de bonnes connaissances dans les domaines de la voirie, des réseaux et des infrastructures et êtes à l'aise avec les travaux de terrassement, de canalisations et d'aménagements extérieurs.

• Outils informatiques: Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants, notamment Excel. La connaissance du logiciel ERGO pour l'élaboration des bordereaux de soumission constitue un atout, tout comme la maîtrise d'AutoCAD et d'autres logiciels utilisés dans le domaine du génie civil.

• Connaissance du contexte luxembourgeois : Une expérience des marchés publics et des procédures de soumission au Luxembourg constitue un avantage.

• Qualités personnelles : Vous travaillez de manière autonome, structurée et précise et disposez d'un bon esprit analytique.
Vous accordez une attention particulière à la qualité et à la cohérence des quantités, des plans et des documents contractuels.
Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes capable de collaborer efficacement avec les différents acteurs d'un projet.

• Langues : Vous maîtrisez le français à l'oral et à l'écrit. La connaissance de l'allemand et/ou du luxembourgeois constitue un atout.


Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

• Rejoignez une équipe multidisciplinaire engagée et passionnée, impliquée dans des projets de génie civil, de voirie et d'infrastructures de différentes envergures au Luxembourg.

• Bénéficiez d'une réelle autonomie dans l'organisation de votre travail et prenez progressivement davantage de responsabilités.

• Des opportunités pour évoluer tant sur le plan personnel que professionnel


Notre offre:

Un métier varié et intéressant, avec un grand potentiel de développement personnel, au sein d'une société en pleine croissance et
une ambiance conviviale. Vous évoluez au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire et motivée. Après une initiation encadrée, vous assurez
vos missions de manière autonome.

• Projets passionnants et variés  
• Formations professionnelles  
• Horaires de travail flexibles  
• Régime de retraite d'entreprise  
• Stationnement aisé à proximité  
• Contrat à durée indéterminée et à temps plein  
• Rémunération compétitive  
• Télétravail
• Carte - Chèques repas

Rejoignez notre équipe et participez avec nous à la création de projets d'urbanisme durables et innovants !
Nous sommes impatients de découvrir votre candidature !

jobs.employer: BEST Ingénieurs - Conseils, Bureau d'Etudes Et De Services Techniques Ingénieurs-Conseils, Sàrl
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:


Vos missions:

Rejoignez une équipe multidisciplinaire composée d'ingénieurs, de techniciens, de planificateurs et de chefs de projet et participez à la conception et à la réalisation de projets d'infrastructure au Luxembourg.

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

• Planifier les infrastructures et réseaux souterrains Vous concevez et coordonnez les infrastructures souterraines telles que
les réseaux d'eaux usées et d'eaux pluviales ainsi que les réseaux de distribution d'eau potable, de gaz, d'électricité et de
télécommunication, en tenant compte des réseaux existants et des contraintes locales.
• Planifier les projets d'infrastructure en 3D
Vous développez les réseaux et conduites souterrains dans le cadre d'une planification 3D coordonnée, en tenant compte
notamment des altimétries, des pentes, des profondeurs de couverture, des distances de sécurité, des croisements et des
autres contraintes techniques.
• Élaborer les plans de conception et d'exécution
Vous développez les projets depuis la phase de conception jusqu'aux études d'exécution et établissez les plans de situation,
profils en long et en travers, coupes, plans de détail et modèles 3D nécessaires.
• Coordonner les conduites et réseaux
Vous assurez la coordination entre les différents réseaux d'assainissement et réseaux divers, identifiez
suffisamment tôt les éventuels conflits et croisements et développez des solutions techniquement réalisables.
• Analyser et intégrer les données existantes
Vous analysez les données topographiques, les modèles de terrain, les réseaux existants et autres données
techniques et les intégrez dans la planification.
• Collaborer avec les équipes de projet
Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs, techniciens, chefs de projet et autres spécialistes
afin d'assurer une planification coordonnée des différentes infrastructures.
• Garantir la qualité de la planification
Vous veillez à l'exactitude technique, à la précision et à la cohérence des plans et modèles 3D et assurez leur
mise à jour en fonction de l'avancement des projets.


Votre profil:

• Formation : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de technicien ou d'ingénieur dans le domaine du génie civil, des
travaux publics ou des infrastructures, ou d'une qualification technique équivalente.
• Expérience professionnelle : Vous disposez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans la planification
d'infrastructures, de réseaux d'assainissement et/ou de réseaux divers. Vos connaissances pratiques en matière de
planification 3D et de coordination des réseaux souterrains constituent un élément essentiel de votre profil.
• Expérience en planification 3D des infrastructures : Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée dans la planification 3D des
réseaux souterrains d'assainissement et de distribution et êtes capable de coordonner spatialement les différents réseaux,

jobs.title: Junior National Funding Advisor – Innovation & Sustainability Grants (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Fixed-term contract (CDD – 24 months), full-time, ref.: JNF09
Service: National Funding
Hierarchical Superior: Head of National Funding

About Luxinnovation
Luxinnovation is Luxembourg's national innovation agency. As a semi-public institution set up as an Economic Interest Group (GIE), we empower companies to innovate today to be ready for tomorrow. We also contribute to the development of the economy as a whole by identifying innovation opportunities and fostering collaborative innovation projects that stimulate the development of a sustainable, competitive and digital economy.
Luxinnovation is supported by three ministries — the Ministry of the Economy, the Ministry for Research and Higher Education, and the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs — as well as three semi-public institutions: the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce, the Luxembourg Chamber of Skilled Crafts, and FEDIL – The Voice of Luxembourg's Industry.

Job mission
Department description
One of Luxinnovation's core activities is to support companies seeking national funding for their innovation activities and sustainability investments. The mission of the National Funding team is to guide and support companies throughout the process of applying for innovation and environmental state aid, ensuring they access the right instruments at the right time.
Job description
As a Junior National Funding Advisor, you will reinforce the National Funding team in the context of increased demand for innovation funding and decarbonisation grants. You will provide first-level guidance to companies, support eligibility assessments and contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities — including the AI Factory initiative and environmental aid schemes.
You will progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes under the mentorship of experienced advisors.

Main tasks and responsibilities
Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:
Inspire:
• Contribute to the promotion of national funding opportunities by supporting the planning, coordination and delivery of awareness campaigns, workshops and events, particularly in relation to emerging environmental and AI aid schemes.
• Assist the National Funding team in knowledge-sharing activities and continuous improvement initiatives that contribute to the team's effectiveness and visibility.
Assess & Accelerate:
• Under the guidance of experienced advisors, participate in client meetings and support the preliminary assessment of companies seeking public funding for research, innovation and sustainability projects, including conducting eligibility checks and due diligence reviews.
• Support the review of funding applications by analysing project descriptions, financial statements, investment plans and supporting documentation, and contribute to the preparation of internal decision-support documents for Gate 1 and Gate 2 reviews.
Connect:
• Manage and qualify incoming client requests on a daily basis, with a particular focus on opportunities related to the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes, ensuring timely orientation towards relevant support services.
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the customer relationship management (CRM) system and other internal tools, ensuring high-quality data management and effective follow-up of client interactions.
Fund:
• Provide first-level guidance to companies on available state aid instruments for innovation and sustainability, including the AI Factory initiative and environmental/decarbonisation funding schemes.
• Collaborate closely with senior members of the National Funding team to address more complex client enquiries and progressively develop expertise across funding instruments, eligibility criteria and application processes.
• Contribute to the preparation of client feedback and internal decision-support documents under the supervision of senior advisors.
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Holder of a master's degree (bac+5 in the French university system) in economics, finance, business management, engineering or a dual scientific/management profile.
• Previous internship or professional experience of 1 to 2 years in an activity related to innovation funding, business consulting, financial analysis or state aid.
Specific competencies:
• Good skills in financial analysis and the ability to assess investment plans and business documentation.
• Strong writing skills and the ability to produce clear summary notes and decision-support documents.
• General knowledge of project management principles.
• Ability to manage several complex files efficiently and independently.
• Relational ease allowing effective interaction with partners at relevant ministries, financial institutions and business managers.
• Organised, flexible, autonomous with excellent listening and analytical skills.
• Interest in innovation ecosystems, decarbonisation and sustainability funding.
Languages:
• Fluent French and English (oral and written) are mandatory. Luxembourgish and/or German are considered a strong asset.
IT skills:
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel in particular).
• Familiarity with CRM tools and internal data management platforms.

Why choose this position?
Join a human-sized, multidisciplinary organisation where you will learn to carry out eligibility assessments using solid procedures, tools and databases. You will be part of a team with a strong team spirit and a culture of information sharing, with direct exposure to Luxembourg's innovation ecosystem. This role offers diversified and rewarding missions — from analysing state aid applications to participating in events on cutting-edge technology — giving you the opportunity to build a solid foundation in innovation funding and public support instruments.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!
Please note that this position is based at our current offices in Esch-Belval. Luxinnovation GIE will relocate to the Luxembourg main station area in the first quarter of 2027.

Department description
The National Business Relationship Department works directly with Luxembourg-based companies — from SMEs to large enterprises — to identify their innovation needs, connect them to the right support services and accelerate their growth. The department acts as the primary interface between the business ecosystem and Luxinnovation's programmes, funding instruments and expert networks.
Job description
As an Agrifood Innovation & Business Relationship Advisor, you will serve as the main point of contact for agrifood companies in Luxembourg, identifying their needs and contributing to the digitalisation and decarbonisation of the sector. You will work closely with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture and relevant sector-specific associations to support SMEs and large companies in their innovation journey toward sustainable agriculture and food innovation.
You will map the agrifood ecosystem, build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and ensure that companies benefit from tailored Luxinnovation services, R&D collaborations and national or European funding opportunities.

Your responsibilities are structured around Luxinnovation's four core pillars of activity:

Inspire:

• Understand companies' innovation needs and assess how Luxinnovation's services align with their requirements

• Translate business needs into actionable strategies that accelerate the transition toward digital and sustainable practices in the agrifood value chain
Connect:
• Develop and lead a network by connecting agrifood organisations, research centres and businesses to foster innovation and collaboration
• Facilitate strategic partnerships by linking companies with the right agrifood solutions and ensuring effective service delivery through client relationship management (CRM)
• Build and nurture relationships by ensuring ongoing engagement, satisfaction and a clear overview of all ongoing activities through continuous follow-up
• Enhance collaboration by connecting stakeholders and aligning ecosystem services across the agrifood sector
Fund:
• Help companies access State aid, R&D collaborations and adoption programmes related to the agrifood sector
• Strengthen engagement with companies to enhance their access to national and European agrifood support mechanisms
• Increase the number of agrifood companies accompanied by Luxinnovation in their innovation journey
• Improve the conversion rate from initial meetings to the adoption of Luxinnovation services
• Expand outreach to new companies to raise awareness and encourage engagement with innovation funding instruments
This list is not exhaustive. Additional tasks may be assigned to the holder of the job.

You will act as a key bridge between national/European initiatives and the Luxembourg business ecosystem, driving innovation and sustainable growth.

Required competencies
Education level and professional experience required:
• Master's degree in engineering, agrifood sciences, business or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of professional experience in the agrifood sector, bioeconomy, business development, consulting or ecosystem coordination
Specific competencies:
• Strong understanding of agrifood challenges, including decarbonisation, circular economy, digitalisation and sustainable agriculture
• Deep insight into how innovative strategies and sector-specific workflows can accelerate the transition toward digital and sustainable practices
• Analytical skills to gather, document and prioritise business requirements and translate them into actionable strategies
• Excellent communication and networking skills, with the ability to build relationships across agrifood value chains
• Comfortable speaking in front of large audiences, engaging them effectively and tailoring presentations to specific audiences
• Adaptability in evolving environments, with a positive, problem-solving attitude and the ability to work autonomously, take initiative and drive solutions with confidence
• Dynamic, results-oriented and proactive — ready to take ownership and drive change
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Languages:
Fluency in French, English and Luxembourgish or German is required.
IT skills:
Proficiency with standard office tools (MS Office suite). Familiarity with CRM platforms is an asset.

Why choose this position?
This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of Luxembourg's agrifood innovation ecosystem from within its national innovation agency. You will play a pivotal role in connecting agrifood SMEs and large companies to the resources, partnerships and funding they need to accelerate their digital and sustainable transformation.
You will work at the crossroads of policy, industry and research — collaborating with the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Viticulture, sector associations and European networks. Your impact will be tangible: every company you accompany, every partnership you broker and every workgroup you lead will contribute directly to building a more competitive and sustainable agrifood sector in Luxembourg.
You will join a collaborative, forward-looking team that values autonomy, initiative and professional growth — in an environment where your ideas can translate into real, ecosystem-wide change.

Application
Interested candidates are invited to submit online their resume and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience and motivation for the role.
AI-generated applications might not be the best way to stand out. Show us the real you, and let's see where this journey takes us!

About the LCSB
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Luxembourg Centre for Systems Biomedicine (LCSB) is an interdisciplinary research centre of the University of Luxembourg.
We conduct fundamental and translational research in the field of Systems Biology and Biomedicine – in the lab, in the clinic and in silico. We focus on neurodegenerative processes and are especially interested in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease and their contributing factors. The LCSB recruits talented scientists from various disciplines: computer scientists, mathematicians, biologists, chemists, engineers, physicists and clinicians from more than 50 countries currently work at the LCSB. We excel because we are truly interdisciplinary, and together we contribute to science and society.

Your role
We seek a highly motivated software developer to join a FNR JUMP-funded project translating a validated suite of bioinformatics software tools into CausalOmics, an integrated software platform for causal analysis of omics data. The platform identifies root causal genes and candidate drug targets from multi-omics datasets.
The candidate will contribute to the further development of the unified, point-and-click user interface, implement interactive visualization frameworks for complex biological networks, and develop the core platform architecture that connects the analysis modules, spanning preprocessing, network and pathway analysis, causal reasoning, drug target assessment, and machine learning, through robust APIs.
Further responsibilities include setting up the cloud deployment infrastructure (SaaS architecture, REST API) and ensuring the platform is scalable, reproducible, and accessible to users without coding or bioinformatics expertise. The role is closely linked to the CausalOmics go-to-market project, and the candidate will work directly with the project's principal investigator and its interdisciplinary bioinformatics and business development team.
This position is offered with the explicit intent that the successful candidate may take on the role of Chief Technology Officer (CTO) / Lead Developer of the planned CausalOmics spin-off company after incorporation.

Your profile
• A degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field: MSc or equivalent; PhD an advantage
• Proven experience in full-stack web development, including front-end frameworks and back-end/API design
• Experience with interactive data visualization and building user-friendly, no-code interfaces for complex analytical workflows
• Familiarity with cloud deployment (SaaS architectures, REST APIs, CI/CD) is highly advantageous
• An interest in, or prior exposure to, bioinformatics or biomedical data is a plus but not required
• Strong software architecture and code quality skills, including experience with scalable, modular system design
• Cross-disciplinary aptitude, strong organizational and interpersonal skills, and interest in a translational, commercially oriented research environment
• Excellent command in English

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

Key responsibilities

Are you well-versed in various investment vehicles? Do you want to play an important role in delivering first class execution services that lays our bank for everything we do? Are you a motivated team-player with a keen eye for details? Are you analytical and thrive in high-pressure environment?

We're looking for a Execution Trader to:

We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback.

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

jobs.title: POMOĆNI RADNIK / POMOĆNA RADNICA ZA NJEGU, SKRB I PRATNJU,  NA ODREĐENO I NEPUNO RADNO VRIJEME (30 SATI TJEDNO) DO 30.06.2027. GODINE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) i članka 52. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Župa dubrovačka“, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića „Župa dubrovačka“ na 30. sjednici održanoj 24. rujna 2026. godine raspisuje

N A T J E Č A J

ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA

za obavljanje poslova za radno mjesto :

  • POMOĆNI RADNIK ZA NJEGU, SKRB I PRATNJU (m/ž) - 1 izvršitelj/ica na određeno i nepuno radno vrijeme (30 sati tjedno) do 30.06.2027. godine

Mjesto rada: Vukovarska 48, Srebreno, 20207 MLINI

UVJETI za radno mjesto:

- kvalifikacija razine 4.1 stečena završetkom strukovnog obrazovanja u trajanju od tri godine

- utvrđena zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova

- probni rad od dva mjeseca

Sukladno:

- Zakonu o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22 i 101/23, 145/24, 146/25, 22/26) - Pravilniku o unutarnjem ustrojstvu i načinu rada Dječjeg vrtića „Župa dubrovačka“

  • Pravilnik o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja ( NN 145/2024, 62/2025)

Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Prijava na natječaj (vlastoručno potpisana) treba obavezno sadržavati priloge:

  • Životopis
  • Dokaz o državljanstvu
  • Dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  • Potvrdu iz elektroničke baze podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radno pravnom statusu, ne stariju od mjesec dana od objave natječaja;
  • Izjava kandidata da za prijem u radni odnos ne postoje zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, (vlastoručno potpisana)
  • Dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju;
    • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od mjesec dana od objave natječaja;
    • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi prekršajni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju ne starije od mjesec dana od objave natječaja;
    • potvrdu nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjeru za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda sukladno čl. 25. st. 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), ne stariju od mjesec dana od objave natječaja
    • Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenom presliku, a prije izbora kandidata predočit će se izvornik ili ovjereni preslik isprava.

Kandidati su dužni priložiti dokaz o promjeni prezimena/imena ukoliko je došlo do promjene u odnosu na priloženu dokumentaciju.

Sukladno članku 13. stavku 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine broj 82/08., 125/11., 20/12., 138/12. i 69/17.) na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova. Izrazi koji se koriste u tekstu ovog natječaja, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol.

Kandidat koji je stekao obrazovnu kvalifikaciju u inozemstvu dužan je priložiti rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije u skladu s posebnim zakonom kojim se uređuje priznavanje inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija za obavljanje reguliranih profesija u Republici Hrvatskoj.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21, 13/26) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 102. stavaka 1. – 3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf (kopirati link)

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos.

Da bi kandidat ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, osoba iz članka 48. stavaka 1. – 2. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21,13/26) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf (kopirati link)

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Dokaz o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom iz članka 13. navedenog Zakona.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dječji vrtić može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka EU 2016/679 i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine 42/18).

Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podatka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Rok za podnošenje prijave kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja.

jobs.title: NASTAVNIK/NASTAVNICA PSIHOLOGIJE
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine, broj 87/08., 86/09., 92/10., 105/10. – Ispravak, 90/11., 16/12., 86/12., 94/13., 152/14., 7/17., 68/18., 98/19., 64/20., 151/22. i 156/23.), GAUDEAMUS, prva privatna srednja škola u Osijeku s pravom javnosti Osijek, Vladimira Preloga 1, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa Nastavnik (m/ž) koji obavlja poslove nastavnika/ce psihologije – jedan izvršitelj/ica – određeno nepuno radno vrijeme (2 sata neposrednog odgojno-obrazovnog rada, odnosno 4 sata tjedno) uz probni rok od 6 mjeseci. Uz opći uvjet za zasnivanje radnog odnosa propisan Zakonom o radu (Narodne novine, broj 93/14., 127/17., 98/19., 151/22. i 64/23.), kandidati/kinje trebaju ispunjavati uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi i uvjete propisane Pravilnikom o stručnoj spremi i pedagoško-psihološkom obrazovanju nastavnika u srednjem školstvu (Narodne novine, broj 1/96. i 80/99.). PREDNOST: edukacija iz NLP-a, mindfulness Prijavi treba priložiti: – životopis s navedenom adresom elektroničke pošte, – dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi/završenom obrazovanju, – dokaz o državljanstvu, – uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak za kaznena djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja), – elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka HZMO-a (ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja). Prijavu na natječaj potrebno je vlastoručno potpisati, a isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici, osim uvjerenja o nekažnjavanju. Prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa odabrani kandidat/kinja predočit će izvornik. Na oglašeno radno mjesto mogu se javiti osobe oba spola. S kandidatima/kinjama prijavljenim na natječaj koji/e su pravodobno dostavili/e potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama, a ispunjavaju uvjete javnog natječaja, provest će se testiranja. Termin testiranja bit će objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole https://gaudeamus.hr/dokumenti najkasnije 3 dana prije provođenja ili će se poslati kandidatima/kinjama elektroničkom poštom ili telefonski. Kandidat/kinja koji/a ne pristupi testiranju smatrat će se da je povukao/la prijavu. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati/kinje daju privolu da Gaudeamus, prva privatna srednja škola u Osijeku s pravom javnosti, kao voditelj zbirke podataka, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati osobne podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka u skladu sa zakonskim odredbama. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom dostaviti elektroničkom poštom na gimnazija@gaudeamus.hr Kandidat/kinja koji/a je stekao/la inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužan/na je u prijavi na natječaj priložiti rješenje određenog visokog učilišta o priznavanju potpune istovrijednosti u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija (Narodne novine, broj 158/03., 198/03., 138/06. i 45/11.) ili rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje o stručnom priznavanju inozemne visokoškolske kvalifikacije u skladu sa Zakonom o priznavanju inozemnih obrazovnih kvalifikacija (Narodne novine, broj 158/03., 198/03., 138/06. i 45/11.) te u skladu sa Zakonom o reguliranim profesijama i priznavanju inozemnih stručnih kvalifikacija (Narodne novine, broj 82/15., 70/19., 47/20. i 123/23.) rješenje Ministarstva znanosti i obrazovanja o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije radi pristupa reguliranoj profesiji. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Škole. O rezultatima izbora kandidati/kinje će biti obaviješteni na mrežnoj stranici škole u zakonskom roku.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 22/26), a po odluci Upravnog vijeća Dječjeg vrtića Medvjedići Rugvica donesenoj na 18. sjednici, donosi O D L U K U o raspisivanju natječaja za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta pet (5) izvršitelj/ica za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta: ODGOJITELJ/ICA NATJEČAJ ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA NA NEODREĐENO VRIJEME S PUNIM RADNIM VREMENOM UVJETI za radno mjesto su: - prema čl. 24. i čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26) - ne starije od dana objave natječaja 5.Uvjerenje da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak za neki od prekršaja navedenih u čl. 25. st. 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26) - ne starije od dana objave natječaja 6.Potvrdu Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu stanovanja) da kandidatu/kandidatkinji nisu izrečene zaštitne mjere iz članka 25. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, izjavu da do sada nije koristio pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 10 dana od dana objavljivanja natječaja. Prijave za natječaj s obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se na adresu: Dječji vrtić Dječji vrtić Medvjedići Rugvica, Školska ulica 18, Jalševec Nartski, 10370 Dugo selo, u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom – „Za natječaj – odgojitelj/ica na neodređeno vrijeme novootvoreni poslovi“ Svi kandidati koji zadovoljavaju formalne uvjete natječaja, bit će pozvani na intervju, a o vremenu održavanja istog kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem e-maila. Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete javnog natječaja Dječji vrtić pridržava pravo provesti usmeni intervju u svrhu provjere znanja, vještina i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se kandidat prima. Područje provjere kandidata, iz kojih će se razgovor voditi: 1.Državni pedagoški standard predškolskog odgoja i naobrazbe (NN 63/2008 i 90/10) 2.Zakon o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26) 3.Nacionalni kurikulum za rani i predškolski odgoj i obrazovanje (NN 05/15) 4.Pravilnik o postupku, načinu i uvjetima za napredovanje u struci i stjecanje položajnih zvanja odgojitelja, stručnih suradnika i ravnatelja u dječjem vrtiću (NN 83/2024) 5.Pravilnik o obrascima i sadržaju pedagoške dokumentacije i evidencije o djeci u dječjem vrtiću (NN 83/01) Dječji vrtić Medvjedići Rugvica zadržava pravo u bilo kojem trenutku poništiti ovaj natječaj, djelomično ili u cijelosti, bez posebnog obrazloženja i bez ikakve obveze prema kandidatima koji su se prijavili. Odluka o poništenju bit će objavljena na mrežnim stranicama vrtića i oglasnoj ploči ustanove. O rezultatima provedenog natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od osam (8) dana od dana donošenja odluke o odabiru kandidata putem oglasne ploče i mrežne stranice Vrtića https://dv-medvjedici.hr/ . Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog Zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Medvjedići Rugvica dana 24. 9. 2026. i traje do 4. 10. 2026.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: POMOĆNI/A RADNIK/CA
jobs.description:
• transport i odlaganje bala,
  • radovi čišćenja postrojenja,
  • održavanje i čišćenje sredstava za rad,

  • sudjeluje u radu MBO, odlagališta i reciklaža kao pomoćna radna snaga,
  • vodi brigu o uređenju, racionalnom i pravilnom odlaganju dovezenog otpadnog materijala,
  • vizualnom kontrolom utvrđuje vrstu i sastav otpada te može bitnu štetnost prijavljuje nadređenima,

  • obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu procesnog inženjera i voditelja odjela,
  • za svoj rad odgovoran je procesnom inženjeru i voditelju odjela.

Potrebna stručna sprema i iskustvo: minimalno razina 1. stručne spreme, sa ili bez radnog iskustva.

jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik), osnovnoškolska katolička ustanova s pravom javnosti, Osnovna škola „Lotrščak“, Zagreb, Donje Svetice 127, raspisuje NATJEČAJ 1. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23).
