jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, Osnovna škola Cestica, Dravska 2, Cestica, raspisuje

NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa

1. UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU – 1 izvršitelj/ica na određeno vrijeme puno radno vrijeme od 40 sati tjedno

Mjesto rada: Cestica, Dravska 2

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN 82/08 i 69/17)

Uvjeti:

Osim općih uvjeta sukladno općim propisima o radu kandidati trebaju zadovoljavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19 i 64/20) i Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN, br. 6/19 i 75/20).

- posebni uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi za osobe koje sudjeluju u odgojno-obrazovnom radu s učenicima jesu poznavanje hrvatskog jezika u govoru i latiničnom pismu u mjeri koja omogućava izvođenje odgojno-obrazovnog rada, te vrsta i razina obrazovanja

- učitelj/učiteljica razredne nastave mora imati obrazovanje u skladu s odredbama čl. 4. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN 6/19 i 75/20)

- radni odnos u školskoj ustanovi ne može zasnovati osoba za koju postoje zapreke iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu u kojoj će navesti osobne podatke i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuju kandidati/kinje obvezni su priložiti sljedeće isprave:

- Životopis, - Diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi, - Domovnicu odnosno dokaz o državljanstvu, - Uvjerenje nadležnog suda ili e zapis da protiv osobe nije pokrenut i ne vodi se kazneni postupak glede zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa prema čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19 i 64/20) ne starije od 30 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja - Elektronički zapis o radnom stažu ili potvrda o radnom stažu iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje - ne starije od 30 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja

Navedene isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici.

Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat/kandidatkinja dužan/na je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika sukladno Zakonu o javnom bilježništvu (NN 78/93, 29/94, 162/98, 16/07, 75/09, 120/16).

Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. jobs.description:
Sukladno čl. 21. Statuta Doma zdravlja Čakovec, ravnateljica Doma zdravlja Čakovec raspisuje:

NATJEČAJ

za prijem u radni odnos:

1. Doktora medicine na radnom mjestu ugovornog zdr. radnika primarne zdr. zaštite - 1 izvršitelja (m/ž) na neodređeno vrijeme za rad u ordinaciji opće/obiteljske medicine Doma zdravlja Čakovec u Orehovici, Nikole Tesle 23.

Općina Orehovica nudi mogućnost financijske stimulacije liječnika.

Uz molbu za zapošljavanje prilaže se:

  1. kraći životopis,
  2. preslik diplome,
  3. elektronski zapis ili potvrda HZMO-a s podacima o radnom stažu (ne starije od 1 mjeseca),
  4. preslik odobrenja za samostalan rad koje izdaje nadležna komora (važeća licenca),
  5. uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 6 mjeseci).

Sukladno čl. 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova, na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola.

Natječaj će se objaviti na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i mrežnim stranicama Doma zdravlja Čakovec (www.dzck.hr).

Natječaj je otvoren od 03.09.2026. godine pa do popunjavanja radnog mjesta.

Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, moraju se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo, a osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, uz prijavu su dužni priložiti i svu dokumentaciju koju posebni propis propisuje za ostvarivanje tog prava.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o pravima hrvatskih branitelja iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, uz prijavu je dužan priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, uz prijavu je dužan priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze iz čl. 49. rečenog Zakona, dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, uz prijavu je dužan priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo navedeno pravo.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, uz prijavu je dužan priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti ostvaruju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Ne može se primiti u radni odnos za obavljanje poslova osoba koja u sustavu zdravstva neposredno u vidu zanimanja pruža zdravstvenu zaštitu te koja sudjeluje u dijagnostičkim i terapijskim postupcima, a protiv koje je pokrenut kazneni postupak ili koja je pravomoćno osuđena za neko od kaznenih djela iz glave XVI. Kaznenog zakona (Narodne novine br. 125/11., 144/12., 56/15., 61/15. – ispravak, 101/17., 118/18., 126/19., 84/21., 114/22., 114/23. i 36/24.) – Kaznena djela protiv spolne slobode i glave XVII. istoga Zakona – Kaznena djela spolnog zlostavljanja i iskorištavanja djeteta.

Za kandidata primljenog u radni odnos po ovom natječaju poslodavac će pribaviti dokaz po službenoj dužnosti da nije osuđen za navedena kaznena djela, dok je odabrani kandidat dužan dostaviti dokaz da se protiv njega ne vodi takav kazneni postupak.

Dom zdravlja pridržava pravo za kandidate koji ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja provesti testiranje (provjera znanja i sposobnosti, sklonost timskom radu, komunikacijske vještine, odgovornost i sl.), kao i provesti usmeni razgovor.Vrijeme i mjesto održavanja intervjua i testiranja objavit će se na web stranici Doma zdravlja Čakovec.

Molbe s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja dostavljaju se na adresu Dom zdravlja Čakovec, Ivana Gorana Kovačića 1e, 40 000 Čakovec s naznakom “za natječaj – zapošljavanje ____ (navesti točan naziv radnog mjesta)”.

Prijavu za natječaj koja se dostavlja putem pošte potrebno je poslati „preporučeno“.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu Domu zdravlja Čakovec da se njegovi osobni podaci prikupljaju, obrađuju, objavljuju u digitalnom obliku te čuvaju u skladu s općim aktima Doma zdravlja, radi provođenja javnog natječaja za zapošljavanje. Uvjerenje o zdr. sposobnosti izabrani kandidat/kinje dostavljaju po obavijesti o izboru, a prije donošenja odluke o izboru. Odluka o izboru kandidata javno će se objaviti na internetskoj stranici Doma zdravlja Čakovec u zakonskom roku te se kandidati neće pojedinačno obavještavati pisanim putem. Dom zdravlja Čakovec pridržava pravo, bez obrazloženja, djelomično ili u cijelosti, u svako doba poništiti ovaj natječaj. DOM ZDRAVLJA ČAKOVEC

jobs.title: VODITELJ/ VODITELJICA POSLOVA U STROJARSKOJ INDUSTRIJI
jobs.description:
Opis posla:

  • Organizacija, planiranje i koordinacija izvođenja strojarskih radova te osiguravanje njihove pravovremene i kvalitetne realizacije.
  • Vođenje i nadzor projekata u području strojarske industrije, uključujući koordinaciju zaposlenika, podizvođača i dobavljača.
  • Praćenje tijeka proizvodnih, montažnih i instalacijskih aktivnosti te osiguravanje usklađenosti s projektnom dokumentacijom i zadanim rokovima.
  • Kontrola kvalitete izvedenih radova te sudjelovanje u puštanju sustava i postrojenja u rad.
  • Praćenje primjene propisa zaštite na radu, tehničkih standarda i drugih važećih zakonskih propisa.
  • Izrada i vođenje potrebne projektne i tehničke dokumentacije te redovito izvještavanje o statusu projekata. Uvjeti:
  • Završeno srednjoškolsko ili visoko obrazovanje tehničkog usmjerenja (strojarstvo, elektrotehnika ili srodno područje).
  • Višegodišnje iskustvo rada na gradilištima i vođenju projekata u području strojarstva ili industrijskih postrojenja.
  • Potrebno je iskustvo u vođenju i nadzoru montaže automatskih lakirnica i pripadajućih industrijskih postrojenja na gradilištu, uključujući koordinaciju izvođača, usmjeravanje ugradnje opreme, kontrolu i odobravanje izvedenih radova te vođenje pripadajuće dokumentacije.
  • Spremnost na službena putovanja u Hrvatskoj i inozemstvu te fleksibilnost u organizaciji rada.
  • Razvijene organizacijske i komunikacijske vještine te odgovoran i proaktivan pristup radu.
  • Aktivno znanje njemačkog i/ili engleskog jezika.
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorije. Nudimo:
  • Ugovor o radu na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Konkurentna primanja i atraktivne uvjete rada.
  • Rad na zanimljivim i izazovnim projektima u međunarodnom i inovativnom okruženju.
  • Mogućnost profesionalnog razvoja, stručnog usavršavanja i napredovanja.
  • Samostalnost u radu, sudjelovanje u donošenju odluka te priliku za aktivan doprinos razvoju i uspjehu tvrtke.

jobs.title: REFERENT/ REFERENTICA NABAVE U UGOSTITELJSTVU
jobs.description:
Potreban/potrebna nam je referent/referentica nabave u ugostiteljstvu koji/koja će biti ključna karika i osiguravati nesmetano poslovanje restorana, hotela... nabavom namirnica i inventara.

Referent/referentica nabave osigurat će optimalan omjer cijene i kvalitete te spriječiti nedostatak roba. Svakodnevno će pratiti stanje u skladištima i hladnjačama, definirat će minimalnu količinu zaliha te pravovremeno naručivati hranu, pića i potrošni materijal.

Tražit će najbolje ponude, ugovarati cijene, rokove plaćanja i uvjete isporuke s dobavljačima.

Pratit će otpremnice, provjeravati valjanost ulaznih računa te koordinirati s knjigovodstvom. Kontinuirano će istraživati nove trendove i kontrolu cijena konkurencije kako bi se zadržala profitabilnost.

Nudimo odličnu plaću sa smještajem, dodatno nagrađivanje, isplatu regresa za godišnji odmor, božićnice, uskrsnice, dječje darove i druge pogodnosti zaposlenicima.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA PROJEKTA U SERVISU
jobs.description:
Opis posla:
  • vođenje i koordinacija projekata servisiranja, održavanja, popravaka i remonta jahti i brodica
  • pregled potrebnih radova, mjerenje te detaljna razrada potrebnog materijala i opreme
  • priprema specifikacija i narudžbi materijala za potrebe servisnih projekata
  • komunikacija s dobavljačima te praćenje nabave i rokova isporuke materijala
  • svakodnevna komunikacija s klijentima, serviserima, kooperantima i dobavljačima
  • komunikacija s domaćim i međunarodnim klijentima i poslovnim partnerima na hrvatskom i engleskom jeziku
  • organizacija i koordinacija rada servisera i vanjskih kooperanata
  • izrada narudžbi, radnih naloga i ostale dokumentacije vezane uz administrativni i operativni dio Servisa Marine Nautica Novigrad
  • praćenje tijeka projekta, izvršenih radova, utrošenog materijala, radnih sati i usluga kooperanata
  • kontrola kvalitete i dinamike izvođenja ugovorenih radova
  • pravovremeno prepoznavanje dodatnih radova i komunikacija s klijentom vezano uz njihovu realizaciju
  • koordinacija potrebnih aktivnosti kako bi se osiguralo nesmetano i pravovremeno odvijanje projekata
  • provedba radova i procesa potrebnih za realizaciju projekata remonta i popravaka plovila, uz primjenu odgovarajućih znanja i razumijevanja tehnoloških procesa
  • priprema potrebnih podataka i dokumentacije za završni obračun projekta
  • vođenje projekata u skladu s dogovorenim rokovima, opsegom radova i definiranim troškovima
  • izvođenje drugih poslova prema uputama poslodavca

OD KANDIDATA OČEKUJEMO

  • tehničko znanje i interes za nautiku, brodogradnju i servisiranje plovila
  • sposobnost samostalne organizacije i vođenja servisnih projekata
  • izražene organizacijske i komunikacijske sposobnosti
  • odgovornost, preciznost i sistematičnost u radu
  • sposobnost istovremenog praćenja više projekata i prioriteta
  • dobro poznavanje rada na računalu i MS Office paketa
  • dobro znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • spremnost na timski rad i svakodnevnu komunikaciju s klijentima, dobavljačima i kooperantima

Prednost imaju kandidati s prethodnim iskustvom u nautici, brodogradnji, servisiranju plovila, tehničkom održavanju ili vođenju projekata, kao i kandidati koji poznaju brodske sustave, materijale i tehnološke procese vezane uz održavanje i remont plovila.

Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika, na određeno, nepuno radno vrijeme (6 sati tjedno), 1 izvršitelj/ica Uvjeti: Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br.: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i čl.17. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (Narodne novine br. 6/19, 75/20). Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi 4. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 5. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Učitelj/ica engleskog jezika“.

jobs.title: TERENSKI SERVISER/KA
jobs.description:
Terenski serviser (m/ž)

Ključni zadaci i odgovornosti:

  • izvođenje servisnih radova u tvrtki i na terenu, na uređajima tvrtke RASCO i na ostalim uređajima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa i distribuira
  • remont strojeva preuzetih od kupaca
  • izvođenje osnovne obuke za upravljanje Rasco strojevima i uređajima, i onima koje tvrtka RASCO zastupa
  • prijava nesukladnosti prikupljenih sa terena
  • unos podataka i korekcija u baze podataka kojima raspolaže servis
  • vođenje točnih zapisa vezanih za servisne radne naloge
  • kontrola tehničke ispravnosti i održavanje osobnih, dostavnih i teretnih vozila tvrtke

Traženi profil kandidata:

  • SSS tehničkog usmjerenja (automehaničar, autoelektričar, elektromonter itd.)
  • Poželjno 1 - 3 godina radnog iskustvu u sličnim poslovima, ali razmotriti ćemo i kandidate bez radnog iskustva, a koji su spremni proći intenzivnu obuku namijenjenu serviserima početnicima
  • Engleski ili njemački jezik (osnovna razina)
  • Korištenje računalom i MS Office aplikacijama (osnovno)
  • Vozačka dozvola B kategorija
  • Sklonost terenskom radu
  • Odgovoran pristup radnim zadacima
  • Sklonost timskom radu i fleksibilnost u poslu

Što nudimo:

  • Početnu plaću sukladno prethodnom iskustvu uz jasno definiranu mogućnost povećanja primanja nakon savladavanja zahtjeva radnog mjesta

jobs.title: Staff Scientists in Radio Localization and Sensing
jobs.description:
Chalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation, and applied science. We are now looking for two Staff Scientists to strengthen our research in radio localization and sensing.

About the role

Radio localization and sensing at Chalmers is growing in scale, technical breadth, and collaborative activity. To provide the scientific continuity, technical depth, and coordination needed for sustained high-quality research, we are recruiting two Staff Scientists.As a Staff Scientist, you will provide advanced scientific, technical, and methodological support within an established research environment. Working on behalf of the research leader, you will contribute specialist expertise, hands-on research, method development, technical mentoring, and coordination of assigned activities in the group’s research projects.

You will work closely with Professor Henk Wymeersch and other members of the group to strengthen the capacity, continuity, and long-term development of the group’s established research activities. The two appointments will provide complementary expertise. Applicants should identify the profile that best matches their experience; candidates with strengths spanning both areas are also welcome.



    Profile 1: Model-based radio localization, sensing, and tracking. This profile focuses on modelling, algorithm development, performance analysis, and signal processing for radio localization, sensing, and tracking in terrestrial and emerging non-terrestrial networks, including satellites, high-altitude platform stations, and unmanned aerial vehicles.
    Profile 2: Reliable and learning-enabled radio localization and sensing. This profile focuses on developing and applying model-based and learning-based methods for trustworthy and intelligent wireless localization, sensing, and imaging. Relevant themes include privacy, robustness, reliability, model-based AI, machine learning, and semantic or task-driven methods, within the group’s established research agenda.

About the division and department

The Division of Communications, Antennas, and Optical Networks conducts research and education in wireless and optical technologies for communication and sensing. Combining fundamental and applied research, we address challenges in sustainability, security, and next-generation communication systems. The division also plays a key role in engineering education, particularly within the Master’s Programme in Information and Communication Technology.



Your responsibilities

Your responsibilities will include:

    Contributing to high-quality research and contributing to scientific publications, research software, methods, and other long-term research outputs relevant to the group’s agenda.
    Developing and applying specialist methods, models, algorithms, and evaluation approaches in radio localization, sensing, tracking, and related areas.
    Providing technical mentoring and co-supervision to PhD students and postdoctoral researchers within the group, under the direction of the research leader.
    Contributing to the supervision of BSc and MSc thesis projects, where relevant.
    Contributing to the preparation of competitive grant applications that support the group’s research activities, including coordinating defined technical or practical components when assigned.
    Supporting the execution and coordination of collaborative research projects, including work-package activities, technical reporting, deliverables, and presentations.
    Working with academic and industrial partners to support the group’s existing collaborations.
    Contributing to the development and maintenance of relevant research infrastructure, including simulation, software, experimental, or laboratory resources.



Qualifications and merits

To qualify for this position, you should have:

    A doctoral degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Signal Processing, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a closely related field, with research relevant to localization, sensing, tracking, or radio-based inference.
    Substantial relevant research or specialist experience, aligned primarily with at least one of the two profiles described above.
    The ability to work collaboratively within an established research team and to provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior researchers.
    Experience contributing to research proposals or applications for external funding.
    Strong programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB, with experience in scientific computing, signal processing, simulation, or machine-learning frameworks.
    Proficiency in written and spoken English. Swedish language courses are offered.

The following are considered meritorious:

    Experience from contributing to peer-reviewed research publications in relevant international journals and conferences.
    Experience supporting or coordinating activities in collaborative research projects, including technical work packages, deliverables, reporting, or presentations.
    Experience working with academic or industrial partners.
    Experience with simulation, experimental validation, measurement campaigns, research software, or research infrastructure relevant to wireless localization and sensing.
    Experience mentoring or co-supervising BSc, MSc, or PhD students.
    Experience contributing to the development, maintenance, or operation of research software, experimental platforms, or laboratory facilities.

Employment

Full-time, permanent positions.



Application

Submit your application in English through our recruitment portal. All files should be in PDF format (max 40 MB each; ZIP files not supported).

    Personal letter – your motivation and interest in Chalmers. Please specify clearly in your letter which of the two profiles you are applying for.
    CV – A comprehensive CV, including a complete list of publications and details of previous teaching/pedagogical experience.
    Certificates and supporting documents – including your doctoral degree certificate, documentation of awards, or teaching merits.

Only complete applications submitted through the portal will be considered.

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.

Application deadline: October 31, 2026.









*** Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position. ***

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Database Excellence
AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.
  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.
  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.
  • Obsessed with quality.
  • Deliberate in our decisions.
  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.


Position description

The Business Technology team is composed of passionate technologists who are fully engaged in delivering the best products that help teams deliver their best work. We are focused on reducing friction and getting the most value from solutions to enhance outcomes. We want to expand our Business Technology landscape to manage more systems in a predictable way that accounts for scalability, resilience, and performance.

This role sits at the intersection of AI-native operations, enterprise platform engineering, and IT service management. You will own how Sonar designs, builds, and operationalizes AI-augmented systems across its internal technology ecosystem — engineering AI agents and connectors, automating workflows end-to-end, and integrating our enterprise tool stack, with Jira Service Management and the Atlassian suite as one core platform among several.

While Jira Service Management and the broader Atlassian suite form a core part of your platform footprint, your scope extends well beyond it: you will build and maintain integrations across our enterprise tool stack, engineer automation pipelines that eliminate manual work at scale, and operationalize AI-native capabilities (Enterprise Apps connectors, Claude MCP integrations, Rovo agents) that put Sonar ahead of the curve in AI-driven internal operations.

Your success will directly enable every internal team at Sonar to work faster, smarter, and with less friction — and will give leadership real-time visibility, consistent governance, and a platform that scales effortlessly with the company's global growth.


What you will do

You are confident in owning and evolving a multi-platform internal technology ecosystem for a fast-growing, multi-site, multinational organization. You bring deep expertise in building AI-native systems and automations, and you are equally at home administering and evolving ITSM platforms — especially Atlassian — that anchor Sonar's internal operations.

You bring proven, multi-year experience in:

  • AI Systems & Agent Engineering (primary focus): Designing, building, and operationalizing AI-native capabilities across Sonar's internal stack — Claude MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations, custom Claude skills, Rovo agents, and Enterprise Apps connectors. You prototype on the frontier, then harden what works into reliable, governed production systems that internal teams depend on daily.

Boels ist ein dynamisches Familienunternehmen und zählt zu den größten Vermietern von (Bau-) Maschinen und Werkzeugen in Europa. Was uns auszeichnet? Boels gehört zu den führenden Vermietern von Baumaschinen und Werkzeugen in Europa und wächst stetig weiter. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Job, ein starkes Team und spannende Aufgaben rund um Maschinen und Technik.

* Ein familiäres Betriebsklima mit flachen Hierarchien

* Eine umfassende Einarbeitung in Produkte, Programme und Prozesse

* Regelmäßige Schulungen und Weiterbildungen

* Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Boels-Gruppe

* Bonuszahlungen nach Erreichung der Ziele

* Mitarbeitergeschenke zum Geburtstag & zu Weihnachten

* Zuschüsse für Essen / Pluxee Gutscheine

* Monatlichen Fitnesscenterzuschuss

* Zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. Dezember und 31. Dezember

* Freude am Arbeiten mit Maschinen und Werkzeugen

* Technisches Verständnis und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

jobs.title: PĒTNIEKS
jobs.description:
Latvijas Unoversitātes "Cietvielu fizikas institūta" reģ.nr. 90002124925, ZI Nr. 381016 (turpmāk LU CFI) Plāno kārtiņu laboratorija PostDoc Latvia projekta ietvaros aicina pievienoties komandai Pētnieku. Projektā “Nākamās paaudzes ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju plānu kārtiņu uzklāšana un diožu izgatavošana optoelektronikas un enerģijas ierīcēm” tiek kombinētas materiālzinātnes, pusvadītāju fizikas un elektronikas jomas, lai izstrādātu jaunas paaudzes diodes no inovatīviem pusvadītāju materiāliem. Projekta uzdevumi ir izstrādāt jaunu ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju materiālu sintēzes metodes, prototipēt ierīces ar mikroizgatavošanas metodēm, un veikt to elektrisko raksturošanu. Īpaša uzmanība tiks pievērsta jaunā pētnieka zināšanu un prasmju pilnveidošanai caur apmācībām, dalībām vasaras skolās un konferencēm.

Galvenie darba pienākumi:

1.      Veikt pētniecību un eksperimentus materiālzinātnes un pusvadītāju fizikas jomā, īpaši koncentrējoties uz ultraplatzonas pusvadītāju plānām kārtiņām.

2.      Izstrādāt inovatīvu ultraplatzonas materiālu plānu kārtiņu uzklāšanas procesus, izmantojot impulsu lāzera izputināšanu (PLD).

3.   Veikt plānu kārtiņu struktūras, sastāva, morfoloģijas, optisku un elektrisku raksturošanu (XRD, elipsometrija, XPS, SEM, Ramana spektroskopija, I-V, C-V, u.c.).

jobs.title: Superviseur·se CVC/HAVC - Pompes à chaleur - France
jobs.description:
Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et la satisfaction client.

Notre objectif est clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Dans le cadre du lancement et du déploiement de nos pompes à chaleur en France, nous recherchons notre premier·ère Superviseur·ise CVC/HVAC pour superviser les installations de nos pompes à chaleur air-air. Nous recherchons une personne passionnée, ayant de l’expérience dans l’installation de pompes à chaleur et/ou systèmes de chauffage et désireuse de nous aider à développer cette activité en France.

Il s’agit d’un poste sur le terrain couvrant la région d’Amiens, mais tu seras également amené·e à travailler depuis ton domicile ou depuis notre bureau de Lille lorsque cela sera nécessaire.


Ce que tu feras
- Tu nous aideras à mettre en place la structure technique de notre département dédié aux pompes à chaleur en France
- Tu veilleras à la qualité et au bon fonctionnement des installations réalisées par nos partenaires locaux
- Tu seras sur le terrain pour visiter les chantiers et t’assurer de leur bon déroulement
- Tu seras en mesure d’apporter une assistance technique pour résoudre directement tout problème identifié sur place
- Tu auras un esprit « dépanneur » pour trouver des solutions aux défis rencontrés et les résoudre à ton échelle
- Tu mettras à profit tes connaissances et ton expérience en matière d’installations de pompes à chaleur pour garantir une expérience fluide et exceptionnelle
- Tu conseilleras nos clients et tu les aideras à mettre en places les bonnes pratique de réduction des émissions carbone
- Tu examineras les cahiers des charges techniques et les plans techniques de nos pompes à chaleur, et tu pourras participer à leur élaboration/amélioration continue, en lien avec les équipes techniques & métiers du groupe

Profil recherché
- Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience dans l’installation et la maintenance de systèmes de pompes à chaleur aérothermiques
- Tu es disponible et prêt·e à te déplacer dans la région d’Amiens et le Nord de la France
- Tu es un·e technicien·ne expérimenté·e, notamment en plomberie et chauffage, et tu possèdes des connaissances en conception de systèmes de chauffage ; tu es en mesure de dépanner toi-même et d’intervenir techniquement sur place sur les chantiers
- Tu sais examiner et être force de proposition sur des cahiers des charges techniques ainsi que des plans mécaniques
- Tu as l'esprit entrepreneur : tu rejoins un nouveau projet où "tout est à faire". Tu n’as pas peur de partir d'une feuille blanche, tester, apprendre et avancer en autonomie.
- Tu es proactif·ve et rigoureux·se, tu sais organiser ton activité en autonomie, en optimisant au fur et à mesure, notamment en mettant en place des processus clairs et automatisés
- Tu as le goût du challenge, tu aimes aller sur le terrain ; tu n'as pas peur de te confronter aux artisans et de les aider à surmonter les irritants rencontrés. Doté·e d'un fort capital sympathie, tu sais fédérer tes interlocuteurs et les faire devenir de véritables ambassadeurs d’Octopus Energy !



Pré-requis & Qualifications

- Permis voiture en cours de validité
- Diplôme(s) de niveau CAP/BEP, ou VAE de niveau équivalent
- Avoir travaillé précédemment dans des entreprises certifiées RGE & Qualibat 
- Maîtrise de l’anglais technique à l’écrit & l’oral (niveau B1-B2) 
- Habilitation électrique (BR NF C18-510)

Ce sera également un plus si :
- Tu es à l’aise avec les outils & le numérique, notamment Excel
- Tu as de l’expérience avec la partie “électrique” des pompes à chaleur 
- Tu possèdes l’habilitation électrique BR

Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

jobs.title: Structural Engineer - Oceanbird
jobs.description:
AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. Our strong mother companies provide valuable insights in shipping and industrial production and enable us to have a long-term perspective.

By harnessing wind - a constant and free energy source - we contribute to a more sustainable shipping industry. The wind helped us discover our planet - now it can help us preserve it!



The role

We are looking for an experienced Structural Engineer to join our Innovation team and help develop Oceanbird's next generation of wind-powered propulsion systems for commercial vessels.

In this role, you will be responsible for the structural integrity and design of large, complex structures, from early concepts through detailed design and verification. You will combine engineering fundamentals and hand calculations with advanced finite element analysis to understand structural behaviour, identify critical design drivers, and develop robust and cost-efficient solutions. Your structural expertise will directly influence how our products are designed, manufactured, tested, and operated.



The role is highly hands-on but also requires a strong system-level perspective. You will need to understand not only how an individual component behaves, but how the complete product functions and interacts with its operational environment.





Key responsibilities

    Perform structural calculations ranging from hand calculations and analytical methods to advanced FEA.

    Develop, assess, and document structural designs from concept through detailed design, testing, and verification in close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams across mechanical, automation control, electrical, supply chain and quality, and customer projects.

    Take a system-level approach to understanding loads, boundary conditions, interfaces, operational environments, and failure modes.

    Prepare and peer-review structural calculation reports and documentation.

    Apply relevant design standards and class rules, such as DNV requirements.

    Evaluate alternative design solutions regarding structural performance, manufacturability, weight, complexity, and cost.

    Develop and maintain expertise in one or more specialist areas of structural engineering, such as fatigue, welding, bolted joints, dynamics, buckling, composite/steel structures, or structural optimisation.

    Communicate structural risks, assumptions, and design recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

    Contribute to design reviews, testing, verification activities, and continuous improvement of our engineering methods and processes.





What we are looking for

We believe the right candidate combines strong structural engineering fundamentals with a proven track record of delivering projects from concept to field-proven solutions.



You likely have:

    Minimum 5 years of professional experience in structural engineering or a closely related field.

    A master's degree in structural engineering, mechanical engineering, naval architecture, aerospace engineering, or a similar discipline.

    Strong understanding of structural mechanics and engineering fundamentals.

    Practical experience with linear and non-linear finite element analysis; experience with ANSYS is highly desirable.

    Python programming experience is a plus.

    Experience designing and dimensioning large steel structures is highly desirable.

    Experience with marine, offshore, shipbuilding, heavy machinery, energy, or other highly regulated structural applications is an advantage.

    Experience working with DNV standards or other marine classification society rules is highly desirable.

    A sound understanding of how engineering decisions affect the business case of the product.

    Fluent professional English, both written and spoken.





Personal profile

We are looking for someone who:

    Is genuinely passionate about structural engineering and enjoys solving complex engineering problems.

    Is a pragmatic engineer who combines analytical depth with good engineering judgement.

    Is comfortable getting into the details when necessary but is equally able to step back and understand the bigger picture and how your decisions affect the complete product.

    enjoys working collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams.

    Is comfortable challenging designs and assumptions when you see a better structural solution.

    can explain technical reasoning clearly and adapt your communication to your audience.

    is self-motivated and takes ownership of your work.



Most importantly, you want to be part of a multidisciplinary team where structural engineering is not simply a verification function, but an active part of shaping the product.



Location: Stockholm, Sweden. Occasional travel should be expected as part of the role.





We review applications continually so please send in yours not later than October 11th, 2026.

Please note that, in compliance with GDPR, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.



As part of Alfa Wall Oceanbird commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, alcohol and drug testing is applied during the preemployment process. As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role.

jobs.title: Director – International Relations and Diplomacy Programs
jobs.description:
Your mission

The Director of International Relations and Diplomacy (IRD) Programs, based at the Paris Campus, will provide academic leadership for Schiller International University’s undergraduate, graduate and online International Relations and Diplomacy programs across all campuses. The Director will be responsible for ensuring program currency and curriculum quality, faculty hiring and performance, and achieving student outcomes within the International Relations and Diplomacy discipline. In addition, the Director will provide Academic Leadership at the Paris Campus for all academic programs.
  
 The role encompasses the oversight of program design, curriculum development, course content, syllabi, course delivery, assessment and continuous improvement processes, ensuring compliance with U.S. accreditation standards, local regulatory requirements, and dual-degree and articulation agreements with various partners. The Director will work closely with academic leaders across campuses to recruit, evaluate, and support faculty teaching International Relations and Diplomacy courses, ensuring consistency in academic standards and learning outcomes throughout the institution. The director will also work with academic team, student experience and data team to monitor key performance indicators and help design interventions to ensure achieving student outcomes set by the university.
  
 In collaboration with Associate Deans, Directors of other academic areas, and the Paris Campus Director, the Director of International Relations and Diplomacy Programs will provide academic leadership for the Paris Campus and oversee faculty hiring and management, course allocations and academic operation. 
 
The successful candidate will work closely with faculty, staff, and other university stakeholders to foster student engagement, academic success, preparation for employment and career success, and deliver a transformative, student-centered educational experience aligned with Schiller’s experiential and challenge-based learning model.


Tasks and Responsabilities

  • Lead International Relations and Diplomacy programs design, review, and continuous improvement in collaboration with Academic team and other university offices. 
  • Participate in the review and assessment of program and course learning outcomes for International Relations and Diplomacy and other academic areas.
  • Engage actively in innovation within the area(s) of knowledge to update teaching and learning methodologies and educational technology in collaboration with the Educational Technology team and industry professionals.
  • Assess instructional needs and lead the effort to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all International Relations and Diplomacy courses across campuses in collaboration academic leaders on other campuses in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with academic leaders on other campuses to identify, hire and assign qualified faculty to all courses on the Paris campus in a timely manner.
  • Lead annual evaluations of faculty in IRD across campuses and contribute to faculty annual performance evaluations at the Paris campus. 
  • Conduct course observations as needed, both online and onsite. 
  • Collaborate with the Educational Technology team to offer faculty development activities.
  • Support the growing Distance Learning Master’s program in International Relations and Diplomacy.
  • Collaborate with Dean of Institutional Effectiveness to ensure program quality and compliance with all regulations and accreditation requirements. 
  • Monitor student outcomes data weekly and to identify students at risk. Work with faculty and student services to design interventions to support their retention and success.
  • Collaborate with Employability team and devise and implement measures and initiatives to boost students’ employability and career success. 
  • Coordinate the effective implementation of VLE templates and uniform content within International Relations and Diplomacy offerings.
  • Manage faculty workload and faculty assignment in collaboration with the other academic leaders.
  • Any other duties assigned by the Provost, President or Campus Director.


Your Profile

  • An earned Doctorate degree in International Relations and Diplomacy or related field from an accredited institution or close to completion.
  • Proven experience and demonstrated excellence in higher education, administration, and industry experience.
  • Academic program design and review and managing faculty and staff.
  • Passion and commitment to student support and success.
  • Knowledge and experience in distant leaning and online instruction.
  • Knowledge of the American and/or French higher education systems is a plus.
  • Either native English speaker or proficiency level of English competency
  • Local language (French, German, Spanish), desirable
Competencies
  • Communication Connection and Service 
  • Global Mindset 
  • Achieving Results 
  • Driving Innovation and Managing Change 
  • Learning and Development 
  • Drives Vision and Leads Courageously
  • Strong focus on quality and continuous improvement 
  • Leadership skills 
  • Strong intercultural communication skills and cultural agility

jobs.title: Senior Creative Strategist (all genders)

Wir schaffen Relevanz, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erreichen und zu skalieren.

Sichtbarkeit ist nicht automatisch Relevanz. Reichweite nicht automatisch Wirkung.

WeCreate ist eine Social-First Brand Building Agency für das Interest-Media-Zeitalter. Wir übersetzen Social Signals und Community Insights in Social Strategien, Content-Systeme und messbare Markenwirkung – als strategischer Partner, Campaign Co-Pilot oder operatives Umsetzungsteam. 

Für Marken, die nicht nur stattfinden, sondern kulturell und in ihren Communities relevant sein wollen, suchen wir dich als Senior Creative Strategist (all genders).

Du verbindest strategische Klarheit mit kreativer Führung. Als strategische Stimme von WeCreate entwickelst du die Marken- und Plattformlogik unserer Kund:innen, übersetzt sie in wirksame Content-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten Idee ein konsistenter, relevanter und plattformnativer Content-Output wird.

Du verantwortest die strategische und kreative Gesamtausrichtung komplexer Kunden-Mandate von der Social Marken-Positionierung über Plattform- und Kanalstrategien bis zur übergreifenden Content-Systematik und Qualitätssicherung über alle Projektphasen hinweg.

Dabei arbeitest du eigenständig auf Senior-Level, triffst Entscheidungen mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum und kommunizierst sicher mit den Marken-Entscheider:innen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der integrierten Arbeit mit dem Team: Mindestens fünf Tage pro Monat arbeitest du im WeCreate-Office in Hamburg. Zusätzlich bringst du die notwendige Flexibilität für Produktionen, Workshops, Kundentermine und Offsite-Formate mit auch dann, wenn diese außerhalb deines üblichen Arbeitsortes stattfinden.


Dein Impact bei WeCreate

Du gibst Marken und Teams Richtung. Du sorgst dafür, dass strategische Klarheit nicht in Präsentationen endet, sondern in kreativen Systemen, relevanten Inhalten und konsistenter Markenwirkung sichtbar wird.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Service engineer for our client.

Your Role and Responsibilities:
As a Service Engineer, based in the Helsinki or Turku area, you will be responsible for commissioning, maintaining and servicing electric propulsion systems for marine applications. You will execute service work according to work instructions and in accordance with standard processes, quality requirements and safety guidelines.

You will work closely with customers and internal engineering and service teams, acting as the technical point of contact while ensuring high-quality service and customer satisfaction.

The position involves approximately 150 days of mostly international travel per year, as you will provide practical technical support at customer sites around the world. This position offers an excellent opportunity to work with advanced marine technology, develop your technical expertise and gain international experience in a highly customer-oriented industry.

You will be mainly accountable for:
 Commissioning and maintaining electric propulsion systems
 Supervising installations, startup, testing and commissioning in cooperation with customers
 Performing service and warranty work on operating vessels
 Installing and commissioning equipment and identifying and analysing technical problems through remote and on-site activities
 Performing various service tasks, including installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions and equipment replacements
 Consulting and advising customers on suitable service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures and safety guidelines
 Building and maintaining strong customer relationships and providing specialist technical assistance
 Diagnosing equipment failures and recommending corrective actions to prevent recurring problems
 Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and working methods

Qualifications for the Role:
 B.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, automation, marine engineering or another relevant field
 Ability and willingness to perform mechanical service work when required
 Previous practical experience in commissioning relevant products or systems is an advantage

 Experience in shipbuilding, marine systems or industrial equipment is an advantage

 Collaborative and solution-oriented approach
 Good Finnish and English language skills, as the role involves regular interaction with customers and internal teams
 Additional language skills are an advantage
 Good knowledge of MS Office
 Ability to work independently as well as effectively as part of a team
 Strong customer service and communication skills

Our client operates in the marine technology sector and develops advanced electric, automated and digital solutions for vessels and maritime operations. The company is committed to supporting the transition towards more sustainable and energy-efficient marine transportation.

jobs.description:
For this position we are looking for an individual who has a background within traceability & data transactions and is passionate to set the foundation and help drive our digitalization Journey within the Aftermarket, Service & Quality organization, part of the Business Unit Europe.

Typical areas of responsibility are to support both internal and external customers in problems related to product individual data from factories & suppliers.

You will be troubleshooting data issues that might occur related to individual product serial numbers, wrong master data and other things that may interfere with the data submission.

Help to track data quality issues and even coordinate with factories or suppliers the solution.

In this role one would also be working together with the Global operations team and the Global Information Systems organization.

You would be supporting the team responsible for implementing projects like Digital Product Passport and Husqvarna Serial Number roll out.

Your future challenge

This new role is positioned in the Digital Infrastructure team, belonging to Digital Data Solutions, where the role will be working together with our traceability analyst and reporting to the Global Traceability manager.

This person works in close cooperation with the Digital Product, Operational Excellence, Aftermarket & Services team, Data Management team, Operations team as well as with suppliers.

Tasks

• Resolve support tickets related to product individual identification.

• Collaborate with the Global Traceability Manager to develop and maintain data collection and reporting systems.

• Drive analytics of individual product data deliveries from suppliers, change management/project leading skill (to drive implementation and changes of integrations against suppliers as well educating internal users).

• Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by conducting regular audits and reconciliations.

• Provide administrative support, including managing documentation, scheduling meetings, and coordinating communication.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address data-related challenges and optimize traceability processes.

• Do/support error analysis of data and drive needed actions for stable data deliveries.

• Follow up / establish KPI on performance of deliveries.

• Analyze data related to product individual identification and identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement.

Required skills

• University Computer Engineering degree, Supply Chain Management or equivalent experience.

• Proven experience in data analysis, preferably in manufacturing companies.

• Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) and Microsoft Excel.

• Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

• Knowledge of APIs (REST, JSON) and system integrations is a plus.

• Knowledge of traceability systems and manufacturing execution systems best practices is a plus.

• You are fluent in English (preferably also additional languages – Swedish is a plus).

• Be able to work in a multi-cultural context both internally and externally and since all is carried out in an international context.

jobs.title: AI-Native Static Ad Designer
jobs.description:
About Uplane

Companies waste billions on bad ads, mismatched landing pages, and poor budget allocation. Uplane fixes this by building the AI technology for the marketing agency of the future. Our software supports creative producers with static ad creation, video ad creation, landing page design, and much more. We are building the AI software for the next generation of AI-native content producers and need ambitious, creative ad designers with strong taste who will use our AI engine to deliver high-performing static ads for our customers.

About The Role

We're seeking a highly motivated, English-speaking AI-native Static Ad Designer with experience in designing static ads for performance marketing campaigns to join our team full-time (in San Francisco or Berlin on-site, hybrid or remote). In this role, you will work with our self-developed AI static ad engine to create and deliver static ads for the paid social campaigns of our clients. Your creatives will reach millions of people across Meta, Google, LinkedIn and TikTok.

Why Join

  • Uplane is the best place to learn how to design ads with AI. This is the skill every creative lead will need. Learn how to do it today, not in three years.

  • AI does the grunt work, you do the creative work. Our engine handles the tedious stuff so your time goes into concept, taste and design.

  • Millions of people will see your ads.

  • Take ownership and grow quickly.

  • Join a fast-growing, VC-backed company.

  • Culture: fast-moving, ambitious, fun, humble.

Responsibilities

  • AI Static Ad Design: You use our powerful, self-developed AI static ad engine to create and design beautiful static ads that will be seen by millions of people. You are in charge, the AI helps you fulfill your mission.

  • Creative Testing: You develop new angles, hooks and visual concepts, test them in live campaigns and double down on what performs.

  • Team Collaboration: Work with an ambitious team of marketing managers and creative designers to ensure projects are executed to a high standard and in a timely manner.

  • Shape the AI engine: Give feedback to our product and engineering team and shape how our static ad engine will evolve and improve over time.

Requirements

  • Passion for designing ads, you love design and creative work

  • Years of experience in designing static ads

  • Work experience in paid social or with performance marketing campaigns

  • Fast learner, hard-working, and stress-resistant

  • Curious and excited about AI rather than afraid of it

  • Fluent English

Nice to Have

  • Work experience at a marketing agency

  • You have won awards for your creative work

  • You worked with big brands before

ABOUT KOG

Kog builds a co-designed inference stack for real-time AI agents on standard datacenter GPUs, spanning model architecture, inference engine, compilers, and low-level GPU kernels.

On the model side, we developed Laneformer 2B and Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP), a Transformer architecture that overlaps communication with useful computation and weight streaming.

On the systems side, the Kog Inference Engine runs this stack on standard AMD and NVIDIA datacenter GPUs.

Kog generates 3,500 tokens/s per request on 8 AMD MI300X GPUs and 2,100 tokens/s per request on 8 NVIDIA H200 GPUs, in FP16 at batch size 1, with quantization and speculative decoding disabled.

Our next major project is AGCO, our agentic compiler. AGCO is designed to optimize LLMs across different GPUs and optimization targets, including very fast inference.

The team has 10 people, including 9 engineers and researchers and 4 PhDs.

Test it at playground.kog.ai. Read the technical details on the Kog Labs blog.

 

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

You will work directly on AGCO.

The goal is to build a system that can explore ways to optimize LLM execution, generate changes, compile them, check correctness, run them on real hardware, measure the results, and use this feedback to guide the next optimization.

You will contribute to areas such as:

  • Compiler and IR design for representing and transforming LLM computations.

  • Optimization passes, lowering, and code generation.

  • Search methods for exploring different implementations and execution strategies.

  • Verification and correctness checks for generated changes.

  • GPU execution, profiling, and performance optimization.

  • LLM inference across operators, memory, parallelism, and communication.

  • Optimization loops that connect generated changes to measurements on real GPUs.

One direction we are exploring combines an IR, a verifier, a compiler, and a search optimizer. We plan to start with focused problems, build working prototypes, and extend the system from what we learn.

Your main area will depend on your experience, skills, and interests. You may focus more on compilers, GPU systems, or LLM inference while working closely with people across the full stack.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

We look for engineers with deep technical expertise and original work in at least one area relevant to AGCO.

Relevant experience includes:

  • Compiler engineering, including optimization passes, IRs, lowering, code generation, LLVM, or MLIR.

  • GPU programming with CUDA, HIP, Metal, Vulkan, or similar technologies.

  • GPU performance work involving kernels, memory, synchronization, profiling, or hardware behavior.

  • LLM inference engines and performance optimization.

  • Attention, MoE, parallelism, communication, or other systems-level parts of LLM execution.

  • Formal verification, equivalence checking, SAT/SMT, or related methods.

  • Systems that generate, search, test, benchmark, or optimize code automatically.

We care about what you personally built and the technical decisions behind it. Strong candidates can explain the problem, their approach, the alternatives they explored, and how they measured the result.

We review technical work during the process. This can be public code, an upstream contribution, a paper, a thesis, a technical project, or a detailed write-up based on work you can share.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join a small team building AGCO as a core part of Kog's technology.

  • Work at the intersection of compilers, GPU systems, and LLM inference.

  • Direct access to engineers working across the full inference stack.

  • A fast loop from an optimization idea to compilation, execution, verification, and measurement on real GPUs.

  • The opportunity to go deep in your strongest technical area while expanding into the other parts of the stack.

  • High ownership over technical decisions and systems that will shape how Kog optimizes LLM inference.

This role is based in Paris, and we are looking for candidates who can relocate to Paris and work closely with the team.

You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. 

This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on.


Your Mission

  • Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management.
  • Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success 
  • Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead.
  • Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees.
  • Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables.
  • Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods.


Minimum Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist till Nortic i Karlskrona!
jobs.description:
Vill du ta nästa steget i din karriär inom marknadsföring hos ett prisbelönt tillväxtbolag? Just nu finns möjligheten hos Nortic, där du får driva digital marknadsföring på en passionerad arbetsplats med unik sammanhållning och goda framtidsmöjligheter. Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Välkommen in med din ansökan!

Om tjänsten

Som Digital Marketing Specialist planerar, genomför och optimerar du datadrivna kampanjer som ökar engagemanget, stärker användaradoptionen och säkrar långvarig retention. Genom kontinuerlig analys och optimering finslipar du insatserna så att rätt budskap når arrangörer och biljettköpare vid rätt tillfälle. I ett tätt samarbete med teamen inom sälj, leverans och utvecklare binder du samman kundupplevelsen och ser till att de digitala marknadsinsatserna levererar resultat.

Du erbjudsEn unik företagskultur med stark sammanhållning, aktiviteter som AW:s och spelkvällar, samt gemensamma företagsresor. Nortic har korta beslutsvägar där dina idéer snabbt kan bli till verklighet, och det finns goda möjligheter till utveckling och fortbildning inom bolaget. Tjänsten är initialt ett konsultuppdrag via Academic work, med goda möjligheter till direkt anställning och en långsiktig karriär hos Nortic.

Övrigt

    Arbetstiderna är 08-17 på vardagar, med viss flexibilitet
    Arbetet sker främst fysiskt på kontoret, men möjlighet finns att jobba på distans ett par dagar i veckan när man är varm i kläderna

Arbetsuppgifter

Rollen innebär ett brett och operativt ansvar för den digitala marknadsföringen, där du analyserar resultat, skapar innehåll och optimerar arrangörs- och kundupplevelsen i nära samarbete med interna team och externa partners. Arbetsuppgifterna innefattar bland annat att:

    Planera, genomföra och optimera digitala marknadsaktiviteter och kampanjer  
    Producera och anpassa engagerande innehåll för webb, e-post, plattform och sociala medier  
    Arbeta datadrivet med analys, uppföljning och SEO för att driva organisk trafik  
    Hantera utskick och kampanjer via CRM-systemet HubSpot  
    Fungera som länk och koordinera samarbeten med externa leverantörer och partners  
    Säkerställa en enhetlighet och visuell identitet i all digital kommunikation  
    Samarbeta internt med Sälj, Leverans och IT för att stärka arrangörs- och kundupplevelsen

Vi söker dig som har

    Eftergymnasial utbildning inom digital marknadsföring, media, e-handel eller liknande
    Erfarenhet av operativt arbete med digitala marknadsaktiviteter och kampanjer
    Goda kunskaper inom SEO och organisk trafiktillväxt
    Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har

    Kunskaper inom HubSpot eller liknande CRM- och marketing automation-verktyg
    Arbetat inom evenemangs-, kultur- eller biljettbranschen
    Erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning eller arbete på en inhousebyrå
    Grundläggande kunskaper inom grafisk design och visuellt skapande

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är förändringsbenägen, målmedveten, ansvarstagande och intellektuellt nyfiken!

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

jobs.description:
About the role

In this role, you will get the opportunity to develop mechanical components and assemblies while adapting existing designs to specific customer orders. The work perfectly combines practical design tasks with cross-functional collaboration across engineering, production, and supplier teams. You will be supported by experienced colleagues, making this a fantastic environment to grow your expertise in mechanical engineering and manufacturing documentation.

In this role, you will be employed in a 12-month fixed-term contract with our client company, working as an embedded consultant for an in-house product company.

What our client can offer to you:
- Salary: 2500–3500 €/month, depending on your background and current skill level.
- A strong start to your career: You will get hands-on experience in a real product company environment, learning the complete lifecycle from CAD design to manufacturing.
- A collaborative environment: You will work closely with different departments, ensuring you gain a broad understanding of industrial engineering.

Work tasks

Your daily tasks will revolve around 3D modeling and creating precise manufacturing documentation for customized orders. You will ensure that technical specifications are met and that production has the correct information to build the components.
- Producing and updating 3D models for mechanical parts and subsystems.
- Preparing accurate, detailed manufacturing drawings.
- Adapting established product designs to order-specific requirements.
- Keeping design records and related information up to date in PDM and ERP systems.
- Collaborating with sales, R&D, manufacturing, and suppliers.

The work contract is with our client company, a consultancy company and you

We are looking for

- Mandatory: A bachelors or masters degree in mechanical engineering (or currently finalizing your studies).
- Mandatory: Hands-on experience with PTC Creo. This can be from your studies, internships, thesis work, or academic/personal projects.
- Mandatory: Fluent communication skills in English.
- Advantage: Basic understanding of manufacturing methods, engineering fundamentals, and familiarity with PDM systems.
- Personality: You are eager to learn, responsive to feedback, and possess a careful, detail-oriented approach to your work.

Schedule for the recruitment:
- Application period is open now.
- We are processing applications continuously and aim to present the first candidates by mid-October.
- Client interviews will follow immediately after.

Location & Remote work:
- The client's office is located in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area. The role requires working at the office for a minimum of 2 days per week to ensure smooth onboarding and teamwork.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Ekonomiassistent, leverantörsreskontra, västra Göteborg
jobs.description:
För dig som trivs som konsult och vill vara del av vår kunds engagerade ekonomiteam där samarbete, kvalitet och ansvar står i fokus!


Om tjänsten


I rollen som ekonomiassistent kommer du att ha ett huvudsakligt fokus inom leverantörsreskontraprocessen och bidra till att säkerställa ett effektivt och korrekt flöde. Du jobbar nära ytterligare en medarbetare som har fokus på detta område, med du är del av ett större ekonomiteam där samarbete är A och O. Du blir en viktig avlastning för ekonomiteamet och får möjlighet att arbeta i en verksamhet med flera bolag inom en koncernstruktur.

Uppdraget omfattas av ett konsultuppdrag med anställning hos SJR.
Vår kunds kontor är placerat inom Göteborgs västra del där arbetet sker på plats, och uppdraget omfattar initialt sex månader. Utgångspunkten är att arbetet sker på heltid.


Ansvarsområden


Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar löpande arbete med leverantörsreskontra, vilket inkluderar större flöden, momsfrågor och arbete i Medius. Du har kontakt med leverantörer på både svenska och engelska via mejl och telefon, och en tät dialog med dina kollegor på ekonomiavdelningen. Även bankavstämningar och uppgifter relaterat till kundreskontra kan förekomma.


Lämplig bakgrund


Vi söker dig som har:

- några års erfarenhet av leverantörsreskontra och som trivs inom just detta område, även om du också gärna stöttar upp inom andra områden, så som bankavstämningar och kundinbetalningar.

- erfarenhet från större bolag/koncern med större flöden av fakturor, gärna även momsfrågor.

- goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift

- tillgänglig omgående och kan arbeta på plats på kontoret i västra Göteborg

Meriterande är erfarenhet av Medius och/eller Visma Business.


Personliga egenskaper


För att trivas och lyckas i uppdraget tror vi att du har god förmåga att samarbete - du fungerar väl med olika typer av kollegor. Du är även ansvarsfull och strukturerad i ditt arbete. Du tar initiativ inom dina ramar, och är inte rädd att ställa de frågor som krävs för arbetet. I och med de många kontakter du har i rollen är också av vikt att du är serviceinriktad och kommunikativ.

Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta operativt med leverantörsreskontraprocessen och som ser värdet i att skapa ordning, kvalitet och framdrift i det dagliga ekonomiarbetet.


Ansökan


För mer information om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig Konsultchef Karin Fors via karin.fors@sjr.se. Vi intervjuar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden har gått ut.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!


Konsult hos SJR


Att arbeta som konsult hos SJR innebär att du blir en del av en dedikerad organisation med kompetens att ge dig perfekta förutsättningar att utvecklas både inom din yrkesroll och på ett personligt plan. Du får tillgång till vårt stora nätverk av intressanta företag och uppdragsgivare och därmed en unik möjlighet att ta din karriär till nästa steg.

Vi på SJR bryr oss om vår personal och tillsammans med oss får du en långsiktig partner som ger dig trygghet och stöd. Vi är lyhörda för dina behov och du kommer att ha en nära relation med din konsultchef som stöttar dig i din utveckling.
