IT Object Leader - Surface Ship
jobs.description:
Vi tror att framsteg och möjligheter skapas bäst tillsammans. Välkommen till en plats där samarbete gör skillnad.

Din roll

Vill du vara den som ser till att nästa generations fartyg byggs med rätt IT, i rätt tid och med de smartaste verktygen? Nu söker vi en IT Object Leader till Business Unit Surface Ships som vill äga den helheten och driva den framåt.

Du blir IT:s röst i vår governancemodell (pm3) och affärens viktigaste partner inom IT. Rollen är en kombination av IT Delivery Manager och Business Relationship Manager. Du ansvarar både för att rätt saker levereras och för att skapa en välfungerande relation mellan IT och verksamheten.

Du är den operativa motparten till vår Business Object Leader (BOL). Tillsammans ser ni till att pm3-objektet är framåtlutat och inte bara reagerar på det som redan hänt. Du ser också till att IT prioriterar det som skapar mest värde för affären, när det behövs. Och du håller AI, cloud och nya arbetssätt på agendan hela tiden, inte som ett sidoprojekt.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

    Äga roadmapen - Du ansvarar för den IT-relaterade delen av pm3-objektplanen och formar färdplanen tillsammans med BOL. Du tittar framåt, utmanar och ser till att vi satsar på rätt saker.
    Göra behov till leverans - Du översätter verksamhetens behov till tekniska krav och user stories, leder sprintplaneringen och håller backloggen skarpt prioriterad mot affärsvärde.
    Driva innovation - Du bevakar hur AI, molntjänster och ny teknik kan förändra hur vi designar, bygger och följer upp fartyg. Sedan omsätter du det i konkreta initiativ.
    Bygga broar mellan agilt och traditionellt - Du översätter agila mätetal till leveransdatum och rapporterar leveranssäkerhet, resurser och risker till styrgrupp, CIO och affärsägare. Du gör det på ett sätt som skapar förtroende åt båda hållen.
    Säkra rätt team - Tillsammans med Service Managers och IT Site Managers ser du till att vi har rätt kompetens och kapacitet på plats.

Du jobbar nära Business Object Leader, Head of Operational Development, Service Managers och ansvariga inom Arkitektur och Cybersecurity.

Här får du ett verkligt helhetsansvar och mandat att påverka. Du jobbar med avancerad teknik i ett sammanhang som betyder något: att bygga fartyg som bidrar till säkerhet och försvarsförmåga. Du får också en roll där innovation är en del av uppdraget, inte något du behöver kämpa för att få tid till.

Din profil

Du har ett driv som märks. Du väntar inte på att någon ska ge dig uppdraget, utan tar det, sätter riktningen och får andra att följa med. Du är en projektledare i grunden som gillar att få saker att hända och håller ihop leveranser även när tempot är högt.

Du trivs med människor, alla sorters. Ingenjören som vill ha detaljerna, chefen som vill ha helheten, utvecklaren som vill ha arbetsro. Du läser av rummet, anpassar dig och bygger relationer som håller när det blåser.

Du är tekniskt nyfiken på riktigt. Du hänger med i vad som händer inom AI och Cloud, testar gärna själv och ser möjligheter där andra ser komplexitet. Samtidigt förstår du, eller vill snabbt förstå, hur ett fartyg blir till från konstruktion till leverans och var IT gör störst skillnad längs vägen.

Vi tror också att du har:

    en akademisk examen inom exempelvis datavetenskap, systemvetenskap eller civil-/högskoleingenjör inom maskinteknik eller elektroteknik
    erfarenhet av att navigera mellan agila arbetssätt och traditionell projektstyrning
    vana att leda tvärfunktionella initiativ och workshops

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från producerande industri med komplexa produkter och integrerade affärsprocesser.

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

jobs.title: Responsable bourses et mobilité internationale F/H
jobs.description:
Vos missions

Vous assurez la gestion des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels et contribuez au pilotage de celui-ci.

Vous garantissez la qualité, la conformité et le suivi administratif et financier des dispositifs de bourses, notamment dans le cadre du programme Erasmus+.

En complément de cette mission principale, vous contribuez à la mise en œuvre des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses grandes priorités, inclusion et diversité, transition écologique, transformation numérique, participation à la vie démocratique et aux valeurs européennes.

Dans ce cadre, vous participez au développement d’actions à destination des étudiants et des personnels : événements, actions de sensibilisation, formations courtes, ressources et formations en ligne.

En tant que référent-e « Transition numérique » Erasmus+ de la DRI, vous accompagnez également la transformation numérique des processus de mobilité et participez activement au déploiement, au paramétrage fonctionnel et à l’appropriation du logiciel de gestion de la mobilité internationale et des partenariats universitaires au sein de la DRI.

Vos activités

1. Coordonner l’activité du pôle « Bourses »

  • Assurer la gestion des différents dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale des étudiants et des personnels

  • Coordonner la gestion des bourses Erasmus+ et des autres dispositifs de financement nationaux, régionaux ou institutionnels

  • Organiser et promouvoir les bourses de mobilités internationales (campagnes d’attribution des aides, information et accompagnement des étudiants et personnels)

  • Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des dossiers de bourses de mobilité internationale et budgets dédiés

  • Produire les données, indicateurs, bilans et statistiques

  • Garantir le respect des critères d’éligibilité, des procédures et des règles propres aux différents programmes

  • Participer à la définition et à l’évolution des critères et procédures, dans une logique de simplification, de fiabilisation et d’amélioration continue.

  • Contribuer aux rapports Erasmus+, aux bilans institutionnels ainsi qu’aux contrôles et audits éventuels

  • Assurer une veille sur l’évolution des dispositifs de financement de la mobilité internationale

2. Accompagner le déploiement de la solution numérique dédiée à la gestion de la mobilité internationale et la transformation numérique des processus

Dans le cadre du déploiement de cet outil à l’UTC, vous participez à la transformation et à la dématérialisation des processus de gestion de la mobilité internationale.

À ce titre, vous contribuez notamment au/à l’:

  • Déploiement de la solution numérique : analyse des processus existants, workflows, tests, paramétrage…

  • Amélioration régulière : cohérence, fiabilité des données, évolution

  • Accompagnement des membres du service : prise en main, tutoriels

  • Accompagnement des étudiants et personnels

  • Développement d’une utilisation experte progressive : indicateurs et suivi… 

Vous participez ainsi à faire de la solution numérique un outil d’amélioration et de transformation des processus. 

3. Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des priorités de la Charte Erasmus+

Contribuer à la déclinaison opérationnelle des engagements de l’UTC dans le cadre de la Charte Erasmus+ et de ses quatre grandes priorités :

  • Inclusion et diversité : favoriser l’accès à la mobilité des publics ayant moins d’opportunités et améliorer leur accompagnement.

  • Transition écologique : promouvoir une mobilité internationale plus responsable et sensibiliser aux enjeux environnementaux.

  • Transformation numérique : développer les usages et ressources numériques liés à la mobilité et accompagner la dématérialisation des dispositifs Erasmus+.

  • Participation et citoyenneté européenne : développer des actions favorisant la connaissance de l’Europe, de ses valeurs et des opportunités offertes par Erasmus+. 

4. Contribuer à la promotion des actions et événements à destination des étudiants

Contribuer à la promotion de la mobilité internationale et des priorités Erasmus+ :

  • événements étudiants (Erasmus Days, rencontres interculturelles, témoignages, challenges, etc.) ;

  • ateliers de préparation au départ et de valorisation du retour de mobilité ;

  • actions autour de l’Europe, de l’inclusion, de l’interculturalité et de la mobilité durable. 

5. Contribuer au développement des formations courtes et des ressources pédagogiques

Contribuer à la conception et à l’animation de formations courtes, ateliers et ressources pédagogiques, en présentiel, en ligne ou en format hybride, dans le contexte de la mission (tutoriels et ressources numériques destinés aux étudiants et personnels). 

6. Participer aux projets transversaux de la DRI

Participer, selon les besoins, aux projets transversaux de la Direction aux Relations Internationales : projets Erasmus+, alliance européenne SUNRISE, événements internationaux, actions de promotion de la mobilité, internationalisation des formations et démarches d’amélioration continue

Travailler en interaction avec les autres pôles de la DRI, les services et enseignants de l’UTC, les associations étudiantes et les partenaires institutionnels.

Informations complémentaires

Dates pour candidater

Du 29/09/2026 au 29/10/2026

Type de recrutement et date prévisionnelle de recrutement

Poste ouvert aux personnels de catégorie A assistant ingénieur, par voie statutaire (mutation, détachement) ou contractuelle (contrat à durée déterminée d’un an, prolongation possible pouvant aboutir à un CDI) – pourvoi immédiat

Salaire mensuel brut

Suivant statut ou par la voie contractuelle, selon expérience

Pour les fonctionnaires, RIFSEEP : ASI - Groupe 1

Pour les agents contractuels, salaire mensuel brut de 1 867 euros à 3 111 euros, selon expérience

Volume horaire

37 heures et 30 minutes/semaine - 1 607 heures/an

Congés

50 jours de congés, RTT comprise, par année universitaire

Environnement et contexte de travail

Vous intégrerez la direction aux relations internationales et serez placé(e) sous la responsabilité hiérarchique de la directrice aux relations internationales.

Des déplacements occasionnels (formations, réunions, évènements) sont à prévoir.

Contexte

L’ouverture à l’international constitue un pilier du modèle pédagogique de l’UTC et ce depuis sa création. Elle se traduit par une stratégie internationale ambitieuse, des projets d’envergure comme des campus à l’international et une alliance des universités européennes et d’autres projets et partenariats structurants. L’UTC a aujourd’hui plus de 220 partenaires internationaux dans le monde. Certains de ces partenariats ont plus de 40 ans d’existence. L’UTC continue à consolider un réseau européen solide et vise à être un acteur clé dans l’évolution du modèle de l’enseignement supérieur européen. 

Dans ce cadre, l’établissement vise une mobilité internationale sortante de 100% des étudiants de l’UTC. La mobilité Erasmus+ s’envisage dans ce contexte de la promotion de la mobilité, à la gestion des bourses associés jusqu’aux retours de la mobilité.

Pour renforcer cette mobilité, nous accompagnons les étudiantes et étudiants de l’UTC dans l’ensemble des démarches y compris l’obtention des bourses de mobilité internationale.

Finalement, la direction aux relations internationales vise également à promouvoir l’interculturalité, renforcer l’inclusion, la digitalisation et la transition environnementale et ce dans le respect des priorités de la charte Erasmus+ et celles de la stratégie de l’UTC. 

La personne recrutée pourrait contribuer à proposer et développer des actions pour l’implémentation des priorités de la charte Erasmus+ à l’UTC. 


Diplôme et formation

Diplôme : Bac + 2 au minimum, DUT ou licence apprécié(e)

Domaine de formation : Gestion administrative, relations internationales, langues étrangères appliquées.

Expérience

Première expérience professionnelle dans un établissement d’enseignement supérieur vivement souhaitée

Connaissances

Connaissance de l’enseignement supérieur et de son environnement

Connaissance ou capacité à s’approprier rapidement le programme Erasmus+ et les dispositifs de mobilité internationale

Connaissance des principes de gestion administrative et financière

Intérêt pour les enjeux européens, l’internationalisation de l’enseignement supérieur et les priorités du programme Erasmus+

Intérêt pour l’innovation pédagogique et les nouveaux formats d’accompagnement des étudiants

Très bonne maîtrise du français.

Bonne maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais permettant d’interagir avec les étudiants et partenaires internationaux et de travailler sur la documentation Erasmus+. (niveau B1 minimum)

Compétences opérationnelles

Gérer plusieurs campagnes, projets et échéances simultanément

Formaliser et optimiser des processus et workflows

Participer au déploiement fonctionnel d’un outil numérique

Manipuler et contrôler des données

Concevoir et documenter des procédures

Produire des guides, tutoriels et supports destinés aux utilisateurs

Travailler en mode projet et de manière transversale

Concevoir des tableaux de bord, indicateurs de suivi et de performance

Encadrer / animer une équipe

Travailler en équipe

Compétences comportementales

Rigueur, fiabilité et sens de l’organisation

Autonomie et capacité d’initiative

Capacité à gérer les priorités et à respecter les échéances

Appétence pour les outils numériques

Aisance relationnelle et capacité d’animation

Sens du service et de l’accompagnement des étudiants

Sensibilité aux enjeux interculturels, européens, environnementaux et d’inclusion.

jobs.title: QA Manager, Product Growth
jobs.description:
You are a QA Manager leading and developing QA within our Product Growth team. You own our QA strategy and how we approach quality across the full growth journey — from acquisition entry points through website, sign-up, payments, subscriptions, and in-app experiences.

Your mission is to help Product Growth move faster while improving the quality of what we ship. You look beyond individual features and releases to understand the end-to-end customer journey, focusing QA where it matters most — across experimentation, analytics and tracking, payments, and the different devices, browsers, and in-app browsers our users rely on.

You lead and develop our QA team while continuously improving how we work. Through smarter testing strategies, automation, AI, and modern QA practices, you help reduce repetitive manual work, catch more meaningful issues, and enable faster development and release cycles.

Please note that we are hiring for this role in Sweden.

What you will be doing

    

Own the QA strategy and operating model for Product Growth, defining what we test, how we test it, and where QA effort creates the most value

    

Lead, coach, and develop our QA team, supporting their performance, career development, and growing capabilities in areas such as automation

    

Take an end-to-end view of quality across the growth journey, ensuring we test both individual functionality and how experiences work together across surfaces, browsers, devices, and entry points

    

Improve QA processes and prioritization to shorten the time from idea to launch without compromising quality

    

Drive the adoption of test automation, AI, and modern tooling to make QA more effective and scalable

    

Lead the QA approach for larger cross-pod and cross-functional initiatives, identifying risks early and defining the right testing strategy

    

Partner closely with Product and Engineering, and collaborate with Marketing, Design, Analytics, and other teams when needed to ensure quality across the broader customer journey

    

Build a strong quality mindset across Product Growth, making QA an integrated part of product development rather than a final step before release

What skills and experience we think you have

    

QA leadership: Experience leading and developing QA professionals and owning QA strategy, processes, and ways of working

    

Growth product experience: Strong experience testing growth-oriented digital products, including commercial funnels, experimentation/A/B testing, analytics and tracking, conversion journeys, and fast-moving product environments

    

End-to-end quality mindset: You think beyond individual features and understand quality across complete user journeys, including different browsers, devices, entry points, and systems

    

Test automation: Hands-on experience with test automation — whether through implementation, technical evaluation, or close collaboration with automation engineers — strong enough to guide framework and tooling decisions for our stack

    

AI and modern QA practices: Experience using AI and modern QA tooling to improve testing efficiency, effectiveness, or scalability

    

Commercial understanding: Experience with areas such as payments, pricing, subscriptions, or other high-impact commercial flows

    

Strategic and pragmatic thinking: Balances a clear long-term view of where QA needs to go with pragmatic, in-the-moment trade-off calls under time pressure.

    

Risk-based prioritization: Ability to identify where the biggest quality risks lie — including dependencies between features, experiments, and user journeys — and guide the team on where deeper testing or other quality measures deliver the most value.

    

Cross-functional leadership: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence Product, Engineering, and other partners

It's a plus if you also have

    

Experience across both web and mobile apps

    

Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks

    

Experience with subscription-based products

    

Experience working in a regulated or consumer health environment

    

Passion for women's health

What we offer

    

Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location

    

Professional development - you will collaborate with industry leading developers, promoting continuous growth and skill enhancement

    

Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work

    

Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value

    

Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development

Location

We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. Most of the Product Growth team you will work with is located in Stockholm, and the team occasionally meets in the office for collaboration and face-to-face time.

Sounds interesting? If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you!

How to apply

To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.

At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

jobs.title: Master Thesis: Hydrogen trapping and redistribution in martensitic high-str
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated Master’s student to join the AITHOS project, AI-based Trapping characterisation & Hydrogen Odelling in Steels.

Hydrogen embrittlement is a major challenge for high-strength steels. One strategy to improve hydrogen resistance is to engineer carbide precipitates that trap hydrogen and reduce its mobility. The AITHOS project combines experiments, modelling and data-driven methods to understand this behaviour and support future development of hydrogen-tolerant steels.

The Master’s thesis will be carried out primarily at Swerim and will contribute mainly to the experimental work in WP1 and WP2. Possible activities include:

    microstructural characterisation;
    hydrogen charging of steel specimens under controlled conditions;
    measurement and analysis of hydrogen trapping and release, including TDMS;
    mechanical testing of hydrogen-charged specimens;

You will work at Swerim and collaborate closely with researchers from Uppsala University, SSAB and Ovako. The project therefore offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in hydrogen-materials research while developing a professional network spanning both academia and the Swedish steel industry.

The project is suitable for a student who would like to develop expertise at the interface between advanced steel development, hydrogen embrittlement and experimental materials science.

Your profile
We are particularly interested in students with a background in:

    Materials Science and Engineering;
    Applied Physics or Engineering Physics;
    Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field.

Additional Information
The project is planned to be carried out during the spring semester of 2027 at Swerim in Stockholm. Upon successful completion of the Master's thesis (30 ECTS credits), Swerim will provide a compensation of SEK 50,000.

Contact
For further information about the project, please contact: Dr. Birhan Sefer, birhan.sefer@swerim.se

Application
Please apply using the application link below no later than 30 November 2026. Please note that applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the thesis position may be filled before the application deadline if a suitable candidate is identified.

jobs.title: Master Thesis: Recycled aluminium in battery casing application – microstru
jobs.description:
This master thesis is part of the Net Zero Impact Innovation-funded BAALSCRAP project (BAttery casings from ALuminum alloys with low carbon emissions produced from SCRAP), which aims to enable the production of battery cell housings from recycled aluminum scrap and thereby support the transition towards a circular and net-zero automotive industry. The project investigates how alloying elements and impurities originating from recycled feedstock affect manufacturing processes and material performance.

The thesis will focus on the relationship between microstructure and weld properties of recycled aluminum alloys for battery casing applications. The work will involve detailed characterization of welds using light microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM), with emphasis on precipitates, intermetallic particles, segregation, porosity, cracking, and other welding-related defects. The influence of recycled alloying elements and residual impurities on weld quality and performance will be assessed and correlated with material properties. In addition, property calculations (e.g. crack susceptibility) will be used to predict weld performance as a function of alloy composition. The modeling results will be compared with the experimental observations to improve the understanding of microstructure evolution during welding and to help explain the relationship between alloy chemistry, weld microstructure, and weld performance.

Desired Qualifications
We are looking for a highly motivated Master's student in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Materials Engineering, or a related field. The ideal candidate has an interest in experimental research and materials characterization, with a particular focus on microstructure-property relationships in metallic materials. Experience or coursework in microscopy, welding metallurgy, aluminum alloys, or electron microscopy is advantageous but not required.

Additional Information

jobs.title: Senior AI & Automation Engineer (Team) - 19795/19794
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An experienced Senior AI & Automation Engineer is needed to help transform End User Services into an AI-native, zero-touch operating model. The assignment focuses on designing and delivering intelligent self-service capabilities, AI agents, and automated workplace solutions across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, Citrix, and ServiceNow.

You will own the workplace AI and automation backlog and its delivery, reducing repetitive Service Desk activities through Copilot Studio agents, self-service workflows, and closed-loop automation. The solutions will support incident handling, access management, software delivery, onboarding and offboarding, device lifecycle management, endpoint provisioning, configuration, and proactive remediation.

Key Responsibilities

    Own and deliver the workplace AI and automation backlog, from proof of concept through secure, supportable production implementation.
    Design and develop AI-assisted ticket handling, troubleshooting, knowledge search, and autonomous workflows with risk-based approvals and human controls.
    Build intelligent self-service solutions, Copilot Studio agents, and closed-loop automation to reduce manual Service Desk work.
    Develop GenAI and agent-based solutions using LLMs/SLMs, RAG, Agentic RAG, tool calling, MCP/A2A, and LLMOps/GenAIOps practices.
    Integrate enterprise workplace platforms through APIs, orchestration, infrastructure as code, scripting, and CI/CD pipelines.
    Automate workflows involving incidents, identity and access, endpoint provisioning, software, onboarding/offboarding, configuration, and remediation.
    Implement DEX, AIOps, and observability capabilities to proactively identify endpoint and user-experience issues and trigger automated remediation.
    Ensure solutions apply Zero Trust principles, least privilege, RBAC, secure agent and tool access, data protection, auditability, and controlled approvals.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    AI and automation: Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, AI agents, RAG, vector search, LLMOps, GenAIOps, AIOps, and event-driven automation.
    Programming and scripting: Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, JSON, YAML, and KQL.
    Microsoft workplace technologies: Microsoft 365, Intune, Windows Autopilot, Entra ID, Defender for Endpoint, Azure automation services, and Power Platform.
    IT service management: ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, Virtual Agent, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
    Automation and delivery tooling: Ansible Automation Platform, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, Git, and CI/CD.
    Virtual workplace and endpoint technologies: Citrix Virtual Apps & Desktops, endpoint management, application delivery, and Digital Employee Experience monitoring.

Qualifications & Experience

You bring 10+ years of experience in End User Services, EUC, workplace engineering, Service Desk, endpoint engineering, or platform engineering, including large-scale workplace automation. Practical experience building AI, GenAI, Copilot, or agent-based solutions and integrating enterprise platforms through APIs and orchestration is required.

You should have demonstrated experience taking proof-of-concept solutions into secure, supportable production environments. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience is expected. Relevant Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune, Security, AI, Power Platform, Red Hat Ansible, and/or ServiceNow certifications are advantageous. Experience with ITIL, SRE, Zero Trust, FinOps, and modern agentic AI is also beneficial.

jobs.title: Restaurangchef Kungsholmen
jobs.description:
Leader of Bastard Burgers

Välkommen till Bastard Burgers! Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en mycket progressiv och ständigt utvecklande miljö. Tillsammans med andra kollegor är du med och skapar nästa generations streetfood.

I din roll kan du förvänta dig mycket skratt, samarbeten, utmaningar och utveckling. Att vara en Leader of Bastard betyder att du är flexibel, ser möjligheter och har stor förståelse för hela restaurangen, så väl köket som kassan. Genom ett positivt mindset är du högst delaktig i att få ditt team att arbeta tillsammans. En Leader of Bastard leder med gott exempel i enlighet med Bastard Burgers ledarskapsprinciper och värderingar.

I rollen förväntas du ta ett högt ägandeskap för tilldelad enhet samt strävar efter att ge bästa kvalité och service till våra gäster. Genom att följa Bastard Burgers strukturer, rutiner och använda att vår sociala plattform för att interagera med dina kollegor bidrar du till en ”vi-känsla” som kan ta oss hur långt som helst. Vi kommer göra vårt bästa för att du ska utvecklas men vi förväntar oss också ditt engagemang och nyfikenhet och på så sätt skapar vi kontinuerligt lärande.



Restaurangchef Om rollen

Vi vill jobba med dig som älskar människor och mat lika mycket som oss. Som restaurangchef på Bastard Burgers ansvarar du för att servicen håller en hög nivå och att såväl gäster som medarbetare är nöjda och glada. Du leder teamet med rätt inställning och bra energi. Du har erfarenhet från tidigare restaurang- eller serviceyrke och förstår att det blir stressiga stunder men att servicen/maten alltid måste vara utmärkt. Du får ett övergripande ansvar för schemaläggning, inköp, personalkostnader och i princip allt som händer i restaurangen. Arbetet innebär ett stort driftfokus, kök och kassa, med administrativa inslag där du förväntas ta ett högt ägandeskap. Operativt arbete i driften ca 80 % av arbetstiden.

Övergripande ansvarsområden:


    Ta ansvar för resultaten och enheten som helhet – i relation till uppsatta nyckeltal
    Utbilda och rekrytera personal
    Ansvarig för att mäta, utvärdera samt utveckla och rapportera resultaten på sin enhet
    Systematiskt göra uppföljningar i interna system
    Upprätta säkra arbetsförhållanden och följa det interna systematiska arbetsmiljöarbetet
    Se till att livsmedelssäkerheten följs i enlighet med hygienbestämmelser
    Aktivt arbeta med och implementera Bastard Burgers likabehandlingsplan och värdeord på sin enhet

Är vi en match? Vi söker dig som...


    Utbildningskrav: inget
    Har tidigare erfarenhet från restaurang- eller serviceyrke, gärna med personal och budgetansvar
    Du skall kunna svenska och/eller engelska, meriterande att behärska båda språken
    Möjlighet att arbeta flexibla timmar, inklusive kväller och helger  Önskvärda beteenden och erfarenheter:  
    Har en utmärkt kommunikationsförmåga
    God organisations- och ledarskapsförmåga, där du är strukturerad och ansvarstagande
    Motiveras av och kan motivera medarbetare till att jobba efter uppsatta mål
    Har ett engagemang för Bastard Burgers och har gärna koll på oss sedan tidigare!
    Vi ser gärna att du bor i närområdet av enheten



Vi erbjuder dig

Bastard Burgers värdeord är kvalité, kultur och människor, där dessa ligger till grund för gemensamma mål. En tjänst hos oss innebär en möjlighet att få vara delaktig i ett innovativt och snabbt växande företag, där vi är stolta över vår kultur och familjära känsla!

Perks:

•    Föräldraförmån – vi toppar upp föräldrapenningen!* (upp till ett visst belopp). •    Kollektivavtal (tjänstepension, förmåner etc.) •    Friskvårdsbidrag  •    Betald startavgift för lopp och tävlingar • Personalrabatt på alla Bastard Burgers i Sverige, Norge, Finland

Om Bastard Burgers

Bastard Burgers är ett ungt och snabbt växande företag som grundades i Luleå, Sverige, år 2016. Idag finns det fler än 70 Bastard Burgers-restauranger runt om i hela Sverige och ytterligare restauranger i Finland och Norge.

Vi är stora och vi växer snabbt, men vägrar tappa personlighet eller bli basic. Kom hit för att du gillar musik, graffiti, streetwear, riktigt bra streetfood, klistermärken på borden, svengelska – allt det där som gör Bastard Burgers till Bastard Burgers. Kärlek till mat och människor har skapat en stark kultur runt Bastard Burgers, där såväl klimatsmarta initiativ som högljudd hiphop ryms.

Mångfald och inkludering

Bastard Burgers värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten. Vi ser därför gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet, vår ambition är att rekrytera medarbetare från olika bakgrunder. Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Mechanical and Piping Engineer needed!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Mechanical & Piping professional looking for your next challenge? In this role, you will take ownership of engineering and design, drive quality and collaborate with international partners to deliver complex projects. Does this sound like the opportunity you’ve been looking for?

About the position

We at Perido are now looking for a Mechanical and Piping Engineer to our client, a Swedish industrial company developing large-scale production of green iron and steel using green hydrogen and renewable energy, with the aim of significantly reducing the steel industry’s carbon emissions. As mechanical piping engineer, you will report to the Engineering Lead, but you will also participate in the cross-functional delivery teams. The position is based in Stockholm, with the flexibility to work 50% from home.

Your daily tasks

The Mechanical & Piping engineer is responsible for overseeing the mechanical piping design work for one of the areas (Steel Mill, Iron Reduction, Hydrogen Plant, Balance of Plant and Ground Works) in a project. You will be responsible for ensuring the coordination of the engineering partners to reach cost and time-efficient design solutions for all Mechanical & Piping work related to your area.

Key responsibilities:

    Take ownership of Mechanical & Piping engineering and design
    Provide guidance on engineering and design strategies, concepts and solutions
    Ensure that engineering work complies with applicable codes, standards, regulations, equipment specifications and process equipment operating targets
    Drive quality assurance and continuous performance improvement throughout the organization
    Manage and oversee the engineering work delivered by EPCM and OEM partners, ensuring that they have the information and feedback required to deliver safely, on time and within budget
    Represent the company as the single point of contact for the Mechanical & Piping discipline, with responsibility for delivery and quality
    Develop and select engineering and design standards and procedures to ensure consistent quality and compliance with requirements

Your characteristics

You have excellent management, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in complex, cross-functional environments involving multiple teams and sometimes competing priorities. You communicate confidently in English, both verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders, and are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where processes and procedures may not always be clearly defined.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

In this recruitment process, we only accept applications written in English.

Qualifications:

    Previous working experience in major industrial capital projects
    Highly developed knowledge of industrial scale piping and/or mechanical static/rotating installations
    Previous project experience within Scandinavian codes and standards
    Experience with PED
    Experience in project planning, execution (including construction realities), management, and communication with all stakeholders in large successful capital projects
    Experience in working with EPCM Mechanical engineers
    Must be knowledgeable about industry best practices and change management
    Recent experience in engineering and construction activities in large capital projects
    Experience managing engineering partners or third parties
    Fluent in English

Contract type and hours

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-06-30. Start 2026-10-27.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

jobs.title: Platform Specialist
jobs.description:
Company Description

IKEA is on a constant journey to create a better everyday life for the many people by continuously re-invent us as we continue to grow and develop to meet and exceed our customers’ needs. We will transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question, and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us.  

To realize our ambitions in the IKEA Supply Strategy, IKEA has recognized the need to improve and modernize our work methods. We are working on harmonizing and standardizing our Transport Platforms processes. This new position is an excellent opportunity to provide strategic oversight for release scheduling and resource planning, aligning the release strategy with business priorities and Digital Product’s needs.

As a person, you are valued for your collaborative spirit and your strong leadership, which focuses equally on processes, platforms, and people.

Job Description

We are looking for a Platform Specialist to handle the complexities and demands of managing releases within the Ivalua environment (for Direct and Indirect Procurement).

In this role, you will be driving the teams to ensure smooth operations and strategic management of our future releases. Act as a Configurator for configuring, and optimizing platform capabilities to meet business needs

We expect you to improve coordination and efficiency across Digital Product and Platform teams, aiming for a continuous improvement of current Ways of Working ensuring quality and risk mitigation.

More specifically, in this role you will be covering following topics:

    IVALUA Configuration:
    responsible for configuring new features, implementing enhancements, and translating business requirements into scalable IVALUA solutions.
    Release Planning:
    Develop and maintain release schedules for various digital products and platforms.
    Coordinate with digital product leaders, platform leaders and other stakeholders to ensure alignment on release timelines.
    Coordination and Collaboration:
    Act as a primary liaison between different teams such as development, testing, operations, and product teams.
    Facilitate communication and collaboration to ensure all stakeholders are aware of release plans, progress, and issues.
    Quality Assurance:
    Ensure that releases meet quality standards and performance metrics.
    Oversee testing and validation processes to confirm that new features and updates are functioning correctly before deployment.
    Risk Management:
    Identify potential risks and issues that could affect the release schedule or quality.
    Develop and implement mitigation strategies to address these risks.
    Deployment Management:
    Manage the deployment process, including staging, rollback procedures, and production deployment.
    Ensure that deployment follows best practices and is carried out smoothly with minimal disruption.
    Documentation and Reporting:
    Maintain detailed documentation of release processes, timelines, and outcomes.
    Provide regular updates and reports to relevant stakeholders on release status, issues, and impact.
    Process Improvement:
    Continuously assess and improve release management processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
    Implement automation tools and techniques to streamline release activities.
    Compliance and Governance:
    Ensure that all release activities comply with organizational policies, standards, and regulations.
    Maintain proper records and audit trails of all release actions and decisions.
    Customer Communication:
    Coordinate with business support to inform end-users about upcoming releases, new features, and any potential downtime.
    Post-Release Support:
    Monitor the performance and impact of releases of post-deployment.
    Address any issues or bugs that arise after the release and ensure quick resolution.
    Coordinate incident management processes during hyper care in collaboration with other teams/platforms/solutions to swiftly address any critical issues that arise during or after a release. Document and learn from incidents to prevent future occurrences.
    Gather feedback from stakeholders to post-release to understand the impact and areas for improvement. Use this feedback to refine future release processes and enhance product quality.

Qualifications

To be successful in this job you have:

    Strong experience in IVALUA configuration
    Understanding of Ivalua environment
    Strong experience in release and environment management
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
    Understanding Middleware
    Knowledge of Application Lifecycle Management methodologies and tools.
    Experience with or knowledge of Platforms infrastructure, including deployment and migration strategies
    Experience or knowledge of managing SaaS platforms (e.g., Ivalua, SAP, etc.)
    Proficiency in project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc.) and tools (JIRA, confluence, Miro, etc.).
    Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with digital releases.
    Skills in resource planning and allocation to ensure successful delivery of releases.
    Ensure that releases meet defined quality and performance standards.
    Strong verbal and written communication skills for effective coordination with cross-functional teams.
    Ability to lead and motivate teams, manage conflicts, and drive projects to completion.
    Strong analytical skills to troubleshoot issues that arise during the release process.
    Meticulousness in ensuring that all details of the release process are managed correctly.

In this role you will report to our Platform Area Manager within Supply Data & Technology.

Additional information

This position is located in Malmö or Älmhult, Sweden, please also note that we do only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. We look forward to receiving your application by the latest 13 Oct. 2026.

You might have some questions about the recruitment process, and we are more than happy to answer those! For more information about the position, please contact Hiring Manager Ilaria Tamburiello, Platform Area Manager Data & Technology at ilaria.tamburriello@inter.ikea.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Katie Pettersson at katie.pettersson2@inter.ikea.com.

jobs.title: Two tenure track positions in Economics
jobs.description:
The Department of Economics at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) seeks candidates for two tenure-track assistant professor positions. Applicants from any field within economics will be considered (with particular focus on theory, microeconomics and applied microeconomics). The appointments start August 1, 2027, and applicants are expected to have completed their Ph.D. or equivalent degree by then. The deadline for applications is November 16, 2026. Applications should be submitted on the EconJobMarket.org website and should include a cover letter, CV, three letters of reference, and a job market paper (clearly labeled) as well as additional papers (optional). Interviews will be conducted online. We intend to interview most applicants in December 2026 around the time of the European Job Market. For further information about the Department of Economics, see https://www.hhs.se/research/departments/economics/ or contact petya.thorne@hhs.se.

Interviews will be conducted remotely by video starting December 2026.

To apply for this position, log in to your account at EconJobMarket.



About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

jobs.title: Business Analyst - Digital Commercial Analytics
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

At H&M, we are committed to creating meaningful growth through customer-centric and data-informed decision making. We are now looking for a Business Analyst to join the Digital Commercial Analytics team.

In this role, you will combine commercial understanding, analytical expertise and stakeholder collaboration to identify opportunities, evaluate business performance and support sustainable growth across our digital business. You will work closely with QCP (Quantified Commercial Plan), Marketing, Digital, Controlling and Sales Markets to translate data into insights and recommendations that strengthen commercial decision-making and execution.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Analyse digital and commercial performance to identify opportunities, risks and growth drivers.
    Turn strategic business questions into actionable insights and recommendations through customer, sales and behavioural analysis.
    Develop business cases and support prioritisation of initiatives and investments.
    Conduct deep-dive analyses to understand customer behaviour and the drivers behind business performance.
    Partner with QCP to develop, maintain and evolve frameworks, tools, guidelines and best practices.
    Drive best practices, analytical frameworks and capability development for Commercial Business Analysts across Sales Markets, enabling more consistent and impactful commercial decision-making.
    Provide analytical support and insights related to post-purchase customer experience, fulfilment, returns and customer behaviour.
    Support business reviews, hindsight analyses and strategic planning through fact-based recommendations.
    Contribute to the continuous development of analytical methods, tools, technologies and ways of working within the team.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will be part of the Digital Commercial Analytics team within the Digital Unit in the Commercial function, working closely with global and local commercial stakeholders, analysts, data teams and digital functions. The team’s mission is to drive digital business performance through advanced analytics, strategic insights, and business cases that enable better decision-making across H&M’s global online business.

The role reports to the Digital Commercial Manager.

WHO YOU ARE

We believe you are a highly analytical and commercially minded person who enjoys solving complex business challenges through data and insights. You can connect customer behaviour, digital performance and commercial outcomes, translating findings into recommendations that create business impact.

You are comfortable working across functions, influencing stakeholders through a fact-based approach and communicating complex topics in a clear and engaging way.

We are looking for people with:

    5+ years of experience within business analysis, commercial analytics, business controlling, commercial planning or a similar field.
    Strong understanding of digital business, e-commerce and customer behaviour
    Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with complex datasets.
    Strong understanding of commercial performance drivers, customer behaviour and digital business KPIs.
    Proven ability to develop business cases and translate insights into recommendations and actions.
    Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation and modern analytical capabilities to enhance analysis, improve ways of working and strengthen decision-making.
    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
    Experience working with analytical tools and platforms such as Power BI, Excel, BigQuery and other data analysis tools.
    A collaborative mindset and a passion for driving business impact through insights.

Additional Information

This is a fulltime permanent role based in Stockholm, Sweden.

If you believe your experience, skills, and ambitions align with this role, please submit your CV in English before 1st of October.

Diversity, Inclusion, and Innovation

At H&M Group, we're deeply committed to fostering a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We actively seek out qualified candidates regardless of race, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, national origin, disability, or age.

Our commitment to an inclusive workplace drives our dynamic and forward-thinking culture. Regardless of your background, origin, or preferences, your application is warmly welcomed. We value diverse perspectives and skills, and every applicant contributes to our vibrant, creative community. Join us and be part of the future we're building.

Our Offer

At H&M Group, you're not just joining a team – you're joining a value-driven culture and an expansive tech network. Enjoy perks like staff discount cards, flexible work arrangements, wellness benefits, parental support, and more. Here, you're encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and chart your own growth path. As you flourish, so do we, with opportunities to create tangible impacts and shape the future.

Additional Information

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

JOIN US  

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth.

jobs.title: Incident and Change Management Specialist
jobs.description:
Our vision at Orange Cyberdefense is to contribute to a safer digital society by helping our customers prevent and manage different types of cyber threats. We are all passionate about cybersecurity and work together to support our customers throughout their security journey.

Your role as an ICM Specialist (Incident and Change Management Specialist)

In this role, you will work together with eight colleagues in a team that was established five years ago with the aim of improving the service we deliver to our customers. You will play an important role in supporting our customers, and we are looking for someone who is passionate about customer service and incident management. This position involves working a three-shift schedule (morning, afternoon, and night).

Examples of responsibilities

    

Manage incoming customer requests by collecting and handling cases, incidents, and service requests.

    

Perform the initial assessment of all incoming customer cases, resolve them when possible, or escalate them to the appropriate department.

    

Respond to alerts from our monitoring systems.

    

Coordinate the daily activities of our cybersecurity technicians.

    

Coordinate hardware replacements for our customers.

    

Contribute to the development of work routines and processes.

    

Create and maintain documentation.

Who are we?

Orange Cyberdefense is Sweden's leading cybersecurity company. Our vision is to contribute to securing the digital society. We provide our customers with services across a wide range of areas, from in-depth technical solutions such as SOC, firewall solutions, technical threat analysis, vulnerability management, and SIEM, to broader services such as security governance and management, risk modeling, and risk analysis. We have 2,700 colleagues globally, including 400 colleagues in Sweden.

At Orange Cyberdefense, we are all different but share a passion for cybersecurity — and that is our greatest strength. We are proud of our differences, experiences, and backgrounds, and we firmly believe that we need to include everyone in order to provide solutions that work for everyone. That is why we ensure that all applications are handled fairly and equally.

Why should you join us?

    

The opportunity to work alongside some of the industry's most dedicated cybersecurity experts and with market-leading technology.

    

A flexible working environment with excellent opportunities for professional development.

    

A Challenger culture that encourages curiosity, initiative, and knowledge sharing.

    

We help secure the IT environments of large international companies.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who loves delivering high-quality service and thrives in a Challenger culture where there are many things happening at once. You have previous experience working with the Microsoft Office suite and experience working at Level 1 with incident management.

Experience or certifications in any of the following areas are considered an advantage:

    

ITIL Service Management

    

Network+

    

Security+

    

CCNA

Additional information

We recruit continuously and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person.

Orange Cyberdefense – Together, we build a safer digital society.

jobs.title: Undersköterska IVA
jobs.description:
Är du intresserad av att bli en del av ett härligt team som tillsammans utför livsviktiga insatser varje dag för patienter i alla åldrar? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Hos oss får du möjlighet att både använda och utveckla dina kunskaper som undersköterska. Arbetet på vår intensivvårdsavdelning är omväxlande och stimulerande. Vi bedriver avancerad intensivvård med övervakning och behandling av patienter med svikt i vitala funktioner. Som undersköterska hos oss blir du en viktig del av ett engagerat team tillsammans med intensivvårdssjuksköterskor och läkare. Tjänsten är ett vikariat som sträcker sig till och med augusti 2027.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska och som trivs i mötet med människor. Du har ett professionellt och förtroendeingivande bemötande och bidrar till att våra patienter känner sig trygga och välkomna.

Du är lyhörd, ansvarstagande och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra. Du bidrar med en god teamkänsla och ett positivt förhållningssätt, även när tempot är högt. Hög servicekänsla och kvalitetsmedvetenhet är egenskaper som vi värdesätter. Som person är du trygg i din roll och kan behålla lugnet i situationer som kräver det. På intensivvårdsavdelningen arbetar c:a 60 personer, fördelade på anestesiologer, specialistsjuksköterskor inom intensivvård och allmänsjuksköterskor, undersköterskor samt en sekreterare. I anslutning till IVA har vi en uppvakningsavdelning och en dagkirurgisk avdelning som idag bemannas av allmänsjuksköterskor och undersköterskor. På IVA vårdas ca 600 patienter per år i alla åldrar med skiftande diagnoser. Alla patienter som vårdats mer än 92 timmar erbjuds att besöka vår Post IVA - mottagning. Vi deltar i traumalarm och akutlarm på sjukhuset. Vi bistår även barnkliniken med ventilatorvård på Neonatalavdelningen.

Trots att vi är det mindre akutsjukhuset har vi de flesta specialiteter representerade hos oss såsom kirurgi, ortopedi, medicin, kvinnoklinik med förlossning, barnklinik med neonatalavdelning, ögon och öron. Infektionskliniken är lokaliserad i Kalmar där vi har ett nära samarbete. Vårt sjukhus styrka är korta och snabba beslutsvägar med personlig kontakt och relation över klinikgränserna. Detta möjliggör att vi kan bedriva vår intensivvård med hög kvalité och goda resultat.

Västerviks sjukhus är ett av tre sjukhus i Kalmar län. Sjukhuset är ett akutsjukhus med förlossningsvård och BB. På Västerviks sjukhus finns jobb för dig som vill utvecklas i din roll tillsammans med trevliga kollegor. Här arbetar drygt 1200 medarbetare och vi har en fin sammanhållning och en bred kompetens. Sjukhuset är lagom stort och du får en trygg, och trivsam anställning med möjlighet till att lära nytt. Det ligger i anslutning till Västerviks centrum och är nära skärgården.

Region Kalmar län ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, folkhögskolor, kultur, kollektivtrafik och regional utveckling. Vi är över 7 000 medarbetare som alla jobbar tillsammans för ett friskare, tryggare och rikare liv för länets invånare. Hos oss får du många förmåner och ett av Sveriges bästa kollektivavtal. Vi möter människor i livets alla skeden och har ett meningsfullt och utvecklande arbete – varje dag.

Region Kalmar län erbjuder alla medarbetare en anställning på 100%. Om du arbetar deltid men önskar arbeta heltid kan utökning av tjänst erbjudas vid annan arbetsplats.

Vi vill att du bifogar CV, personligt brev och för tjänsten relevanta utbildningsbevis till din ansökan. För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Region Kalmar län vill vi att du söker tjänsten i vårt rekryteringssystem och inte via e-post eller i pappersformat.

jobs.title: Network Developer
jobs.description:
Senior Network Developer

About Share

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure across Africa (fiber routes, subsea capacity, data centers, cloud on-ramps) into a single intelligence layer. That lets ISPs, hyperscalers and AI companies get connectivity where they need it in seconds, not months.

Today, bandwidth is bought and sold through slow, private, one-off deals, with almost no price transparency. We're replacing that with one neutral exchange: an API on top of real infrastructure, with prices set by actual supply and demand. It's already live across East Africa, with thousands of kilometers of fiber, 12 infrastructure providers, 10 data centers, and around 8 million people served.

The Role

Our network is the foundation of the product. Every route a customer provisions through our API has to exist, perform and stay up on real hardware. We're hiring a Senior Network Developer to design and build that network as software: a distributed, multi-provider fabric that engineers change through code, not by logging into devices.

You'll own the network architecture end to end. That covers our BGP edge (transit, peering at KIXP and LINX, private interconnects with hyperscalers), the backbone, and the PoPs and data centers we're adding across the continent. You'll set the standards our network is built to, which partner ISPs connecting to us will inherit. As we grow, you'll also help build the network engineering team.

What you'll do

  • Design the backbone and PoP architecture as standard, repeatable building blocks, from edge to data center, so we can add capacity and new markets without redesigning each time.

  • Drive our move to Segment Routing and a clean IP architecture, including IPv4 reuse, IPv6, and how customer and internal address space coexist.

  • Build on disaggregated white-box hardware (Edgecore with IP Infusion OcNOS today), and make the hardware and software calls that keep us fast and affordable.

  • Turn operations into software. That means a source of truth (Nautobot), templated config (Jinja), and CI/CD with validation, staged rollouts and rollback for every change.

  • Build the telemetry and observability that show what the network is really doing. Use AI where it actually helps: anomaly detection, automated triage, and auto-remediation with a human in the loop.

  • Own availability. Limit how much any failure can affect, mitigate first and diagnose second, and turn post-mortems into fixes in the system.

  • Work with our software team on the API and provisioning layer that exposes the network to customers, and with partner ISPs' engineers on the hand-off.

  • Help hire and develop the engineers who'll run this with you.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 8+ years building and operating large networks at a hyperscaler, CDN, internet exchange, carrier or ISP.

  • Deep BGP at scale: route policy, communities, RPKI, traffic engineering, peering and transit.

  • Strong data center and backbone design. You know Clos/EVPN-VXLAN fabrics and MPLS or Segment Routing, and when each makes sense.

  • Hands-on with white-box or disaggregated networking, including choosing hardware and knowing where the silicon limits you.

  • You treat the network as code. You write automation yourself (Python or similar), and you've built or run the pipelines, source of truth and telemetry that make that safe.

  • You've owned availability for something that couldn't go down, and can walk us through a real incident: what broke, how you found it, and what you changed.

  • AI-native in how you work. You've built with these tools, not just used them, and you have a view on where they help in operations and where they don't.

  • You think like an owner. You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network.

  • A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.

Nice to have

  • Experience at an internet exchange, or running peering at scale.

  • Open networking stacks like SONiC, OcNOS or FRR, or contributions to them.

  • Streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, sFlow), and building your own monitoring tooling.

  • 400G/800G and optical (ZR) deployments, including vendor selection and certification.

  • Access networks (GPON/XGS-PON) and MikroTik or Huawei gear, since many partner ISPs run it.

  • Building networks in emerging markets such as Africa or Latin America.

  • DDoS mitigation at the edge.

If you don't tick every box but have built and run large networks in production, apply anyway.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a venture-backed company (US-incorporated, with a Kenya operating entity)

jobs.title: Network Operation Engineer
jobs.description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Troubleshoot and resolve. This is where you earn your seat. Confirm the alert is real, gather the facts, and localise the fault: one peer or many, us or upstream, a real outage or a monitoring blip. The assistive layer surfaces a likely diagnosis and a suggested fix, the config history is right there in Git, and the runbooks are live. Your job is to read all of it critically, decide what is actually true, and close out what you can on your own. Every ticket you resolve yourself is one our senior people did not get pulled out of deep work, or out of bed, to deal with.

Keep the network healthy, not just alive. A quiet shift is not an idle one. Run the proactive passes: check that routes are propagating the way they should, that RPKI and filter chains are doing their job, that peering and transit sessions are clean across the edge, that no PoP is drifting toward a capacity wall. Catch the slow degradations that never trip an alert. The day team should inherit a network in a known good state.

Build and automate. The repetitive parts of this job should not stay repetitive. Write the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one. Push our config automation forward (Jinja driven generation, NAPALM or NETCONF/gNMI against the devices) so changes ship from data, not from memory. When the assistive layer keeps missing the same thing, that is a candidate for automation, and you are well placed to build it during the hours nobody else is online.

Move the work forward. You are part of the network team, working the same board they do. Pick up tickets from the Linear queue, take config changes through review to merge, and keep our source of truth (Nautobot) accurate as the estate changes. Real work lands while East Africa is offline, so the team wakes up further ahead than they went to bed.

Report exactly what is happening. For everything you cannot or should not fix alone, the handoff has to be clean: what is wrong, where, since when, what is affected, whether it is getting worse, and what you have already tried. No guessing dressed up as fact. No "the internet is down." A clear, written incident note a senior engineer can act on the moment they open it, and a tidy handover to the East Africa team at the end of your shift.

Escalate well. Know the ladder cold: what you are cleared to touch, what you must not touch alone, and who to bring in for what. Escalating early on a genuine outage is good judgment. Sitting silently on a problem because you were unsure is the one thing that gets people out of bed angry. Handle what you can, raise the rest fast and clearly, and do not turn either dial too far.

3. Who we're looking for

A network engineer who can stand on their own through a shift, and who treats the quiet hours as time to build rather than time to wait. You will not be the most senior engineer on this team, and you do not need to be. The people you escalate to are CCIE level. What we need from you is independence and range: work a problem properly, resolve a fair share of it yourself, and use what is left of the shift to actually move the network forward. Pair that with clear reporting, sound judgment about when to bring in help, and the instinct to question a machine's suggestion rather than follow it blindly, and you are who we are looking for.

Must-have

  • Strong networking competence, held in your hands rather than on paper. CCNA and well beyond it. You understand TCP/IP, routing and switching, IP addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and how they behave when they go wrong.

  • Real troubleshooting instinct. Given a degraded link or a dropped session, you know where to look and what to rule out. You can read BGP session state, follow a path with ping and traceroute, and tell a local fault from an upstream one without waiting to be told.

  • Working BGP knowledge. Reading communities and route policy, spotting a flap or a leaky origin, understanding how transit, peering, and RPKI behave at the edge.

  • Comfortable on the gear and the CLI. Linux, network device CLIs, and dashboards are familiar ground. We run MikroTik (RouterOS) across the network and so do many partners, so RouterOS experience is a real plus.

  • Comfortable working with config in Git. Configuration lives in repos, not on devices. Reading a diff, understanding why a config changed, and proposing one yourself should not be foreign to you.

  • Some scripting, and the appetite to do more. Bash or Python, enough to automate the repetitive parts away and to grow into our config and automation pipelines. We are not hiring a button pusher.

  • Clear written English. You can describe a technical situation accurately and briefly so someone picking it up cold understands it instantly.

  • Calm under pressure and dependable. When the graphs go red you get more precise, not more panicked. You show up for every shift, alert and on time.

  • Located in New Zealand or a nearby time zone where covering our deep overnight maps onto your normal working day.

Nice-to-have

  • CCNP, or MikroTik MTCNA / MTCRE.

  • Prior NOC, ISP, or carrier operations experience.

  • Hands on with MPLS (L3VPN, EVPN) and the multi-tenant isolation a shared backbone needs.

  • Exposure to open source and white box routing or forwarding stacks (SONiC, IP Infusion OcNOS, FRR, or similar).

  • Network source of truth and automation tooling (Nautobot, NAPALM, Jinja config generation, NETCONF or gNMI).

  • Familiarity with a monitoring stack such as Zabbix, Grafana, Loki, or Prometheus, and with flow telemetry.

  • Working familiarity with FreeRADIUS, CoA and Disconnect flows, and how session control and accounting hook into the network.

  • Exposure to applying ML or AI in network operations: anomaly detection, predictive failure analysis, automated triage or remediation.

  • IPv6 and dual stack exposure, and internet exchange operations (looking glass and route server behaviour, IRR and RPKI hygiene).

4. What we offer

  • A seat inside a serious, very senior network team, with people who have deep service provider backgrounds and will sharpen you fast. You will see how a real carrier network behaves under live conditions.

  • A front row seat to how a network actually gets run in 2026. Open source forwarding, config as code, and an LLM layer doing real operational work. Not a slide about the future of network operations, but the environment you would work in every shift, and help build.

  • Real engineering, not just monitoring. The role is built so the quiet hours go into automation, propagation and health work, and tickets off the board. The path into deeper network engineering and automation work is the plan, not a vague someday.

  • Competitive salary and private health and wellness benefits, fully remote, in a mission driven, investor backed company building the backbone of Africa's next generation internet.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Delta Platform
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

Delta builds BLP’s core software: the technical foundation that everything else at the company runs on.

Who we're looking for

Modelling logic and correctness by construction is paramount to us. We aim to express what must be true, prevent invalid states, and keep systems pristine even as they grow.

Thus, we’re looking for highly ambitious engineers who can tackle difficult problems and think precisely. You must be able to make assumptions explicit and use formal, structured reasoning to reach a solution, and explain why it is correct. Typically, strong background in mathematics is a key foundation for this kind of work. We also place a high value on thoroughness and perfectionism.

Tooling wise, we rely heavily on type systems & functional programming.

 

What you'll do

Our work spans four areas, you will usually work on a given project within one of:

  • Infrastructure: Build and operate the cloud infrastructure BLP depends on, covering security, observability and CI/CD.

  • Backend: Develop a large codebase, tackling performance, concurrency and the challenges of distributed systems.

  • ML: Apply the latest AI technology to complex, real-world business problems and turn it into reliable production software.

  • Unbound: Build our product extension platform, enabling BLP to automate arbitrary customer business processes as we scale.

 

What you'll bring

We do not require experience with any particular technology or even industry software development experience.

You should, however, provide clear evidence of the abilities we’re looking for. That evidence could include:

  • strong academic backgrounds (math PhD/MSc or significant olympiad achievements)

  • startup experience (early employee, built productive systems yourself & know what it takes to maintain them)

  • FP experience (have deep understanding of programming languages and are able to discern the various tradeoffs of different paradigms)

 

What we value

We value engineers who think deeply about systems, care about correctness, and take pride in building infrastructure that is understandable, maintainable, and reliable.

Flexibility. Work on-site in Zurich or remotely within Europe.

 
 

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.
