jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja motivoitunutta Kotipalveluyrittäjää liittymään osaavien Kotirinki-yrittäjien joukkoon. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden rakentaa omaa menestystäsi joustavasti.

Työ sisältää: Siivouspalvelut arkipäivisin asiakkaiden kodeissa esimerkiksi säännöllisesti tehtävät ylläpitosiivoukset tai kertaluoteisia palveluita kuten teho- ja muuttosiivouksia tai ikkunoidenpesua. Tehtäviisi sisältyy myös ikäihmisten Kotiapupalvelut, kuten asiointiapuun, seuranpitoon ja arjen tukitehtäviin, sinulla tulee myös olla siihen soveltuvuutta ja kiinnostusta

Edellytämme: Vähintään B-ajokorttia (Suomalainen ajo-oikeus) ja auton käyttömahdollisuus Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, minimi taso B2 (asiakasviestintä tapahtuu suomeksi suullisesti ja kirjallisesti) Nuhteeton tausta ja luottotiedot kunnossa Hyvä fyysinen ja henkinen kunto

Arvostamme: Asiakaspalveluasennetta ja aitoa halua auttaa Kiinnostusta markkinointiin ja oman toiminnan kehittämiseen Valmiin toimintamallin arvostamista Tahtoa menestyä yrittäjänä ja tehdä töitä yhdessä.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kasvaa ja kehittyä osana lämminhenkistä ja tyytyväistä Kotirinkiläisten joukkoa. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!

Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.

Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.

Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.

Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.

Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.

Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo lähes 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.

Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimme

Nyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea ja etuja heti alusta alkaen.

Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme.

Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme. Seuraavat koulutukset ovat lokakuussa ja marraskuussa!!

Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, toiminimi,

jobs.title: Fulfillment Operator
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD LIER DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
Join our team of Fulfillment Operators at Lier!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store, and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

At Oda, you’ll work in a fast-paced, inclusive environment with passionate colleagues who value collaboration and learning. As a Fulfillment Operator, you’ll play a key role in picking and delivering high-quality groceries to the right customer. Together, we tackle operational challenges, support each other, and help shape Oda as a great place to work💪🏼


What you’ll be doing

  • Pick and pack goods for customers

  • Be the first point of contact for the handover of goods from suppliers

  • Ensure that products are on the shelves and that the workplace is kept tidy

  • Work closely with your team to achieve our operational goals and measure against company KPI´s

  • Contribute to a culture that works with continuous improvement of processes and working methods


What you’ll need to succeed🌟

  • Like working as part of a team towards a common goal and are keen to help others

  • See solutions rather than problems and offer suggestions for improvement where necessary

  • Are comfortable with and like routine-based tasks

  • Are motivated by working in a fast-paced, physically active environment

  • Are self-driven and enjoy taking ownership of tasks

  • Have a genuine desire to work and grow in Oda

  • Speak and understand English. Norwegian is a plus

  • The minimum age requirement for this position is 18 years


What would be nice to have💡

  • Previous experience in warehouse work, in a value chain, trade, or production

  • It's a plus if you have a forklift certificate

  • Being service-minded and customer-focused

  • Having your own car or being able to drive is great, as our working hours don't align well with public transportation


What we offer🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact at a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, which means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere.

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • Discounted lunch and a free gym to keep you fuelled and energised 🏋

  • Free parking

  • Oda Shuttle Bus: We offer a shuttle bus service for all employees between Lørenskog (Solheimveien) ➔ Helsfyr ➔ Sjølyst/Skøyen ➔ Lier 🚌


Practical informationℹ️

  • We are currently hiring for both day and night shifts.

    • Working hours:

      • Day shift: 06:30:-14:30

      • Night shift: 22:00-06:00

      • You are going to follow a fixed schedule with a shift rotation, working every fourth weekend

  • We're hiring for our Dry and Cold departments. You’ll primarily work in one department, but assist in the others when needed. Please specify in your application which department you're applying for

  • Application deadline: 6 November. We're actively looking for the right person to join our team, so we’ll be interviewing candidates on a rolling basis. Because we might close the ad early if we find the perfect fit, make sure to get your application in as soon as possible

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job🧡


Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium. As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so the invitation reaches the right place🤖


We look forward to hearing from you🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Department Manager Interior
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining future-oriented engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels for a wide range of market segments, including offshore energy, naval, fisheries, icebreaking and research. 

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength.  We need people with a wide range of skills, professional backgrounds, and experience. Engineers, designers, skilled workers, project managers, finance professionals, procurement specialists and many others all work together towards a common goal. Different perspectives and areas of expertise are essential to delivering high-quality vessels. 

To be able to build the ships of tomorrow today, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact. 

 

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Department Manager Interior to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and support Production Coordinators and Supervisors across projects.
  • Drive operational performance, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
  • Monitor project progress, resource utilization, quality, and efficiency. 
  • Ensure compliance with HSE requirements and promote a strong safety culture.
  • Collaborate with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, and installation teams to secure successful project execution. 
  • Resolve operational challenges and support the delivery of projects according to quality, schedule, and budget objectives. 
  • Contribute to planning, performance reporting, and development of the Interior department
Qualifications
  • Relevant technical education or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience within interior shipbuilding.
  • Leadership experience and strong people management skills.
  • Strong operational, planning, and resource management capabilities.
  • Good understanding of HSE, quality, and project execution.
  • Technical understanding of interior installation and production processes.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong leadership and communication skills.
  • Team-oriented and collaborative approach.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
  • Ability to motivate, coach, and develop employees.
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Why you'll enjoy working at VARD

 At VARD, you'll join an international company where innovation, collaboration, and continuous development are part of everyday work. We are committed to creating an environment where people thrive, grow, and succeed together. 

As part of our team, you'll benefit from: 

  • Exciting and meaningful work in a global maritime environment 
  • Opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth 
  • A competitive pension scheme and comprehensive insurance coverage 
  • Flexible working arrangements, including the possibility to work from home 
  • Subsidized lunch in our office canteen 
  • Subsidized gym membership to support your health and wellbeing 
  • Occupational health services 
  • Free mobile phone usage 
  • Modern office facilities with free parking 

At VARD, we also know that a great workplace is about more than just work. Through Social by VARD, you'll have the opportunity to connect with colleagues across teams and locations through a wide range of social activities and events. From fjord cruises, hiking, and cooking classes to football practice, go-karting, and wine tasting, there are plenty of opportunities to build relationships, share experiences, and create lasting memories.

ContactsVegard Nykrem, Vice President Installation, +47 924 38 495
LocationPostvegen 2
6018 Ålesund
Key information:Employer: Vard Interiors AS

Reference number: 5187579269
Percentage of full-time: 100%
Regular
Application deadline: 03/11/2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vard Interiors AS is a specialized company for interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R installation in Vard Group AS. Our company is present in VARD shipyards in Norway, Romania, and Vietnam. We have also established a subsidiary in Romania.

jobs.title: Myyjä, S-market Söderkulla / Försäljare, S-market Söderkulla
jobs.description:
Primary location:
SIPOO

MYYJÄ, S-MARKET SÖDERKULLA, 20 H/VKO, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää S-market Söderkullaan vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Myyjän työtehtävissä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtäviä, mm. asiakaspalvelutyötä kassalla sekä hyllytystä. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös myymälän siisteydestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä tuotteiden esillepano ja saatavuuden varmistaminen.
Me S-market Söderkullassa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin!

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä - myös juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta (10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtunti tulospalkkioon yrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 11.10.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa toimipaikkapäällikkö Victoria Uddström (victoria.uddstrom@sok.fi). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

FÖRSÄLJARE, S-MARKET SÖDERKULLA, 20 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till S-market Söderkulla för en fast anställning. Som försäljare får du arbeta mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter, bland annat kundservice i kassan och varuplock. I ditt dagliga arbete ingår också att se till att butiken är ren och trivsam samt att säkerställa produkternas exponering och tillgänglighet.
Här på S-market Söderkulla brukar vi säga att vi har helt vanliga jobb. Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng – tvärtom!

Vi önskar att du
- möter kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- har en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- har förmåga att ta i bruk nya system
- har möjlighet att jobba i varierande arbetsskift - under högtider.
Goda kunskaper i finska och kunskaper i svenska ses som en merit.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.
Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89 - 14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på båda finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi går vidare i rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, men senast söndag 11.10.2026. Mer information om får du av enhetschef Victoria Uddström (victoria.uddstrom@sok.fi). Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

jobs.title: Barista/Tearista, Thé Hidden
jobs.description:
Etsimme osa-aikaista baristaa/tearistaa Thé Hiddeniin

Thé Hidden on uuden konseptin mukainen teehuone ja kahvila, joka tarjoaa erikoisteetä ja -kahvia Tampereen keskustassa. Se tuo kaupunkiin uusia tuotteita. Valoisa ja pelkistetty tunnelma tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen ja rauhoittavan kokemuksen. Erikoistuneet tee- ja kahvivalikoimat, matcha sekä makeat ja suolaiset herkkumme ovat houkuttelevia. Meidät on juuri nimetty Suomen Top 30 kahviloihin 2026!

Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista baristaa/tearistaa, jolla on työkokemusta kahvila-alalta. Työtehtäväsi ovat monipuolisia ja sisältävät muun muassa:

- Kahvijuomien valmistus vankalla latte art -osaamisella

- Teejuomien valmistus

- Ruoan valmistus

- Tuotteiden esittely, myynti ja valmistus

- Ystävällinen asiakaspalvelu

- Kassatyöskentely

- Siisteyden ylläpito


Etsimme henkilöä, joka:

- On erittäin vastuuntuntoinen, motivoitunut ja energinen. Positiivisella asiakaspalveluasenteella varustettu, paineensietokykyinen ruuhka-aikoina ja joustava muuttuvissa tilanteissa.

- Voi työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että tiimissä

- Osaa sujuvasti suomea ja englantia

- Voi työskennellä pitkäaikaisesti

- Sinulla on hygieniapassi työsuhteen alkaessa


Tehtävä on osa-aikainen ja työtunteja on noin 12-30 tuntia viikossa. Työvuorot ovat klo 11.00-19.30 välillä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Kiinnostuitko? Lähetä ansioluettelo sähköpostitse osoitteeseen infothehidden@gmail.com otsikolla Thé Hidden SINUN NIMESI. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

Looking for a Part-time Barista/Tearista at Thé Hidden

Thé Hidden is a new-conceptual combined tearoom and cafeteria, offering speciality tea and coffee, located in the centre of Tampere. It brings novel products to the town. The bright and simplistic atmosphere will provide you a distinct experience and calmness. Specialized tea and coffee selections, as well as matcha and other treats are tempting. We've just been named one of Finlands Top 30 Cafés of 2026!

We are now looking for a part-time Barista/Tearista with working experiences in the cafe industry. Your duties are diverse, include but not limited to:

- Making coffee drinks with competent latte-art skill

- Making tea drinks

- Preparing food

- Preparing and selling retail products,

- Friendly customer service,

- Cashier work,

- Maintaining cleanliness.


The person we are looking for is:

- Highly responsible and motivated, with an energetic and positive customer service attitude, anti-pressure in rush hours and is flexible in dealing with changing situations

- You can work both independently and in a team

- You can speak fluent Finnish and English

- You can work long term

- You have a hygiene pass by the time the employment begins


This position is part time and is offered approximately 12-30 working hours/week. Work shifts are scheduled at between 11:00 and 19:30. The work starts according to the agreement.

Are you interested? A CV is requested to be sent by email to infothehidden@gmail.com, with the subject line Thé Hidden YOUR NAME. We interview applicants already during the application period and the position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found!

jobs.description:
**Rental Sales Agent, SIXT Rovaniemi**

**Talven suosituin matkailukohde tarvitsee tekijöitä vauhdikkaaseen operatiiviseen työhön.**

SIXT etsii sesonkityöntekijöitä Rovaniemen toimipisteeseen marraskuusta maaliskuuhun. Työ tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden olla osa kansainvälistä työympäristöä Lapin matkailun ytimessä ja osallistua päivittäin toimipisteen sujuvaan operatiiviseen toimintaan.

Etsimme energisiä ja oma-aloitteisia tekijöitä, jotka viihtyvät käytännönläheisessä työssä, nauttivat vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja ovat valmiita työskentelemään osana tiivistä tiimiä.

Tässä tehtävässä

- Vastaat ajoneuvojen siirroista eri toimipisteiden, huoltojen ja yhteistyökumppaneiden välillä

- Huolehdit autojen pesuista, tarkastuksista ja valmistelusta asiakkaille

- Varmistat, että kalusto on oikeassa paikassa, hyvässä kunnossa ja valmiina seuraavaa vuokrausta varten

- Käsittelet autonvuokrauksiin liittyviä käytännön tehtäviä toimipisteellä

- Toimit osana tiimiä varmistaen, että päivittäinen toiminta sujuu tehokkaasti ja turvallisesti


Sesongin aikana työpäivät ovat monipuolisia ja tempo voi olla ajoittain nopea. Työssä yhdistyvät käytännön tekeminen, ongelmanratkaisu ja yhteistyö kansainvälisessä ympäristössä. Työ on vuorotyötä ja sisältää ilta-, viikonloppu- ja pyhävuoroja.

Toivomme sinulta

- Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta

- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Positiivista asennetta ja halua oppia uutta

- suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi

- Voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia ja vähintään vuoden ajokokemusta


Tarjoamme

- Tuntipalkan 12,50 €/h

- Kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen

- Kansainvälisen työympäristön Lapin matkailun ytimessä

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää operatiivisia taitoja ja kartuttaa kokemusta kansainvälisessä yrityksessä

- SIXTin henkilöstöedut, kuten alennukset autonvuokrauksesta Suomessa ja ulkomailla, kattavan työterveyshuollon sekä ePassin


Aiempi kokemus autonvuokrausalalta ei ole välttämätöntä. Meille tärkeintä on oikea asenne, halu oppia ja kyky toimia osana tiimiä.

**Hae pian, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana.**

**Tule viettämään talvi Lapin kansainvälisimmässä matkailukaupungissa ja ole mukana pitämässä sesongin pyörät pyörimässä SIXTillä!**

jobs.title: Business Controller, Vianor
jobs.description:
Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. We continue to drive innovation and develop our premium technology from Nokia, where we are rooted. Today, operating in over 60 countries across the world, we are looking for experienced professionals and future talents to join us.

We are looking for a Business Controller, Vianor to join our team.

The Business Controller, Vianor acts as a senior finance business partner to the Vianor business leadership, providing financial insight, analysis and challenge to support performance management, profitability improvement and strategic decision-making. The role combines strong business understanding, disciplined financial planning and reporting, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business actions.

Key responsibilities:

- ·Financial leadership and business partnering: Provide proactive financial support, challenge and insights to Vianor business leadership and country organizations. Act as a trusted sparring partner in identifying performance drivers, risks, opportunities and concrete improvement actions.
- Performance management and profitability analysis: Lead analysis of business performance across sales, margin, cost, operating profit, working capital and cash flow. Support the business in understanding key profitability drivers, including customer, product, country and price-volume-mix dynamics.
- Planning, forecasting and budgeting: Own and coordinate key financial planning processes for Vianor, including monthly estimates, annual budgeting and long-range planning, in close cooperation with business leadership and country finance teams.
- Reporting and financial transparency: Ensure timely, accurate and meaningful financial reporting for Vianor and support country companies in monthly reporting. Continuously improve reporting quality, management insight and visualization of key financial information.
- Investment, business case and strategic support: Support business development, investment decisions, expansion initiatives and M&A-related activities by providing robust financial analysis, business case modelling and standardized evaluation methods.
- Process, tools and ways-of-working development: Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, planning practices, reporting tools and analytical methods. Promote efficient use of systems, data and digital tools, including business intelligence and AI-supported analysis.
- Governance, controls and audit support: Support sound financial governance, internal cost allocation, inventory-related follow-up and audit processes for Vianor and relevant country companies.

What we expect from you:

- A masters degree, preferably in finance, accounting or economics.
- Solid experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, reporting or a comparable senior finance role, preferably in an international, multi-entity environment.
- Strong understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, working capital, profitability drivers and financial performance management.
- Proven ability to act as a business partner to senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and convert financial analysis into practical business recommendations.
- Experience in budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, investment analysis and business case modelling.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for business audiences.
- High level of integrity, ownership and attention to detail, combined with the ability to operate independently and drive improvement across processes, tools and ways of working.
- Good command of modern finance systems, reporting tools and data analytics solutions; experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.
- Fluent written and spoken Finnish and English. Other relevant languages are considered an advantage.

The successful candidate combines strong financial expertise with commercial curiosity and a hands-on understanding of business operations. They are expected to be proactive, structured and collaborative, with the confidence to challenge the business constructively while building trust-based relationships across functions and countries.

Our way of working

Our talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. jobs.title: Parturi
jobs.description:
Etsin tällä hetkellä **1–2 henkilöä vakituiseen ja pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen**. Tarkoituksena ei siis ole määräaikainen työ, vaan toivon löytäväni henkilön, joka haluaa sitoutua työhön pidemmäksi aikaa.

Liikkeemme ovat normaalisti avoinna noin **klo 10.00–19.00/20.00**, ja työskentelemme myös lauantaisin ja sunnuntaisin. Työajat ja viikoittainen tuntimäärä voidaan kuitenkin sopia joustavasti työntekijän tilanteen ja toiveiden mukaan.

Työ voidaan järjestää joko **tuntipalkalla tai provisiopalkalla**. Molemmat vaihtoehdot ovat mahdollisia. Suurin osa työskentelee tällä hetkellä provisiopohjaisesti, ja provision määrä sovitaan työntekijän osaamisen, kokemuksen ja ammattitaidon perusteella.

Jos hakijalla on jo aikaisempaa kokemusta parturialalta ja hän hallitsee erityisesti miesten hiustenleikkauksia sekä esimerkiksi **skin fade- ja muita fade-tyylejä**, hänellä on mahdollisuus aloittaa työ suoraan.

Jos hakijalla ei vielä ole riittävästi kokemusta, mutta hän on aidosti kiinnostunut alasta ja motivoitunut oppimaan, voimme mahdollisuuksien mukaan aloittaa esimerkiksi **työkokeilulla**. Olen valmis opettamaan ja kehittämään hänen osaamistaan, jotta hän voisi myöhemmin jatkaa meillä työntekijänä.

Alan koulutus on etu, mutta minulle tärkeintä ovat **motivaatio, hyvä asenne, energia, halu oppia ja kiinnostus parturialaa kohtaan**. Hakija voi olla nainen tai mies. Toivon, että henkilö/hakija on Suomesta ja asuu Suomessa ja pystyy sitoutumaan työskentelyyn Jyväskylässä.

Meillä on tällä hetkellä kaksi liikettä Jyväskylässä:

**Kauppakatu 18, 40100 Jyväskylä,** **Polttolinja 1 LH 4, 40520 Jyväskylä**

Tavoitteeni on ennen kaikkea löytää **hyvä, motivoitunut ja pitkäaikainen tekijä**, jonka kanssa voimme rakentaa yhteistyötä pidemmälle tulevaisuuteen.

jobs.title: AGENTES DE CRÉDITO E EMPRÉSTIMOS
jobs.description:
E se o seu próximo trabalho fosse ajudar pessoas a concretizar alguns dos projetos mais importantes das suas vidas?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa de Intermediação de Crédito em Portimão e procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, de números e, sobretudo, de encontrar soluções.

Mais do que um Gestor de Crédito, procuramos uma pessoa curiosa, determinada e com vontade de fazer a diferença. Alguém capaz de ouvir um cliente, compreender a sua realidade e acompanhá-lo na procura de uma solução de financiamento adequada, competitiva e responsável.

No dia a dia, irá analisar necessidades e perfis financeiros, preparar e acompanhar processos de crédito, contactar entidades financeiras, comparar propostas e estar ao lado do cliente desde o primeiro contacto até à conclusão do processo.

Experiência na banca, crédito, seguros ou área financeira será valorizada, e muito. Mas não é o único caminho para chegar até nós. Se tem perfil comercial, facilidade de comunicação, capacidade de organização e vontade genuína de aprender, queremos conhecê-lo(a).

Procuramos alguém com energia, empatia, responsabilidade, capacidade de negociação e gosto por objetivos. Acima de tudo, alguém que perceba que por detrás de cada processo existem pessoas, famílias e projetos de vida.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento, ferramentas de trabalho e uma equipa disponível para ajudar. Queremos que cresça profissionalmente, desenvolva competências e encontre espaço para construir o seu próprio percurso connosco.

Se procura apenas mais um trabalho, talvez não sejamos o projeto certo. Se procura uma oportunidade para aprender, crescer e sentir que o seu trabalho tem impacto real na vida das pessoas, queremos falar consigo.

jobs.title: AGENTE IMOBILIÁRIO E GESTOR DE PROPRIEDADES
jobs.description:
E se o seu próximo desafio profissional não tivesse dias todos iguais?

Estamos a reforçar a nossa equipa imobiliária em Portimão e procuramos pessoas com energia, iniciativa e vontade de construir uma carreira onde o contacto humano, a autonomia e os resultados fazem parte do dia a dia.

Não procuramos apenas alguém para vender imóveis. Procuramos alguém que goste de pessoas, que tenha curiosidade pelo mercado e que queira tornar-se um verdadeiro profissional de confiança para quem precisa de comprar ou vender uma casa.

O dia a dia passa por conhecer e trabalhar uma determinada zona, identificar oportunidades, contactar proprietários, angariar e promover imóveis, acompanhar compradores e vendedores, realizar visitas, negociar propostas e estar presente em todas as etapas até à concretização do negócio.

Já tem experiência no imobiliário ou na área comercial? Excelente. Nunca trabalhou no setor? Isso não é necessariamente um problema. Procuramos sobretudo atitude, capacidade de comunicação, resiliência e vontade de aprender. O conhecimento e as ferramentas podem ser adquiridos; a vontade de fazer acontecer tem de partir de si.

Valorizamos pessoas positivas, responsáveis, organizadas e com espírito empreendedor. Pessoas que saibam ouvir, criar relações de confiança e que não tenham receio de sair da zona de conforto para alcançar objetivos.

Da nossa parte, encontrará formação, acompanhamento próximo, apoio comercial, jurídico e de marketing, CRM e ferramentas para desenvolver a sua atividade, integrando uma equipa onde a entreajuda faz parte da forma de trabalhar.

Não prometemos que todos os dias serão fáceis. Prometemos que serão diferentes.

Se procura uma profissão onde possa conhecer pessoas, desenvolver-se, superar-se e sentir que o seu trabalho é realmente seu, talvez esteja na altura de nos conhecermos.

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja, LVI
jobs.description:
Liity mukaan laivanrakentajien joukkoon – 160 vuotta huippuosaamista Helsingin keskustassa.

Olemme Helsinki Shipyard – telakka, joka on suunnitellut, rakentanut ja toimittanut räätälöityjä, korkealaatuisia matkustaja-aluksia ja jäänmurtajia ääriolosuhteisiin jo vuodesta 1865. Vuonna 2025 juhlistamme 160-vuotista taivaltamme, ja olemme ylpeitä saadessamme jatkaa tarinaamme Helsingin sydämessä, Hietalahden telakalla.

Meillä laivanrakennus tehdään alusta loppuun saman katon alla – suunnittelusta ja rungon valmistuksesta aina varusteluun, sisustukseen ja käyttöönottoon saakka. Tämä tekee meistä ainutlaatuisen työpaikan: näet oman kädenjälkesi osana kokonaisuutta ja pääset seuraamaan, kuinka valtava laiva nousee telakan hallissa vaihe vaiheelta valmiiksi.

Erikoisosaamisemme on arktisissa aluksissa, mutta rakennamme kaikkea superjahdeista monitoimijäänmurtajiin. Itse asiassa olemme valmistaneet noin 50 % maailman jäänmurtajista – ilman meitä jäisillä merillä navigointi olisi huomattavasti vaikeampaa.

Haemme LVI-osaajaa työnjohtajaksi telakan kunnossapitotiimiin!

Tässä roolissa pääset keskelle tekemistä – varmistamaan, että tuotanto toimii sujuvasti ja kehittämään kunnossapitoa yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

Tehtävänkuvaus

Työssäsi vastaat LVI-huoltotöiden suunnittelusta, koordinoinnista ja päivittäisestä johtamisesta. Huolehdit töiden aikataulutuksesta, resurssien organisoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta.

Päävastuut

- LVI-huolto- ja kunnossapitotöiden työnjohto

- Materiaalien ja tarvikkeiden hankinnan koordinointi

- Työn laadun, turvallisuuden ja dokumentoinnin varmistaminen

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutustaustaa, esimerkiksi talotekniikasta

- Aiempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta ja kunnossapitojärjestelmistä

- Tuntemusta kiinteistötekniikasta ja kunnossapidosta

- Hyviä organisointi- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Kyky johtaa useita samanaikaisia työtehtäviä

- Oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

Arvostamme erityisesti halua kehittää toimintaa ja rakentaa toimivaa yhteistyötä tiimin kanssa.

Miksi tämä voisi kiinnostaa sinua?

- Näet konkreettisesti työn tuloksen – joka viikko alus etenee silminnähtävästi.

- Teet töitä osaavien ammattilaisten kanssa matalassa organisaatiossa: meillä tehdään töitä porukalla, ei urakalla. Vältämme siiloja ja teemme yhdessä.

- Työ on monipuolista, merkityksellistä ja täynnä oppimismahdollisuuksia.

- Helsingin telakka toimii Helsingin sydämessä ja meidän laivat seilaavat maailman merillä. Täällä yhdistyy suomalainen osaaminen, pitkä historia ja kansainväliset huippuhankkeet.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jätä CV ja avoin hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmäämme 11.10.2026 mennessä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Tehtävä täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja aloituksesta sovitaan valittavan henkilön kanssa.

Huomioithan, että hakemukset otetaan vastaan vain rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta GDPR-vaatimusten täyttämiseksi.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa kunnossapidon osastopäällikkö Ari Sylve, ari.sylve@helsinkishipyard.fi tai p. 050 5908 8386.

Osana valintaprosessia tehtävään valituille henkilöille tehdään terveystarkastus, joka sisältää myös huumetestin. Joissakin tehtävissä saatetaan lisäksi vaatia turvallisuusselvitys.

  • Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns.

  • Proven record in client strategy, sales and building data-driven business cases that clients invest in.

  • Native-level German, understanding of Swiss German, fluent English.

  • Comfortable using AI as a core tool for analysis, reporting and consulting.

What makes you a fit:

  • You like taking ownership and seeing things through.

  • You give honest feedback, to clients and to us.

  • You know when to plan carefully, when to perfect, and when to move fast.

  • You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward.

Perks:

  • Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy - we're results-oriented and don't micromanage.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays.

  • Fair compensation and profit participation.

  • Personal development opportunities, e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins' UPW event.

  • 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won't be considered.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java, Kafka & Integration
jobs.description:
Als Senior Java Developer bist du ein zentraler Teil unseres Entwicklungsteams und gestaltest anspruchsvolle, geschäftskritische Softwarelösungen aktiv mit. Dein Fokus liegt auf modernen, skalierbaren Architekturen, der Verarbeitung sehr hoher Datenvolumen sowie einer nachhaltigen Softwarequalität. Dabei bringst du nicht nur deine technische Expertise ein, sondern unterstützt das Team auch dabei, Lösungen und Entwicklungsprozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aufgaben:

  • Als vollwertiges Teammitglied arbeitest du an der Weiterentwicklung komplexer Lösungen mit Fokus auf Java, Kafka und Elasticsearch/OpenSearch

  • Du bist aktiv an der Umsetzung beteiligt und agierst als Vorbild für hohe Softwarequalität, insbesondere hinsichtlich Clean Code, Testabdeckung und Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

  • Du integrierst die entwickelten Lösungen unternehmensweit und stellst APIs und Schnittstellen für andere Komponenten und Systeme zur Verfügung

  • Du entwickelst Lösungen für die Verarbeitung sehr hoher Datenvolumen, sowohl in Realtime- als auch Batch-Szenarien

  • Du unterstützt das Team dabei, den Entwicklungsprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern und eine zuverlässige, hochwertige Bereitstellung der Lösungen


Anforderungen:

  • Du bist ein erfahrener Softwareentwickler und -designer mit fundierter Expertise in moderner Softwareentwicklung, Microservices und Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Integrationskompetenz und hast bereits erfolgreich an Integrationsprojekten gearbeitet

  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Kafka sowie idealerweise Elasticsearch oder OpenSearch mit

  • Als Generalist fühlst du dich in allen Schichten einer Lösung zuhause und kannst technische Zusammenhänge ganzheitlich beurteilen

  • Du entwickelst mit Begeisterung in Java und/oder Go und legst grossen Wert auf Clean Code und nachhaltige Softwarequalität

  • Du kennst moderne Cloud-basierte Architekturen und Lösungen, idealerweise im Umfeld einer Private Cloud

  • Nice zo have: Zusätzliche Erfahrung mit Angular ist von Vorteil.

Generelle Rahmenbedingungen:

  • Start: asap

  • Dauer: langfristig, erster Vertrag bis ende Jahr

  • Pensum: 80-100%

  • 1 Tag vor Ort in Raum Olten (Donnerstag)

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries (M/F)

Luxembourg | req786

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Developer to join our team, focusing on Multi/Single Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and cultivating relationships with professional intermediaries and clients, driving business growth, and ensuring the delivery of exceptional service. The position is based in Luxembourg and you will report to the Head of Multi Family Offices & Professional Intermediaries.

Your next challenge:

• Contribute to the growth strategy and to the development of the value proposition of the bank
• Conduct research to identify business opportunities with new customers
• Develop a growth strategy, foster and build both long-term and trustworthy customer relationships with professional intermediaries, including law firms, fiduciaries, and family offices (B2B and B2C)
• Maintain an extensive knowledge of the current market conditions to detect and/or anticipate possible commercial opportunities for the customers
• Collaborate across business lines to help you develop new business leads
• Attend and coordinate events (seminars, conferences)
• Make use of the internal CRM to keep track on your business development activities

Your skills:

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in a front function within the banking or financial services sector
• A strong international network of MFO/SFO & Professional Intermediaries
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance
• Solid understanding of wealth structuring, wealth management product and services
• Excellent interpersonal skills, an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to build sustainable relationships
• Proven negotiation skills and the ability to close deals
• A high level of integrity and ethics
• Strong analytical skills, particularly in KYC/AML compliance.
• A relevant University background in Finance
• Fluent in English and French, any other language is seen as an advantage (for example : German, Italian)
• Strongly client- and results-oriented
• Rigorous, organized and methodical in customer approach actions
• Motivated to be part of a great team
• Willing and able to travel

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.

BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Fixed-term contract - 12 months) (m/f)
jobs.employer: Bank Pictet & Cie (Europe) AG, succursale de Luxembourg S.A.E.
jobs.description:
Career Opportunities: Senior DevOps Engineer (Fixed-term contract - 12 months) (124840)

Requisition ID 124840 - Luxembourg - Experienced Professionals

Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

Pictet Tech division specializes in designing and integrating cutting-edge software applications, including advanced portfolio management systems, sophisticated trading platforms, and comprehensive banking and corporate solutions. As a key contributor to the Group's strategic advancements, the division plays a vital role in driving transformative innovations that enhance our services and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

We are seeking a DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen the reliability and performance of the bank's strategic application processes through an advanced monitoring and observability framework across both on-premises and cloud environments. Monitoring is designed and implemented in close cooperation with software engineering teams in order to track end-to-end application chains. Industrialize application and business process deployments by designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure production releases and a stable IT production environment.. Participation in a periodic 24/7 on-call shift is required.

Your role

• Provide support to operations teams. Lead post-incident reviews, including Root Cause Analysis and post-mortems. Define and track preventive action plans.
• Collaborate with business and technical teams to align system reliability with operational needs and produce clear operational documentation.
• Industrialize and standardize the deployment of applications and business processes through automated CI/CD pipelines.
• Design, implement and maintain monitoring and observability solutions for business processes, including dashboards, reliability indicators, alerting and end-to-end flow traceability, with advanced use of the Grafana Observability Stack across on-premises systems and cloud services.
• Analyze business-process performance and recommend improvements.
• Integrate new processing tasks into the production schedule and/or optimize existing ones.
• Configure and implement data transfers with external partners, ensuring reliability, traceability and end-to-end monitoring.
• Contribute to the cloud strategy, including deployments, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
• Automate recurring tasks through scripts, workflows and tooling in collaboration with development and operations teams
• Ensure compliance with regulatory and data-protection requirements.

Your profile

• Master's degree / Engineering degree in Computer science
• Fluent in french and english
• Minimum 7 years of experience in a similar role, ideally within a banking environment or fund administration
• Strong expertise in monitoring and observability tools, as well as distributed tracing concepts (Grafana, Dynatrace, Jaeger).
• Good knowledge of cloud environments from major providers (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), with a sound understanding of IaaS, PaaS and SaaS service models.
• Solid knowledge enabling effective use of Kubernetes and Docker infrastructures, including operations, scaling and monitoring.
• Proven hands-on experience with scripting and automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell, orchestration tools).
• Working knowledge of systems and networking (Linux/Unix, Windows Server, core networking fundamentals) to support diagnosis and troubleshooting, without acting as a day-to-day system administrator.
• Familiarity with DevOps concepts and Site Reliability Engineering practices, including reliability indicators, capacity management and scalability.

jobs.title: Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO (m/f)
jobs.description:
Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & Group MLRO

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve. We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, and the Netherlands, as well as a subsidary in the UK. Supervised by the CSSF we have the ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.

When you join us you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

The Head of Group Financial Crime Compliance & MLRO has primary responsibility for implementation, oversight and monitoring of the Group's financial crime compliance framework (across money laundering & terrorist financing, sanctions, bribery & corruption, external fraud risks), ensuring robust risk management, full regulatory compliance, and effective detection and reporting of financial crime, thereby safeguarding the integrity, reputation, and resilience of the organisation. The role holder acts as the central point of contact with competent authorities and the FIU on financial crime (including specifically AML/CFT ) matters.

Key Accountabilities

Group AML/CFT Framework Leadership:

• Define, implement and maintain a consistent and effective Group-wide FCC framework aligned with applicable regulations and group risk appetite  across all entities.
• Ensure policies, procedures and control expectations are defined, implemented and maintained.    

Group Financial Crime Risk Stewardship:

• Oversee the effectiveness of the financial crime risk control framework .  
• Provide advice,  guidance and challenge to the 1LoD risk and control ownership.  
• Coordinate and maintain the group-wide financial crime risk assessment.

Client Due Diligence Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of client due diligence and client acceptance processes.
• Ensure higher risk clients are subject to enhanced due diligence.
• Monitor compliance with client onboarding and periodic review requirements.            
                        
Suspicious Activity Reporting Oversight:

• Oversee the effectiveness of transaction monitoring and client/transaction screening arrangements including systems/toolings.
• Act as ultimate escalation point for suspicious activity, investigate complex cases and ensure timely and compliant reporting to FIUs.                                    

Regulatory Engagement & Representation:

• Serve as primary contact for regulators, leading inspections, managing regulatory interactions, overseeing regulatory reporting and ensuring remediation of findings for financial crime matters.                                    

Group MLRO Network & Local Oversight:

• Lead and coordinate local MLROs, ensuring consistent governance, escalation, independence and oversight across jurisdictions.
Governance, Board Reporting & Advisory:
• Provide regular FCC reporting to senior management and the Board, advising on risk exposure, control effectiveness and mitigation strategies.
• Ensure escalation of major financial crime risk events, breaches or control issues, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation and remediation.

Culture, Training & Awareness:

• Promote a strong compliance culture throughout the organisation by designing and delivering effective AML/CFT training and awareness across all levels of the organisation

Knowledge and Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CAMS, CFE) preferred.
• Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in financial crime compliance within the financial services industry (Larger bank / big four preferred), with a focus on AML, ABC, sanctions, and policy framework.
• In-depth knowledge of European and UK regulatory requirements related to financial crime compliance, including AML directives, sanctions regimes, and bribery/corruption laws.                          
• Proven experience in developing and implementing FCC policies, procedures, and controls across multiple jurisdictions.
• Strong leadership and management skills with the ability to effectively oversee a team and drive results in a dynamic and complex environment.  

Attributes and Qualities

• Leadership & People Management                                
• Collaborative Teamwork                                
• Critical Thinking & Problem Solving                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                                
• Conflict Resolution & Negotiation

Technical Skills

• MS Office proficiency

Languages Skills

• English: Fluent
• Any other Quintet language is considered an asset

jobs.description:
Gestionnaire Assurances Vie Entreprises

Location Leudelange
Experience Level Professionnels
Home Office Oui

Votre job en bref

En tant que Gestionnaire Vie Entreprises, vous assurez la gestion et le suivi des contrats d'assurance groupe destinés aux entreprises au Luxembourg. Vous accompagnez les clients, partenaires et affiliés tout au long du cycle de vie des contrats, tout en garantissant leur conformité aux exigences légales et réglementaires. Grâce à votre expertise en assurance Vie Groupe (Employee Benefits), vous contribuez à la qualité du service, à la satisfaction des clients et au développement durable des relations commerciales.

Ce qui vous attend

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

• Gérer l'ensemble du cycle de vie des contrats d'assurance groupe et des régimes complémentaires de pension : mise en place, renouvellements, décomptes, paiements, investissements, affiliations, sorties et prestations.
• Accompagner les entreprises, les services RH, les affiliés et les courtiers dans le traitement de leurs demandes et le suivi de leurs contrats.
• Contrôler la conformité des dossiers et veiller au respect des exigences légales et réglementaires applicables, notamment en matière d'AML/KYC et d'IGSS.
• Analyser les besoins des entreprises et contribuer à la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées ainsi qu'à la mise en place de nouveaux contrats.
• Développer et renforcer les relations avec les clients et partenaires, participer aux présentations auprès des employés et assurer le suivi des commissions des agents et courtiers.
• Collaborer avec les équipes Finance, Actuariat, Ventes, Juridique et Compliance afin de garantir une gestion fluide et efficace des contrats.
• Participer au partage des connaissances, aux projets de l'équipe et aux initiatives contribuant à l'amélioration continue de l'activité Vie Entreprises.
• Assurer une veille sur les évolutions du marché et du cadre réglementaire afin de contribuer au maintien de la qualité et de la pertinence des solutions proposées.

Ce que nous attendons

• Formation de niveau BAC+3 à BAC+5 en assurances, gestion, finance ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans une fonction opérationnelle du secteur des assurances, idéalement dans l'environnement Vie Groupe ou Employee Benefits.
• Bonne connaissance des produits Vie Groupe, des régimes complémentaires de pension et du fonctionnement des contrats collectifs.
• Compréhension des enjeux fiscaux, financiers et réglementaires liés au marché luxembourgeois de l'assurance et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement fortement réglementé.
• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques, bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et aisance dans l'utilisation des outils de gestion propres au secteur de l'assurance.
• Esprit d'analyse, aisance avec les chiffres, sens de l'organisation et capacité à gérer plusieurs dossiers avec rigueur.
• Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles, orientation client, sens du service et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes.
• Maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un atout.

À propos de Baloise

Nous sommes plus qu'une compagnie d'assurance traditionnelle : nous sommes le partenaire personnel de quiconque veut se sentir tout simplement en sécurité. Outre nos activités financières classiques, nous cherchons à innover et à créer des liens générateurs de valeur avec des partenariats et des start-ups. Nous considérons l'ère numérique comme une opportunité et aspirons à ce que notre offre de demain soit encore plus durable, plus innovante et plus orientée client. Vous voulez y participer ?

Nous vous donnons la liberté de poursuivre vos idées... Investissez-vous ! Remettez-nous en question ! Continuez à évoluer et à nous faire évoluer !  Tout ceci est possible grâce à notre culture de l'apprentissage et de l'erreur ainsi qu'à une communication d'égal à égal. Parce que ce n'est qu'ensemble que nous pourrons aller de l'avant.

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services (m/f)
jobs.description:
Job Title:  Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services

Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting
Job Function:  Consulting Services
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14080

Job Description:  

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

Your skills

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Economics, Engineering, or Information Technology (Master's preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
• Around 3-4 years of relevant experience in the banking industry, with demonstrated exposure to middle- and/or back-office operations.
• Solid knowledge of multiple banking value chains, including but not limited to:  

1. Payments & Cash Management
2. Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
3. Investment & Portfolio Management
4. Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
5. Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
6. Lombard & Collateral Management
7. Trade Finance
8. Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Operations

• Proven experience writing Business Requirements Documents, functional specifications, or service descriptions in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
• Ability to translate high-level strategic intent into detailed, workable operational and technology specifications.
• Familiarity with target operating model design, process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), and service delivery frameworks.
• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools; certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an asset.
• Pragmatic, autonomous, solution-oriented, and comfortable working at speed across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
• Exceptional written communication skills — ability to produce clear, structured, and professional documentation.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior leadership and subject matter experts.
• Fluent in English; French and/or any additional language is an asset.
• Ability to efficiently manage multiple deliverables and priorities in a fast-paced, high-ambition environment.

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

Get to know more about Deloitte on our LinkedIn page (#DeloitteLU), Instagram page, YouTube page or website.
With more than 2,600 employees and 98 nationalities, Deloitte Luxembourg is one of the Grand Duchy's largest, strongest and oldest professional services firms. For more than 75 years, our talented teams have been serving clients in various industries delivering high added-value offerings to national and international clients in audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. Deloitte Luxembourg is part of the global Deloitte network.

jobs.title: Lower School Learner Support Teacher - 1 year contract (m/f)
jobs.description:
Want to help every learner access, participate and thrive?

At the International School of Luxembourg (ISL), we believe that learner diversity enriches our community. We are looking for a Lower School Learner Support Services (LSS) Teacher who is passionate about creating inclusive learning environments where children feel known, valued and empowered to grow.
Working within our learning community, you will support students with language acquisition and/or diverse learning needs, partnering closely with classroom teachers, families and colleagues across Learner Support Services. Through responsive teaching, targeted intervention and inclusive practice, you will help remove barriers to learning and enable students to develop confidence, agency and independence.
Why does this Role matter?
You will be an important advocate for learners and a resource for our whole learning community. Your expertise will help teachers respond to learner variability, help families understand and support their child's development, and—most importantly—help students recognise themselves as capable, active and successful learners. At ISL, learner support is not simply about helping students overcome challenges. It is about creating the conditions in which every child can participate, develop agency, experience success and reach their potential.

Why ISL?
At ISL, you will join a diverse, caring, and forward-thinking community where:
● Learning is driven by curiosity, compassion, and connection
● Educators are supported to grow, reflect, and innovate
● Students are empowered to find their voice and shape their future
At ISL, learning is deeply human. We believe in creating spaces where students feel seen, heard, and inspired to take ownership of their learning. At our school, learning is driven by curiosity, inquiry, and hands-on experimentation. We are looking for teachers who see teaching as relational, creative and purposeful.

What will You do?
● Support learners individually, in small groups and within the classroom through inclusive, evidence-informed language and learning interventions.
● Co-teach and collaborate with classroom teachers to differentiate learning experiences and ensure meaningful access to the IB Primary Years Programme curriculum.
● Build learner agency by involving students in understanding their strengths, setting learning goals and reflecting on their progress.
● Use assessment purposefully to identify learning needs, monitor growth and adapt interventions and support.
● Develop and monitor Individual Learning Plans, accommodations and targeted learning goals for students requiring additional support.
● Case-manage students receiving language or learning support, maintaining clear records and coordinating communication between students, families, teachers and relevant specialists.
● Partner with families, building trusting and respectful relationships around each child's learning, development and wellbeing.
● Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, including classroom teachers, counsellors, school leaders and external specialists.
● Strengthen inclusive practice by sharing expertise, resources and strategies with teachers and teaching assistants.
● Contribute actively to the wider Learner Support Services Team and our collaborative professional learning culture.
● Taking active part in the vibrant life of the school — from parent evenings to community events to leading beyond-the-classroom activities.
● Engaging in personal professional growth and bring fresh ideas into the classroom.
● Engage with AI effectively in guiding learners by having a human-centered mindset, promoting ethical principles and responsible use, and providing the knowledge, understanding and skills needed to create and use AI to complement their education.
You will thrive here if you …
● Build positive, trusting relationships with children and creates a strong sense of belonging and psychological safety.
● See learner variability through a strengths-based and inclusive lens.
● Differentiate learning thoughtfully and creatively to reduce barriers and increase participation.
● Collaborate effectively and sees co-teaching as a shared professional practice.
● Communicate sensitively and clearly with students, families, colleagues and external specialists.
● Use evidence, observation and assessment to make informed decisions about learning.
● Are organised and dependable when managing individual learning plans, referrals, documentation and confidential information.
● Reflect on your practice, seeks feedback and remains curious about developments in language acquisition and inclusive education.
● Demonstrate cultural responsiveness, empathy and respect within a diverse international community.

Who are You?
● Strong knowledge of inclusive education, learning differences and/or English language acquisition.
● An understanding of multi-tiered systems of support (“MTSS”) and the use of targeted, evidence-informed interventions.
● Experience with co-teaching, differentiation and inclusive classroom practice.
● Able to use assessment information to identify needs, establish goals and monitor student progress.
● Hold a current teaching qualification/certification and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent; a Master's degree in Special/Inclusive Education, Learning Support, Learning Differences or Language Acquisition is highly valued.
● Preferably two years of recent successful experience working with preschool or primary-aged learners with language and/or learning support needs.
● Experience supporting multilingual learners and recognising multilingualism as an asset.
● Experience interpreting psychoeducational assessments and translating recommendations into classroom practice would be an advantage.
● Experience in an international school and/or IB PYP environment is highly valued.
● Near-native fluency in English and confidence using digital tools to support learning, collaboration and documentation.

We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
We are committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expect all staff to share this commitment.
Recruitment timeline:
• If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.
• If you have not been contacted after the deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

jobs.description:
Supply Chain Analyst, Supply Chain Operations
Job ID: 10553338 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84

Description

Amazon Supply Chain forms the backbone of the fastest growing ecommerce business in the world. The sheer growth of the business and the company's mission "to be Earth's most customer-centric company” makes the customer fulfilment business bigger and more complex with each passing year.

Our Supply Chain team is responsible for planning and executing the network for our UK fulfilment business. We work closely with Amazon's Fulfillment Centers (FCs), Transportation, Retail and Finance teams, orchestrating the upstream and downstream partners to exceed customer expectations while optimizing end-to-end supply chain speed and cost.

We are looking for an analytical and driven Supply Chain Analyst to join our team. In this role, a S&OP Supply Chain Analyst will seek out problems, dive deep into data, earn trust of partner teams, and deliver results that can have a large scale influence. This role is a blend of short term execution and long term strategic planning, that requires quick decision-making, with incomplete data, while also thinking big and influencing the long term direction of the network.
You will be responsible for driving EU level strategic projects and change initiatives in collaboration with multiple stakeholders and in alignment with senior management. You will also work on key analytical projects to drive smarter and optimal decisions within the team.
The end goal of this role is to answer the question of how we can fulfill more products to our customers in a safer, faster, more efficient, and more cost-effective manner.

Key job responsibilities

- Make sound business judgments to drive both tactical as well as strategic improvements
- Own programmatic execution and the detailed and strategic levels
- Identify, prioritize, and implement processes to eliminate defects in the supply chain
- Create, develop, and drive solutions that lead to a richer end to end customer experience
- Successfully operate and influence in a cross-functional capacity

About the team

Customer Fulfilment, or CF, is where it all started for Amazon. CF has scaled up from a humble team of booksellers to a sophisticated global team which handles more than 1.5 million orders every day. The team is the foundation of our business and its efforts have helped us diversify across new regions and services. With the help of emerging technology, we're always looking for ways to offer a bigger, better product range – delivered quickly and affordably.

Our centres are sometimes referred to as the ‘First Mile' because it's where most Amazon packages start their journey. We help to manage dynamic inventory and facilitate speedy deliveries round the clock.

Lots of different people work in our Fulfilment Centres, so there are plenty of opportunities for every skillset. Some of us work with physical products, while others analyse data to help everyone across the business make smart decisions.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business or a related field
- Experience working in supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of SQL

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience with planning, performance metrics, and process improvement
- Experience using data analysis to drive business decisions
- Experience building and growing relationships with internal and external partners
- Experience communicating complex concepts clearly and persuasively to different audiences

Job ID: 10553049 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

Amazon's Employee Experience & Outcomes (EXO) organization exists to earn, drive, deliver and protect the trust between Amazon and its 1.5M+ workforce. Within EXO, the Research, Strategy & Solutions Team is EXO's center of excellence for employee relations research, intelligence, proactive strategies/consulting and solutions. We are seeking a HR Specialist to join our team as an individual contributor reporting to the Research, Strategy and Solutions Leader.

In this role, you will assess data, workplace dynamics, behaviors, external trends, and relationships to identify risks and gaps in the work environment, and translate those insights into sustainable, scalable initiatives, mechanisms, and programs that drive long-lasting change at all levels. You will influence leaders to gain alignment and support, and work cross-functionally and globally to design and execute large-scale proactive strategies.

This is a research-forward role: the emphasis is on data-driven analysis, strategic foresight, and forward-looking trend intelligence rather than reactive ER issues management or investigations. Success requires deep employee and labor relations expertise, strong analytical and research skills, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly and persuasively.
